original: sādaramiha vedagiriprādurbhūtaṃ sarojabhūdayitam | ghanasārasarasabhāsaṃ śirasā harimānamāmi paramādyam || 3 ||
analyzed: sa ādaram iha vedagiri prādurbhūtam saroja bhū dayitam ghanasāra sarasa bhāsam śirasā harim ānamāmi parama adyam

original: vedagirau veṅkaṭādrau ‘vedādrirgaruḍādriśca’ iti tannāmasu pāṭhāt | prādurbhūtaṃ abhivyaktaṃ sarojabhuvaḥ śriyaḥ ‘sā’haṃ vai paṅkaje jātā’ iti mahābhāratokteḥ | dayitaṃ vallabhaṃ ghanasāraḥ jaladharavaraḥ ‘sāro bale sthirāṃśe ca nyāyye klībaṃ vare triṣu’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: vedagirau veṅkaṭādrau vedādriḥ garuḍādriḥ ca iti tad nāmasu pāṭhāt prādurbhūtam abhivyaktam saroja bhuvaḥ śriyaḥ sā aham vai paṅkaje jātā iti mahābhārata ukteḥ dayitam vallabham ghanasāraḥ jaladharavaraḥ sāraḥ bale sthira aṃśe ca nyāyye klībam vare triṣu iti amaraḥ

original: tamiva sarasabhāsaṃ ādyaṃ jagatkāraṇaṃ ataeva paraṃ sarvasmāduttamaṃ hariṃ śrīnivāsaṃ sādaraṃ yathā syāttathā śirasā ānamāmi |
analyzed: tam iva sarasa bhāsam ādyam jagat kāraṇam atas eva param sarvasmāt uttamam harim śrīnivāsam sādaram yathā syāt tathā śirasā ānamāmi

original: pakṣe sarojabhūrbrahmā tasmin dayā’sya sañjātā dayitaḥ tārakāditvāditac | taṃ tathoktaṃ, ataeva vedagiri nigamavāci sādaraṃ, ataeva prādurbhūtaṃ madhukaiṭabhanirvartitanigamāpahāranirviṇṇe nīrajāsane
analyzed: pakṣe saroja bhūḥ brahmā tasmin dayā asya sañjātā dayitaḥ tam tathā uktam ataeva vedagiri nigama vāci sādaram ataeva prādurbhūtam madhu kaiṭabha nirvartita nigama apahāra nirviṇṇe nīraja āsane

original: etasminnantare rājan devo hayaśirodharaḥ| jagrāha vedānakhilān rasātalagatān hariḥ ||
analyzed: etasmin antare rājan devaḥ haya śiraḥ dharaḥ jagrāha vedān akhilān rasātala gatān hariḥ

original: iti hayaśiraupākhyānoktarītyā vedoddharaṇāya kṛtāvatāramityarthaḥ | ghanasāraḥ karpūraḥ ‘atha karpūramastriyām | ghanasāraḥ’ ityamaraḥ | tamiva sarasabhāsaṃ ramaṇīyaviśadasuṣamaṃ ādyaṃ śirasā hariṃ hayaśirasamityarthaḥ | ‘itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe’ iti tṛtīyā | paraṃ atyantaṃ ānamāmi |
analyzed: iti hayaśiras upākhyāna ukta rītyā veda uddharaṇāya kṛta avatāram iti arthaḥ ghanasāraḥ karpūraḥ atha karpūram astriyām ghanasāraḥ iti amaraḥ tam iva sarasa bhāsam ramaṇīya viśada suṣamam ādyam śirasā harim hayaśirasam iti arthaḥ itthaṃbhūta lakṣaṇe iti tṛtīyā param atyantam ānamāmi

original: atra śrīnivāsahayānanayorubhayorapi nantavyatvena prastutayoreva śleṣaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: atra śrīnivāsa haya ānanayoḥ ubhayoḥ api nantavya tvena prastutayoḥ eva śleṣaḥ 3

original: anyonyānuguṇādhikavikasvarollāsilalitamadhuratamam | viśvālaṅkaraṇaṃ tadvibhātu mama hṛdi sadātanaṃ mithunam || 4 ||
analyzed: anyonya anuguṇa adhika vikasvara ullāsi lalita madhuratamam viśva alaṅkaraṇam tat vibhātu mama hṛdi sadātanam mithunam

original: anyonyasya parasparasya anuguṇāni adhikaṃ vikasvarāṇi ullāsīni ullāsavanti yāni lalitāni vilāsaviśeṣāḥ taiḥ madhuratamam | yadvā anyonyānuguṇādhikavikasvarollāso’syā stīti tathoktaṃ bhinnaṃ padam | lalitamadhuratamaṃ viśvālaṅkaraṇaṃ sakalalokavibhūṣaṇabhūtaṃ sadātanaṃ mithunaṃ śrīśrīnivāsarūpaṃ mama hṛdi vibhātu |
analyzed: anyonyasya parasparasya anuguṇāni adhikam vikasvarāṇi ullāsīni ullāsavanti yāni lalitāni vilāsa viśeṣāḥ taiḥ madhuratamam yat vā anyonya anuguṇa adhika vikasvara ullāsā usyā asti iti tathā uktam bhinnam padam lalita madhuratamam viśva alaṅkaraṇam sakala loka vibhūṣaṇa bhūtam sadātanam mithunam śrī śrīnivāsa rūpam mama hṛdi vibhātu

original: pakṣe anyonyaṃ anuguṇaḥ adhikaṃ vikasvaraḥ ullāsaścetyete’laṅkārā asmin santīti tathoktam | lalitena lalitanāmnā’laṅkāreṇa madhuratamaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ alaṅkaraṇaṃ alaṅkāraśāstramityarthaḥ | yadvā viśvāni alaṅkaraṇāni yasmin viṣayaviṣayibhāvasambandhena santi tattathoktaṃ tadrūpaṃ mithunamiti yojanā | spaṣṭamanyat |
analyzed: pakṣe anyonyam anuguṇaḥ adhikam vikasvaraḥ ullāsaḥ ca iti ete ilaṅkārāḥ asmin santi iti tathā uktam lalitena lalita nāmnā alaṅkāreṇa madhuratamam viśvam sarvam alaṅkaraṇam alaṅkāra śāstram iti arthaḥ yat vā viśvāni alaṅkaraṇāni yasmin viṣaya viṣayi bhāva sambandhena santi tat tathā uktam tad rūpam mithunam iti yojanā spaṣṭam anyat

original: vivakṣitasūcanāyāyaṃ śleṣasaṃrambhaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: vivakṣita sūcanāya ayam śleṣa saṃrambhaḥ

original: yuktyullekhavicitraprauḍhoktinidarśanātigambhīrān | saparikarasamādhividhīnvacasā’laṃkṛtimaṇīngurūnkalaye || 5 ||
analyzed: yukti ullekha vicitra prauḍha ukti nidarśana ati gambhīrān sa parikara samādhi vidhīn vacasā alaṃkṛti maṇīn gurūn kalaye 5

original: yuktīnāṃ ullekhena ūhena vicitrā āścaryāvahāḥ yāḥ prauḍhāḥ pragalbhāḥ uktayaḥ tāsāṃ nidarśanena prakāśanena atigambhīrān saparikaraḥ yamaniyamādiparikarasahitaḥ samādhividhiḥ dhyānavidhānaṃ yeṣāṃ tān anārataparabrahmadhyānabaddhādarānityarthaḥ | viśeṣaṇadvayena ‘dve vidye veditavye’ ityuktaparāvarajñānopādātṛtvaṃ sūcitam |
analyzed: yuktīnām ullekhena ūhena vicitrāḥ āścarya āvahāḥ yāḥ prauḍhāḥ pragalbhāḥ uktayaḥ tāsām nidarśanena prakāśanena ati gambhīrān sa parikaraḥ yama niyama ādi parikara sahitaḥ samādhi vidhiḥ dhyāna vidhānam yeṣām tān anārata para brahma dhyāna baddha ādarān iti arthaḥ viśeṣaṇa dvayena dve vidye veditavye iti ukta parāvara jñāna upādātṛ tvam sūcitam

original: kṛtimaṇīn vidvadvariṣṭhān gurūn lakṣmīnāthādyasmadācāryaparyantān alaṃ vacasā kalaye staumītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: kṛti maṇīn vidvat variṣṭhān gurūn lakṣmīnātha ādi asmad ācārya paryantān alam vacasā kalaye staumi iti arthaḥ

original: pakṣe yuktiḥ ullekhaḥ vicitraṃ prauḍhoktiḥ nidarśanetyetairalaṅkāraviśeṣeaiḥ atigambhīrān parikaraḥ samādhiḥ vidhirityetairalaṅkāraissaha vartanta iti tathoktān gurūn śreṣṭhān alaṅkṛtayo maṇaya iva alaṅkṛtimaṇayaḥ tān vacasā kalaye grathnāmītyarthaḥ | atra sūcyārthasya śleṣeṇa sūcanam || 5 ||
analyzed: pakṣe yuktiḥ ullekhaḥ vicitram prauḍhā uktiḥ nidarśanā iti etaiḥ alaṅkāra viśeṣaiḥ ati gambhīrān parikaraḥ samādhiḥ vidhiḥ iti etaiḥ alaṅkāraiḥ saha vartante iti tathā uktān gurūn śreṣṭhān alaṅkṛtayaḥ maṇayaḥ iva alaṅkṛti maṇayaḥ tān vacasā kalaye grathnāmi iti arthaḥ atra sūcya arthasya śleṣeṇa sūcanam

original: vakulasarālaṅkāraṃ sakalabhavāmayabharāgadaṅkāram | aśaṭhāntaraṅgasevyaṃ śaṭhārimabhyemyahaṃ dṛḍhābhaktiḥ ||
analyzed: aśaṭha antaraṅga sevyam śaṭha arim abhyemi aham dṛḍhā abhaktiḥ

original: dṛḍhā bhaktiryasya saḥ dṛḍhabhaktiḥ | atra dṛḍhāśabdasya na puṃvadbhāvaḥ ‘striyāḥ puṃvat’ ityādinā puṃvadbhāvavidhau ‘apūraṇīpriyādiṣu’ iti paryudaste priyādau bhaktiśabdasya pāṭhāt | atrāpyalaṃkāraśabdena vakṣyamāṇasūcanam || 6 ||
analyzed: dṛḍhā bhaktiḥ yasya saḥ dṛḍha bhaktiḥ atra dṛḍhā śabdasya na puṃvat bhāvaḥ striyāḥ pum vat ityādinā puṃvat bhāva vidhau apūraṇī priya ādiṣu iti paryudaste priya ādau bhakti śabdasya pāṭhāt atra api alaṃkāra śabdena vakṣyamāṇa sūcanam

original: upamotprekṣāgocaramuddhṛtaviṣamapratīpadṛṣṭāntam | nāthamuniṃ kalaye’laṃ kriyāvatāṃ brahmavedināṃ mānyam || 7 ||
analyzed: upamā utprekṣā gocaram uddhṛta viṣama pratīpa dṛṣṭāntam nātha munim kalayelam kriyāvatām brahma vedinām mānyam

original: upamotprekṣāyāḥ sāmyasambhāvanāyāḥ agocaraṃ asadṛśamiti yāvat | uddhṛtāḥ nirmūlitāḥ viṣamaiḥ pratīpaiḥ pratimatakathakaiḥ dṛṣṭāḥ antāḥ niścayāḥ teṣāṃ dṛṣṭāntāśśāstrāṇi vā yena taṃ nirastasakalavimatasiddhāntamityarthaḥ | ‘anto’strī niścaye nāśe svarūpe’gre’ntike’ntare’ iti ratnamālā, ‘dṛṣṭāntāvubhe śāstranidarśane’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: upamā utprekṣāyāḥ sāmya sambhāvanāyāḥ agocaram asadṛśam iti yāvat uddhṛtāḥ nirmūlitāḥ viṣamaiḥ pratīpaiḥ pratimata kathakaiḥ dṛṣṭāḥ antāḥ niścayāḥ teṣām dṛṣṭāntāḥ śāstrāṇi vā yena tam nirasta sakala vimata siddhāntam iti arthaḥ niścaye nāśe iti ratnamālā dṛṣṭāntau ubhe śāstra nidarśane iti amaraḥ

original: pakṣe upamotprekṣe alaṅkṛtī gocarau pratipādyau yasya taṃ uddhṛtāḥ sthāpitāḥ viṣamaṃ pratīpaṃ dṛṣṭānta ityete’laṅkārā yena taṃ, alaṃ paryāptaṃ yathā syāttathā kriyāvatāṃ ananusaṃhitaphalakarmānuṣṭhānaśālināṃ ataeva brahmavedināṃ brahmavidāṃ mānyam, anena ‘kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ’ iti muṇḍakaśrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate |
analyzed: pakṣe upamā utprekṣe alaṅkṛtī gocarau pratipādyau yasya tam uddhṛtāḥ sthāpitāḥ viṣamam pratīpam dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti ete alaṅkārāḥ yena tam alam paryāptam yathā syāt tathā kriyāvatām an anusaṃhita phala karma anuṣṭhāna śālinām ataeva brahmavedinām brahma vidām mānyam anena kriyāvān eṣa brahma vidām variṣṭhaḥ iti muṇḍaka śrutiḥ pratyabhijñāpyate

original: pakṣe alaṅkriyāvatām ālaṅkārikāṇāṃ, anyatsugamam | atrāpi śleṣamahimnā vivakṣitaṃ sūcitam || 7 ||
analyzed: pakṣe alaṅkriyāvatām ālaṅkārikāṇām anyat sugamam atrā api śleṣa mahimnā vivakṣitam sūcitam

original: sādhukalitālpasārāvajñaṃ yāmunamunīndramāmanavai | chekoktiparigranthitasākṣepapratyanīkavakroktim || 8 ||
analyzed: sādhu kalita alpa sāra avajñam yāmuna muni indram āmanavai cheka ukti parigranthita sa ākṣepa pratyanīka vakra uktim

original: sādhu yathā syāttathā kalitā kṛtā alpasāreṣu aihikaphalasādhanakarmapratipādakavedapūrvabhāgeṣu avajñā tiraskāro yena taṃ ‘asāramalpasāraṃ ca sāraṃ sārataraṃ tyajet’ ityuktarītyā parityaktālpasāramityarthaḥ | anena asārarūpabāhyakudṛṣṭiśāstrāvajñānaṃ kaimutikanyāyasiddham |
analyzed: sādhu yathā syāt tathā kalitā kṛtā alpa sāreṣu aihika phala sādhana karma pratipādaka veda pūrva bhāgeṣu avajñā tiraskāraḥ yena tam asāram alpa sāram ca sāram sārataram tyajet iti ukta rītyā parityakta alpa sāram iti arthaḥ anena asāra rūpa bāhya kudṛṣṭi śāstra avajñānam kaimutika nyāya siddham

original: idaṃ āmuṣmikaphalapratipādakavedabhāgarūpasārāvajñāyāḥ ātmatatprāptisādhanamātrapratipādakāṃśalakṣaṇasāratarāvajñāyāścopalakṣaṇam | anenaiva ‘bhajetsāratamaṃ śāstre ratnākara ivāmṛtam’ ityuktarītyā paramātmatatprāptisādhanapratipādakavedapradeśarūpasāratamaniṣṭhatā cārthasiddhā |
analyzed: idam āmuṣmika phala pratipādaka veda bhāga rūpa sāra avajñāyāḥ ātma tad prāpti sādhana mātra pratipādaka aṃśa lakṣaṇa sāratara avajñāyāḥ ca upalakṣaṇam anena eva bhajet sāratamam śāstre ratnākaraḥ iva amṛtam iti ukta rītyā parama ātma tad prāpti sādhana pratipādaka veda pradeśa rūpa sāratama niṣṭha tā ca artha siddhā

original: chekāḥ vidagdhāḥ yāḥ uktayaḥ tābhiḥ parigranthitāḥ bādhitāḥ krāntā iti vā, sākṣepāḥ ākṣepasahitāḥ pratyanīkānāṃ pratimatakathakānāṃ vakroktayaḥ anṛjuvyāhārāḥ yena taṃ tathoktaṃ ‘granthitaṃ gumbhite krānte hiṃsite ca triliṅgakam’ iti medinī |
analyzed: chekāḥ vidagdhāḥ yāḥ uktayaḥ tābhiḥ parigranthitāḥ bādhitāḥ krāntāḥ iti vā sa ākṣepāḥ ākṣepa sahitāḥ pratyanīkānām pratimata kathakānām vakra uktayaḥ anṛju vyāhārāḥ yena tam tathā uktam granthitam krānte hiṃsite ca tri liṅgakam iti medinī

original: pakṣe sādhu yathā syāttathā ka litāḥ racitāḥ alpaṃ sāraḥ avajñā cetyetā alaṅkṛtayo yena taṃ, chekoktiḥ tannāmālaṅkṛtiḥ tayā parigranthite gumbhite miśrite ityarthaḥ | ākṣepeṇa tannāmnā’laṅkāreṇa saha vartete iti sākṣepe, pratyanīkaṃ ca vakroktiścetyete alaṅkṛtī yena taṃ tathoktam | yāmunamunīndraṃ āmanavai dhyāyāni |
analyzed: pakṣe sādhu yathā syāt tathā ka litāḥ racitāḥ alpam sāraḥ avajñā ca iti etāḥ alaṅkṛtayaḥ yena tam chekoktiḥ tad nāma alaṅkṛtiḥ tayā parigranthite miśrite iti arthaḥ ākṣepeṇa tad nāmnā alaṅkāreṇa saha vartete iti sa ākṣepe pratyanīkam ca vakroktiḥ ca iti ete alaṅkṛtī yena tam tathā uktam yāmuna muni indram dhyāyāni

original: manu avabodhane, loṭ, uttamaikavacanam | sūcanaṃ pūrvavat | yaścakṣuśśrutināthastrātuṃ vedānmunitvamabhipadya | śruticakṣuragragaṇyo babhūva tamimaṃ bhajeya bhāṣyakṛtam || 9 ||
analyzed: manu avabodhane loṭ uttama ekavacanam sūcanam pūrvavat yaḥ cakṣuḥ śruti nāthaḥ trātum vedān muni tvam abhipadya śruti cakṣuḥ agragaṇyaḥ babhūva tam imam bhajeya bhāṣyakṛtam

original: cakṣuśśrutināthaḥ śeṣaḥ vedān trātuṃ arthataḥ śabdataśca rakṣituṃ munitvaṃ rāmānujamunitvaṃ patañjalimunitvaṃ cābhipadya prāpya śruticakṣuṣāṃ vedavidāṃ agragaṇyo babhūva | ādau cakṣuśśrutināthaḥ munitve śruticakṣuragragaṇya ityetadeva vailakṣaṇyamiti bhāvaḥ | bhāṣyakṛtaṃ śrībhāṣyakāraṃ mahābhāṣyakāraṃ ca bhajeya || 9 ||
analyzed: cakṣuḥ śruti nāthaḥ śeṣaḥ vedān trātum arthataḥ śabdataḥ ca rakṣitum muni tvam rāmānuja muni tvam patañjali muni tvam ca abhipadya prāpya śruti cakṣuṣām vedavidām agragaṇyaḥ babhūva ādau cakṣuḥ śrutināthaḥ muni tve śruticakṣuḥ agragaṇyaḥ iti etat eva vailakṣaṇyam iti bhāvaḥ bhāṣyakṛtam śrībhāṣyakāram mahābhāṣyakāram ca bhajeya

original: smṛtisandehabhrāntimadasaṃgativikalpamīlanollāsī | vedāntadeśikamaṇirmodānvidadhātu jagadalaṅkāraḥ || 10 ||

original: smṛtiṣu mānavādidharmasaṃhitāsu sandehabhrāntimatāṃ saṃśayabhramavatāṃ kautaskutānāṃ asaṅgatayaḥ saṅgatirahitāḥ asambaddhā ityarthaḥ | ye vikalpāḥ teṣāṃ mīlane nirāse ullāsī | pakṣe smṛtyādyullāsāntāssaptālaṅkārāḥ te santyasminniti tathoktaḥ | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ sarvālaṅkāravattāyāḥ || 10 ||

analyzed: mām karṣantam hṛdayam eva ekāgārikam coram iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ ekam asahāyam agāram prayojanam asya mumuṣiṣoḥ sa aikāgārikaḥ iti vigrahaḥ tava abje padma sadṛśe pade caraṇe eva abje jala madhya sthite jaladhi madhya gate iti yāvat pade sthāne kārā āgāre iti yāvat nigalaya atra niścalīkaraṇam eva nigalavat tā saṃpādanam

analyzed: nikhila niyantaḥ iti saṃbuddhiḥ īdṛśa nigraha anugraha svatantra tā ābhiprāyikī atra api durviṣaya ādi śabdāḥ śliṣṭāḥ

analyzed: tatra hi śaurau mahānīla rūpakasya siṃha dharādhara ādau siṃhala ādi rūpakasya ca hetu hetumat bhāva sadbhāve pi āropyamāṇa mahā anile rūpaka antara praviṣṭa siṃhala ādi rūpa āropyasya anvaya virahāt na atiprasaṅgaḥ tatra śaureḥ mahā nīla tvena eva rūpaṇam na tu siṃhala ādi saṃbandhi mahānīla tvena iti

analyzed: iti prācīna lakṣaṇasya sāvayava rūpake jyotsnā bhasma churaṇa dhavalā ityādau ativyāptiḥ durvārā tatra api kāpālikī tva rūpaṇe bhasma ādi rūpaṇasya niyamena hetu tva āśrayaṇa saṃbhavāt

original: yathā hi ‘vidvanmānasahaṃsa’ ityādau rājñi haṃsatvarūpaṇaṃ vidvanmānase mānasasarastvarūpaṇamantarā nopapadyate, tathā rātryāṃ kapālikītvarūpaṇamapi jyotsnādau bhasmādirūpaṇamantarā nopapadyata iti sāmyāt |’vidvanmānasahaṃsa’ ityādāvevaikarūpakasya niyamena rūpakāntarasāpekṣatvaṃ nānyatretyasya tu śapathamātrasādhyatvāditi parāstam |
analyzed: yathā hi vidvat mānasa haṃsaḥ ityādau rājñi haṃsa tva rūpaṇam vidvat mānase mānasa saraḥ tva rūpaṇam antarā na upapadyate tathā rātryām kapālikī tva rūpaṇam api jyotsnā ādau bhasma ādi rūpaṇam antarā na upapadyate iti sāmyāt vidvat mānasa haṃsaḥ ityādau eva eka rūpakasya niyamena rūpaka antara sāpekṣa tvam na anyatra ityasya tu śapatha mātra sādhya tvāt iti parāstam

original: tādṛśalakṣaṇasyāsmadupadarśitalakṣaṇa eva paryavasānasyābhimatatvāt āropye āropyāntarānvayasthale hi ekāropa āropāntare niyamena heturbhavatīti tallakṣaṇasya tathā paryavasānaṃ saṃbhavati |
analyzed: tādṛśa lakṣaṇasya asmat upadarśita lakṣaṇe eva paryavasānasya abhimata tvāt āropye āropya antara anvaya sthale hi eka āropaḥ āropa antare niyamena hetuḥ bhavati iti tad lakṣaṇasya tathā paryavasānam saṃbhavati

original: etena ‘āropadvayamātraparyavasitaṃ paramparitaṃ sāvayavaṃ tu na tathā’ iti keṣāṃciduktiranādaraṇīyā | ‘vidvanmānasahaṃsa’ ityādau prakāśādyudāhṛte paraṃparitarūpake āropabahutvasyaiva vartamānatayā avyāptiprasaṅgāt | na cātra padye vidvanmānasahaṃsādibhāge pratyekaṃ rūpakadvayamātratvamastyeveti nāvyāptiḥ |
analyzed: etena āropa dvaya mātra paryavasitam paramparitam sāvayavam tu na tathā iti keṣāṃcid uktiḥ anādaraṇīyā vidvat mānasa haṃsaḥ ityādau prakāśa ādi udāhṛte paraṃparita rūpake āropa bahu tvasya eva vartamānatayā avyāpti prasaṅgāt na ca atra padye vidvat mānasa haṃsa ādi bhāge pratyekam rūpaka dvaya mātra tvam asti eva iti na avyāptiḥ

original: ata evaitatpadyaṃ paraṃparitarūpakabāhulyānmālārūpaparaṃparitodāharaṇatvenopāttamiti vācyam | evaṃ sati ‘jyotsnābhasma’ iti padye’pi ‘bibhratī tārakāsthīni, rātrikāpālikīyam’ ityaṃśe rūpakadvayamātratvasaṃbhavenātiprasaṅgāpātaḥ | na ca rūpakāntaranirapekṣahetuhetumadbhāvāpannarūpakadvayamātratvameva paraṃparitalakṣaṇam |
analyzed: atas eva etat padyam paraṃparita rūpaka bāhulyāt mālā rūpa paraṃparita udāharaṇa tvena upāttam iti vācyam evam sati jyotsnā bhasma iti padye api bibhratī tāraka asthīni rātri kāpālikī iyam iti aṃśe rūpaka dvaya mātra tva saṃbhavena atiprasaṅga āpātaḥ na ca rūpaka antara nirapekṣa hetu hetumat bhāva āpanna rūpaka dvaya mātra tvam eva paraṃparita lakṣaṇam

original: tathāca ‘jyotsnābhasma’ ityādau kāpālikīrūpake yathā ‘tārakāsthīni’ iti rūpakasāpekṣatvaṃ tathā ‘jyotsnābhasma’ ityādirūpakasāpekṣatvasyāpi sattvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ | ‘vidvanmānasahaṃsa’ ityādau ca haṃsādirūpake pratyekaṃ mānasarūpakādyekaikarūpakasāpekṣatvameveti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiśceti vācyam |
analyzed: tathā ca jyotsnā bhasma ityādau kāpālikī rūpake yathā tāraka asthīni iti rūpaka sāpekṣa tvam tathā jyotsnā bhasma ityādi rūpaka sāpekṣa tvasya api sattvāt na atiprasaṅgaḥ vidvat mānasa haṃsaḥ ityādau ca haṃsa ādi rūpake pratyekam mānasa rūpaka ādi eka eka rūpaka sāpekṣa tvam eva iti lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ ca iti vācyam

original: evamapi ‘amuṣminpotakṣmāramaṇasutasūrakṣitipateryaśaśśeṣe so’yaṃ svapiti gaganaśrīsahacaraḥ’ ityādau śeṣarūpakasāpekṣaśrīsahacararūpake sāvayavarūpakatvena kāvyadarpaṇodāhṛte atiprasaṅgāpātāt | na ceṣṭāpattiryujyate, ‘niyatāropaṇopāyassyādaropaḥ parasya yat’ iti paraṃparitaṃ lakṣayatāṃ kāvyaprakāśakārādīnāmanabhimatatvāt |
analyzed: evam api amuṣmin pota kṣmā ramaṇa suta sūra kṣitipateḥ yaśaḥ śeṣe saḥ ayam svapiti gagana śrī sahacaraḥ ityādau śeṣa rūpaka sāpekṣa śrī sahacara rūpake sāvayava rūpaka tvena kāvyadarpaṇa udāhṛte atiprasaṅga āpātāt na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ yujyate niyata āropaṇa upāyaḥ syāt aropaḥ parasya yat iti paraṃparitam lakṣayatām kāvyaprakāśakāra ādīnām anabhimata tvāt

original: yaśasi śeṣatvamarūpayitvā’pi ‘yaśovyāje śeṣe svapiti gaganaśrīsahacaraḥ’ iti padyapāṭhena śrīsahacararūpakopapādanasaṃbhavāttatratyarūpakayorniyatahetuhetumadbhāvāsaṃbhavāt | na caivaṃ sati niyatahetuhetumadbhāvāpannatvameva rūpakadvaye niveśya pariṣkriyatāṃ lakṣaṇamiti vācyam |

original: yadyapi ‘paryaṅko rājalakṣmyāḥ’ iti padyaṃ mālāparaṃparitodāharaṇatayopanyasya atra ‘kṣmāsauvadallaḥ’ iti paraṃparitamapyekadeśavivartīti sarvasvakāroktestādṛśaikadeśavivartiparaṃparitarūpake’vyāptiḥ | tatra kṣmāyāṃ rājapatnyāropasyārthatayā sauvidallarūpe uttararūpakāropye pūrvarūpakāropyabhūtāyā rājamahiṣyā anvayābhāvāt |

original: tathā’pi paraṃparitasyaikadeśavivartitvaṃ na sarvasvakṛto’bhimatam | svakīyaprāktanavibhāgavyāghātāt | tatra hi ‘idaṃ tu niravayavam’ ityādinā sāvayavāvāntarabhedatayaiva ekadeśavivartirūpakaṃ gaṇyate, na tu paraṃparitāvāntarabhedatayā’pīti |
analyzed: tathā api paraṃparitasya eka deśa vivarti tvam na sarva sva kṛtaḥ abhimatam svakīya prāktana vibhāga vyāghātāt tatra hi idam tu niravayavam ityādinā sa avayava avāntarabheda tayā eva eka deśa vivarti rūpakam gaṇyate na tu paraṃparita avāntarabheda tayā api iti

original: upadarśitasarvasvavākyaṃ tu atra padye ‘kṣmāsauvidallaḥ’ ityetadekadeśavivartirūpakaṃ ‘paryaṅkaḥ’ ityādiparaṃparitamālāsamānādhikaraṇamapītyetadarthakatayā kathaṃcitsaṃgamanīyam |
analyzed: upadarśita sarva sva vākyam tu atra padye kṣmāsauvidallaḥ iti etat eka deśa vivarti rūpakam paryaṅkaḥ iti ādi paraṃparita mālā samāna adhikaraṇam api iti etad arthaka tayā kathaṃcid saṃgamanīyam

original: anyathā ākṣiptarūpakasaṃpannarūpakadvayamātratayā tatra paraṃparitarūpakasvīkāre ‘nirīkṣya vidyunnayanaiḥ’ iti padye ekadeśavivartirūpakapratipādanaparasamāsoktiprakaraṇasthatadvākyavirodhaprasaṅgāt |

original: ata eva prakāśādiṣu prāktaneṣu rasagaṅgādharādiṣvarvāktaneṣu cālaṃkāranibandheṣu paraṃparitamadhye ekadeśavivartividhāyā aparigaṇanamupapadyata iti ||
analyzed: atas eva prakāśa ādiṣu prāktaneṣu rasagaṅgādhara ādiṣu arvāktaneṣu ca alaṃkāra nibandheṣu paraṃparita madhye eka deśa vivarti vidhāyāḥ a parigaṇanam upapadyate iti

original: vastutastu ‘kṣmāsauvidallaḥ’ ityatrākṣepalabhyarājamahiṣīrūpakeṇa paraṃparitarūpakābhyupagame’pi nāsmadupadarśitalakṣaṇasya tatrāvyāptiprasaṅgaḥ | ‘kṣmāsauvidallaḥ’ ityasmādapi kṣmāmahiṣīsauvidallaḥ ityevānvayabodhasyākṣepasahakṛtaśabdajanyasya svīkāreṇa prathamarūpakāropyānvitatvasya dvitīyarūpakāropye nirbādhāt |
analyzed: vastutas tu kṣmā sauvidallaḥ iti atra ākṣepa labhya rāja mahiṣī rūpakeṇa paraṃparita rūpaka abhyupagame api na asmad upadarśita lakṣaṇasya tatra avyāpti prasaṅgaḥ kṣmā sauvidallaḥ iti asmāt api kṣmā mahiṣī sauvidallaḥ iti eva anvaya bodhasya ākṣepa sahakṛta śabda janyasya svīkāreṇa prathama rūpaka āropya anvita tvasya dvitīya rūpaka āropye nirbādhāt

original: ākṣepalabhyasyāpyarthasya upāttaśabdārthena saha śābdabodhe bhānaṃ jātiśaktyādyabhyupagantṛtāntrikasamayasuprasiddhameveti ||
analyzed: ākṣepa labhyasya api arthasya upātta śabda arthena saha śābda bodhe bhānam jāti śakti ādi abhyupagantṛ tāntrika samaya su prasiddham eva iti

original: evaṃca sarvasvakārīyavibhāgavākyasyopalakṣaṇatvamavaśyāśrayaṇīyam | anyathā tena paraṃparitamātre pradarśitasya śliṣṭāśliṣṭavidhādvayasya tadvyākhyātṛvimarśinīkāreṇa sāvayave’pi pradarśanaṃ ‘kṣmāsauvidalla iti paramparitamapyekadeśavivarti |
analyzed: evam ca sarva sva kārīya vibhāga vākyasya upalakṣaṇa tvam avaśya āśrayaṇīyam anyathā tena paraṃparita mātre pradarśitasya śliṣṭa aśliṣṭa vidhā dvayasya tad vyākhyātṛ vimarśinīkāreṇa sa avayave api pradarśanam kṣmāsauvidallaḥ iti paramparitam api eka deśa vivarti

original: evamādayo’nye’pi bhedā leśatassūcitā eva’ iti sarvasvakṛta evoktiḥ, ‘evamādayaḥ’ iti pratīkamādāya ‘paraṃparitamapyekadeśavivartītyevaṃprakārāḥ’ iti vimarśinīkṛduktiśca svarasato na saṃgaccheta |

original: na saṃgacche’ta ca śliṣṭaparaṃparitanirūpaṇāvasare ‘vidvanmānasahaṃsa’ iti padyamudāhṛtya ‘idaṃ hi ekadeśavivartyapītyucyate’ iti kāvyapradīpagranthaḥ, idaṃ hīti pratīkamādāya ‘mūle idamapītyanvayaḥ | ekapadopasthāpitayorantaḥkaraṇasaroviśeṣayorabhedādhyavasāye’pi naikatrāparāropaḥ tasya bhedena viṣayanirdeśāpekṣatvāt |
analyzed: na saṃgaccheta ca śliṣṭa paraṃparita nirūpaṇa avasare vidvat mānasahaṃsaḥ iti padyam udāhṛtya idam hi eka deśa vivarti api iti ucyate iti kāvyapradīpa granthaḥ idam hi iti pratīkam ādāya mūle idam api iti anvayaḥ eka pada upasthāpitayoḥ antaḥkaraṇa saraḥ viśeṣayoḥ abheda adhyavasāye api na ekatra apara āropaḥ tasya bhedena viṣaya nirdeśa apekṣa tvāt

original: anyathā viṣayanigaraṇātmikāyāmatiśayoktāvapi tatprasaṅgāt | tasmādārtha evāyamāropa ityekadeśavirtitvamatrāpi yuktam’ iti prabhākhyatadvyākhyānaṃ ca | tasmāt atra ‘kṣmāsauvidallaḥ’ ityādisarvasvavākyaṃ yathāśrutagatyā paraṃparitasyāpyekadeśavivartitvaṃ pratyāyayatīti svīkaraṇameva samucitamityuktāvapi na kṣatiḥ ||
analyzed: anyathā viṣaya nigaraṇa ātmikāyām atiśayoktau api tad prasaṅgāt tasmāt ārthaḥ eva ayam āropaḥ iti eka deśa virti tvam atra api yuktam iti prabhā ākhya tad vyākhyānam ca tasmāt atra kṣmāsauvidallaḥ ityādi sarva sva vākyam yathāśruta gatyā paraṃparitasya api eka deśa vivarti tvam pratyāyayati iti svīkaraṇam eva samucitam iti uktau api na kṣatiḥ

original: tatra ‘kimiyaṃ gaṅgā na hareḥ’ iti prāgudāhṛte padye dhāvalyaṃ dharmiṇo bhagavanmandahasitasya koṭyorgaṅgājyotsnayoścaika evānugāmī dharmaḥ, pratīyamānatvādanirdiṣṭaḥ | evaṃ ‘jaladabhrameṇa lagnā’ ityādipadye’pi | nirdiṣṭastu ‘harito’dhyaiṣṭa giriḥ kim’ iti prāgudāhṛta eva śloke tatra mahattvaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ |

original: atra tadeti prakaraṇasāhyavaśādākāśarājagṛheṇa dharmiṇā’skṣiptāyāstatkālāvatīrṇāyāḥ bhagavatyāḥ padmāvatyā jaladhijaṭharādisaṃśayakoṭidvayākṣiptassādhāraṇo maṇiḥ pratibimbabhūtaḥ | imau ca bimbapratibimbabhāvānirdiṣṭāvapi pratīyamānau sādṛśyaṃ prayojayataḥ | etenānugāmyeva dharmo luptassambhavati na tu bimbita iti vadantaḥ parastāḥ ||

original: iti | sarvaṃ caitattadudāharaṇavivaraṇāvasare sphuṭībhaviṣyati | ‘na pañcaviśikhaḥ kāmaḥ kiṃtvalaṅkhyaśilīmukhaḥ’ ityādāvatiprasaṅgavāraṇāya pratipatterabhedaviṣayakatvaviśeṣaṇam | atra hi nāsaṅkhyaśilīmukhaśabdābhilapanīyasya kasyacidabhedasamāropaḥ kriyate tathāvidhasya kasyacidvastunaḥ kvāpyaprasiddheḥ |
analyzed: iti sarvam ca etat tad udāharaṇa vivaraṇa avasare sphuṭībhaviṣyati na pañca viśikhaḥ kāmaḥ kiṃtu alaṅkhya śilīmukhaḥ ityādau atiprasaṅga vāraṇāya pratipatteḥ abheda viṣayaka tva viśeṣaṇam atra hi na asaṅkhya śilīmukha śabda abhilapanīyasya kasyacid abheda samāropaḥ kriyate tathāvidhasya kasyacid vastunaḥ kvāpi aprasiddheḥ

original: nāpyanyatrāprasiddhasya ‘aṅkaṃ ke’pi’ ityādāviva ihaiva kalpitasya vastunastathāvidhasyābhedena samāropa iti śakyaṃ pratipattuṃ, tathākalpanāyāmiha kaverasaṃrambhāt | tasmādasaṃkhyaśilīmukhaśabdenāpi kāma eva vivakṣita iti viṣayabhūte kāme pañcaviśikhatvaṃ prasiddhaṃ pratiṣidhyāsaṃkhyaśilīmukhatvaṃ dharma eva bhedena samāropyata ityabhyupetyam |
analyzed: na api anyatra aprasiddhasya aṅkam kepi ityādau iva iha eva kalpitasya vastunaḥ tathāvidhasya abhedena samāropaḥ iti śakyam pratipattum tathā kalpanāyām iha kaveḥ asaṃrambhāt tasmāt asaṃkhya śilīmukha śabdena api kāmaḥ eva vivakṣitaḥ iti viṣaya bhūte kāme pañca viśikha tvam prasiddham pratiṣidhya asaṃkhya śilīmukha tvam dharmaḥ eva bhedena samāropyate iti abhyupetyam

original: tathāceha vivakṣitāyāḥ bhedasaṃsargakapratīterevāṅgaṃ pratiṣedho nābhedapratīterityatiprasaṅgavāraṇam | ‘nāyaṃ sudhāṃśuḥ’ ityādau tu sarvatrāpahnavodāharaṇe vyomagaṅgāsaroruhāderdharmiṇa eva tattaddharmaviśiṣṭatayā’nyatra prasiddhasya kavikalpitasya vā viṣaye abhedena pratītirvivakṣiteti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca iha vivakṣitāyāḥ bheda saṃsargaka pratīteḥ eva aṅgam pratiṣedhaḥ na abheda pratīteḥ iti atiprasaṅga vāraṇam na ayam sudhāṃśuḥ ityādau tu sarvatra apahnava udāharaṇe vyoma gaṅgā saroruha ādeḥ dharmiṇaḥ eva tad tad dharma viśiṣṭatayā anyatra prasiddhasya kavi kalpitasya vā viṣaye abhedena pratītiḥ vivakṣitā iti lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ

original: ‘apahnutirapahnutya kiṃcidanyārtharopaṇam’ iti pratipatterabhedaviṣayakatvamanādṛtya kevalāpahnutipūrvakānyārthāropasyaivāpahnutitvaṃ lakṣayato daṇḍino mate tūdāhṛte ‘na pañcaviśikhaḥ’ ityatrāpi naivātiprasaṃgaḥ ||

original: saṃgrāmāṅgaṇasaṃmukhāgatakiyadviśvaṃbharādhīśvaravyādīrṇīkṛtamadhyabhāgavivaronmīlannabhonīlimā |

original: aṅgāraprakharaiḥ karaiḥ kabalayan sadyo jaganmaṇḍalaṃ mārtaṇḍo’yamudeti kena paśunā loke śaśāṅkīkṛtaḥ ||

original: ityādau virahijanavākye nāyaṃ śaśāṅkaḥ apitu sacchidramārtaṇḍa iti pratīyamāne’rthe śaśāṅkaniṣedho mārtaṇḍābhedapratipatterevāṅgamiti tatrātivyāptivāraṇāyābhedapratipatterāhāryeti viśeṣaṇaṃ, atra ca mārtaṇḍāropasya doṣaviśeṣajanyatayā’nāhāryatvāt |
analyzed: ityādau virahi jana vākye na ayam śaśāṅkaḥ apitu sa chidra mārtaṇḍaḥ iti pratīyamāna irthe śaśāṅka niṣedhaḥ mārtaṇḍa abheda pratipatteḥ eva aṅgam iti tatra ativyāpti vāraṇāya abheda pratipatteḥ āhārya iti viśeṣaṇam atra ca mārtaṇḍa āropasya doṣa viśeṣa janya tayā anāhārya tvāt

original: ata eva ‘atra chāyāmātramapahnuteḥ na tvapahnutyalaṃkāraḥ tajjñānasya doṣaviśeṣajanyatvenānāhāryatvāt, kiṃtu ‘bhrāntyalaṃkāraeva’ iti rasagaṅgādharakṛduktissaṃgacchate | asya ca virahijanavacanatāviraheṇa kevalakavimativikāsajanyatve tu bhavatyevedamapi śuddhāpahnuterudāharaṇamiti rahasyam |
analyzed: atas eva atra chāyā mātram apahnuteḥ na tu apahnuti alaṃkāraḥ tad jñānasya doṣa viśeṣa janya tvena anāhārya tvāt kiṃtu bhrānti alaṃkāraḥ eva iti rasagaṅgādhara kṛt uktiḥ saṃgacchate asya ca virahi jana vacanatā viraheṇa kevala kavi mati vikāsa janya tve tu bhavati eva idam api śuddha apahnuteḥ udāharaṇam iti rahasyam

original: ata eva ‘nendustīvro na niśyarkassindhoraurvo’yamutthitaḥ’ ityasya hetvapahnuterudāharaṇatvaṃ ca saṃgacchate | anyathā’syāpi virahijanavacanatābhisaṃdhau alakṣyatāpātātprāktanaiḥ kṛtasya tadudāharaṇasyāsaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva ||
analyzed: atas eva na induḥ tīvraḥ na niśi arkaḥ sindhoḥ aurvaḥ yaḥ utthitaḥ iti asya hetu apahnuteḥ udāharaṇa tvam ca saṃgacchate anyathā asya api virahi jana vacana tā abhisaṃdhau alakṣya tā āpātāt prāktanaiḥ kṛtasya tad udāharaṇasya asaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭā eva

original: na caivamapi sāmānyalakṣaṇe’sminnāhāryaviśeṣaṇopādānaṃ na yujyate, bhrāntāpahnutāvavyāptiprasaṃgāt | tatra hi ‘tāpaṃ karoti sotkampaṃ jvaraḥ kiṃ na sakhi smaraḥ’ ityādau tātvikasmarābhedapratīterāhāryatvavirahāditi vācyaṃ, āhāryatvasyānāhāryatvabhramatvobhayābhāvaparyavasitasyaiva niveśanīyatayā sakaladoṣanivāraṇāt |

analyzed: bhrānta apahnutau hi abheda pratipatteḥ anāhārya tve pi bhrama tva abhāvena eva eka sattve dvayam na asti iti nyāyena ubhaya abhāva viśeṣaṇa mahimnā lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ itareṣu apahnuti prabhedeṣu tu abheda pratipatteḥ bhrama tve pi anāhārya tva viraheṇa eva ubhaya abhāvaḥ sūpapādaḥ iti tatra api syāt eva lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ

original: nadīna iti naśabdena samāsa | adīnaḥ netyanvayaḥ, kiṃtu dīna evetyarthaḥ | nadīnāṃ ina iti vastusthitiḥ | bhagavadāśrita eva nadīnaḥ adīnaḥ | saḥ apāṃ nidhiḥ sarvatomukhabhaṅgāt viśvatomukhātparājayāt, pakṣe jalataraṅgāt, bhaṅgaṃ parājayaṃ ‘bhaṅgo jayaviparyaye | bhedarogataraṅgeṣu’ iti medinī |
analyzed: nadīnaḥ iti na śabdena samāsaḥ adīnaḥ na iti anvayaḥ kiṃtu dīnaḥ eva iti arthaḥ nadīnām inaḥ iti vastu sthitiḥ bhagavat āśritaḥ eva nadīnaḥ adīnaḥ saḥ apām nidhiḥ sarvatomukha bhaṅgāt viśvatomukhāt parājayāt pakṣe jala taraṅgāt bhaṅgam parājayam bhaṅgaḥ jaya viparyaye bheda roga taraṅgeṣu iti medinī

original: atra ‘yadiha parastāt’ iti prāthamikodāharaṇe rajasaḥ parasmin sthāne paramapadatvanihnavo varṇanīye śeṣādrau tadāropārthaḥ | anyeṣu triṣu siṃhaletyādiṣu mahānīlamaṇitvādyapahnavaḥ prastute bhagavati tadāropārthaḥ prathamodāharaṇe nihnave heturnoktaḥ dvitīyādiṣu heturuktaḥ |
analyzed: atra yat iha parastāt iti prāthamika udāharaṇe rajasaḥ parasmin sthāne parama pada tva nihnavaḥ varṇanīye śeṣa adrau tad āropa arthaḥ anyeṣu triṣu siṃhala ityādiṣu mahā nīla maṇi tva ādi apahnavaḥ prastute bhagavati tad āropa arthaḥ prathama udāharaṇe nihnave hetuḥ na uktaḥ dvitīya ādiṣu hetuḥ uktaḥ

original: tatrāpi siṃhaletidvitīyapadye śuddhaḥ, tṛtīyacaturthapadyayośśleṣasaṃkīrṇaḥ | pañcame ‘nāpāṃnidhiḥ’ itipadye samudre nadīnatvanihnavo bhagavadāśriteṣu prakṛteṣu tatsamāropārthaḥ | hetūktyādikaṃ tu pūrvavadeva | tataśca śuddhāpahṛutivadatrāpi dvaividhyamanusandheyam | ayamapahnutibhedaḥ kuvalayānandānurodhenoktaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api siṃhala iti dvitīya padye śuddhaḥ tṛtīya caturtha padyayoḥ śleṣa saṃkīrṇaḥ pañcame na apāṃnidhiḥ iti padye samudre nadīnatva nihnavaḥ bhagavat āśriteṣu prakṛteṣu tad samāropa arthaḥ hetu ukti ādikam tu pūrvavat eva tatas ca śuddha apahṛuti vat atra api dvaividhyam anusandheyam ayam apahnuti bhedaḥ kuvalayānanda anurodhena uktaḥ

original: rasagaṅgādhare tu “anyatra tasyāropārthaḥ paryastāpahnutiśca saḥ’ ityetadupādāya ‘nāyamapahnuterbhedo vaktuṃ yuktaḥ apahnutisāmānyalakṣaṇānākrāntatvāt | tathā hi ‘prakṛtaṃ yanniṣidhyānyatsādhyate sā tvapahnutiḥ’ upa meyamasatyaṃ kṛtvā upamāne satyatayā yat sthāpyate sā’pahnutiḥ’ iti kāvyaprakāśoktalakṣaṇabahirbhāvastāvat sphuṭa eva |
analyzed: rasagaṅgādhare tu anyatra tasya āropa arthaḥ paryasta apahnutiḥ ca saḥ iti etat upādāya na ayam apahnuteḥ bhedaḥ vaktum yuktaḥ apahnuti sāmānya lakṣaṇa an ākrānta tvāt tathā hi prakṛtam yat niṣidhya anyat sādhyate sā tu apahnutiḥ upa meyam asatyam kṛtvā upamāne satya tayā yat sthāpyate sā apahnutiḥ iti kāvyaprakāśa ukta lakṣaṇa bahirbhāvaḥ tāvat sphuṭaḥ eva

original: evaṃ ‘viṣayāpahnave vastvantarapratītāvapahnutiḥ’ ityalaṃkārasarvasvoktalakṣaṇamapi nātra pravartate ||
analyzed: evam viṣaya apahnave vastu antara pratītau apahnutiḥ iti alaṃkāra sarvasva ukta lakṣaṇam api na atra pravartate

original: prakṛtasya niṣedhena yadanyatvaprakalpanam |
analyzed: prakṛtasya niṣedhena yat anya tva prakalpanam

original: sāmyādapahnutirvākyabhedābhedavatī dvidhā ||
analyzed: sāmyāt apahnutiḥ vākya bheda abhedavatī dvidhā

original: iti citramīmāṃsāgataṃ lakṣaṇamapi tathaiva | tasmāt ‘nāyaṃ sudhāṃśuḥ kiṃ tarhi sudhāṃśuḥ preyasīmukham’ ityatra dṛḍhāropaṃ rūpakameva bhavitumarhati nāpahnutiḥ | upameyatopamānatāvacchedakayossāmānādhikaraṇyasya niṣpratyūhaṃ bhānāt |
analyzed: iti citra mīmāṃsā gatam lakṣaṇam api tathā eva tasmāt na ayam sudhāṃśuḥ kim tarhi sudhāṃśuḥ preyasī mukham iti atra dṛḍha āropam rūpakam eva bhavitum arhati na apahnutiḥ upameya tā upamāna tā avacchedakayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya niṣpratyūham bhānāt

original: taduktaṃ vimarśinyām ‘na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhurbrahmasvaṃ viṣamucyate’ atra viṣasya niṣedhapūrvakaṃ brahmasve āropyamāṇatvāt dṛḍhāropaṃ rūpakameva nāpahnutiriti” iti ||
analyzed: tat uktam vimarśinyām na viṣam viṣam iti āhuḥ brahma svam viṣam ucyate atra viṣasya niṣedha pūrvakam brahma sve āropyamāṇa tvāt dṛḍha āropam rūpakam eva na apahnutiḥ iti iti

original: tarhi dīkṣitānāṃ kathamidaṃ parasparavipratiṣiddhavāditvamiticecchṛṇu citramīmāṃsālakṣaṇaṃ prācāmanurodhena, idaṃ tu ratnākarādyanurodheneti na virodhaḥ ||
analyzed: tarhi dīkṣitānām katham idam paraspara vipratiṣiddha vādi tvam iti ced śṛṇu citra mīmāṃsā lakṣaṇam prācām anurodhena idam tu ratnākara ādi anurodhena iti na virodhaḥ

original: atha bhrāntyapahnutiḥ
analyzed: atha bhrānti apahnutiḥ

original: bhrānternivāraṇe’nyasya śaṅkāyāṃ bhrāntyapahnutiḥ ||
analyzed: śaṅkāyām bhrānti apahnutiḥ

original: anyasya bhrānternivāraṇe tattvākhyāne sati bhrāntyapahnutiḥ | imāṃ bhrāntāpahnutirityapyāhuḥ | tadā bhrāntamiti bhāve ktaḥ | tasyāpahnutiḥ | evaṃ ca tattvakathanahetukabhrāntiviṣayaniṣedho bhrāntyapahnutiriti lakṣaṇaṃ bodhyam || yathā
analyzed: anyasya bhrānteḥ nivāraṇe tattva ākhyāne sati bhrānti apahnutiḥ imām bhrānta apahnutiḥ iti api āhuḥ tadā bhrāntam iti bhāve ktaḥ tasya apahnutiḥ evam ca tattva kathana hetuka bhrānti viṣaya niṣedhaḥ bhrānti apahnutiḥ iti lakṣaṇam bodhyam yathā

original: śiśirayate mama hṛdayaṃ kiṃ ghanasāro’tha gandhasāro vā | na hi na hi sapadi smṛtipathamahigirinetā sakhe samānītaḥ || 348 ||
analyzed: śiśirayate mama hṛdayam kim ghanasāraḥ utha gandhasāraḥ vā na hi na hi sapadi smṛtipatham ahi giri netā sakhe samānītaḥ

original: atra śiśirayate mama hṛdayamiti bhagavadvṛttānte gadite tasya hṛdayaśabdapratipādyacittavakṣorūpārthadvayaśleṣamūlakābhedādhyavasāyena ghanasārādisādhāraṇyātkevalabāhyaviṣayapravaṇena kenacitsakhyā kiṃ ghanasāro’tha gandhasāro vetyanuyukte nahinahītyādinā bhrāntivāraṇaṃ kṛtam | idaṃ saṃbhavadbhrāntipūrvikāyāṃ bhrāntāpahnutāvudāharaṇam ||
analyzed: atra śiśirayate mama hṛdayam iti bhagavat vṛttānte gadite tasya hṛdaya śabda pratipādya citta vakṣaḥ rūpa artha dvaya śleṣa mūlaka abheda adhyavasāyena ghanasāra ādi sādhāraṇyāt kevala bāhya viṣaya pravaṇena kenacid sakhyā kim ghanasāraḥ utha gandhasāraḥ vā iti anuyukte nahi nahi ityādinā bhrānti vāraṇam kṛtam idam saṃbhavat bhrānti pūrvikāyām bhrānta apahnutau udāharaṇam

original: kalpitabhrāntipūrvā yathā

original: sīmantaḥ keśavīdhī ‘sīmantamastriyāṃ strīṇāṃ keśamadhyastha paddhatiḥ’ iti vaijayantī | śailadhṛtau govardhanadhāraṇe, ata eva kṛṣṇeti saṃbodhanam | śailatvenādhyavasitastanagrahaṇe ca | atra kalpitā bhrāntiḥ na ghanatatirityādiniṣedhamātronneyā pūrvavatpraśnavaidhuryāt | daṇḍī tu īdṛśasthale tattvākhyānopametyupamābhedamamanyata | yadāha
analyzed: sīmantaḥ keśa vīdhī sīmantam astriyām strīṇām keśa madhya stha paddhatiḥ iti vaijayantī śaila dhṛtau govardhana dhāraṇe atas eva kṛṣṇā iti saṃbodhanam śaila tvena adhyavasita stana grahaṇe ca atra kalpitā bhrāntiḥ na ghana tatiḥ ityādi niṣedha mātra unneyā pūrvavat praśna vaidhuryāt daṇḍī tu īdṛśa sthale tattva ākhyāna upamā iti upamā bhedam amanyata yat āha

analyzed: iti vastutas tu atra upamā bodhakasya iva ādeḥ abhāvāt upamā prabhedaḥ na yuktaḥ tad abhāve pi upamā abhyupagame rūpakasya api upamā tva āpatteḥ

original: haṃsasandeśarasāsvādinyāṃ ‘dattanispandadṛṣṭiḥ’ ityasya vyākhyānāvasare nirūpitamasmābhiḥ ||
analyzed: haṃsasandeśa rasa āsvādinyām datta nispanda dṛṣṭiḥ iti asya vyākhyāna avasare nirūpitam asmābhiḥ

original: evamupāttajātiguṇadravyarūpanimittāḥ anupāttanimittāśca kriyā’bhāvasvarūpotprekṣā apyudāhāryāḥ ||
analyzed: evam upātta jāti guṇa dravya rūpa nimittāḥ anupātta nimittāḥ ca kriyā bhāva svarūpa utprekṣāḥ api udāhāryāḥ

original: dravyābhāvasvarūpotprekṣā yathā
analyzed: dravya abhāva svarūpa utprekṣā yathā

original: viśadayatā’khilabhuvanaṃ yaśasā bhujageśaśikhariśekhara te | aśaśāṅkamivākāśaṃ na kalaṅkī bhāti bhātyapakalaṅke || 426 ||
analyzed: viśadayatā akhila bhuvanam yaśasā bhujaga īśa śikhari śekhara te a śaśāṅkam iva ākāśam na kalaṅkī bhāti bhāti apakalaṅke

original: apakalaṅke niṣkalaṅke bhāti sati kalaṅkī na bhātīti yojanā | atrāśaśāṅkamiti dravyābhāvotprekṣāyāṃ yaśaseti jātirnimittamupāttam | yaśaso guṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ iyamupāttaguṇanimitteti dhyeyam ||
analyzed: apakalaṅke niṣkalaṅke bhāti sati kalaṅkī na bhāti iti yojanā atra aśaśāṅkam iti dravya abhāva utprekṣāyām yaśasā iti jātiḥ nimittam upāttam yaśasaḥ guṇa tva vivakṣāyām iyam upātta guṇa nimittā iti dhyeyam

original: yathā vā
analyzed: yathā vā

original: satyajñānānande nityaṃ vṛṣaśailaśikharato’spande | pariramati ramāvāse paramapadaṃ bhavati nūnamabrahma ||
analyzed: satya jñāna ānande nityam vṛṣa śaila śikhara tospande pariramati ramā vāse parama padam bhavati nūnam abrahma

original: atra paramapade abrahmatvamutprekṣyata iti dravyābhāvasvarūpotprekṣeyaṃ vṛṣaśailādhikaraṇakapariramaṇakriyārūpanimittopādānādupāttanimittā | brahma dravyaṃ ekatvāt | vṛṣaśailaśikharataḥ aspande akṛtakiñciccalane pariramati parito viharati sati | ‘vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ’ iti parasmaipadam ||
analyzed: atra parama pade abrahma tvam utprekṣyate iti dravya abhāva svarūpa utprekṣā iyam vṛṣa śaila adhikaraṇaka pariramaṇa kriyā rūpa nimitta upādānāt upātta nimittā brahma dravyam ekatvāt vṛṣa śaila śikharataḥ aspande akṛta kiñcid calane pariramati paritas viharati sati ramaḥ iti parasmaipadam

original: yathā vā
analyzed: yathā vā

original: tāvakamahasevanamiladanavadhijanacaraṇahatijareṇunibhāt | dharayordhvaṃ visṛmarayā vigaganamiva khagagirīśa jagadāsīt || 428 ||
analyzed: tāvaka maha sevana milat anavadhi jana caraṇa hati ja reṇu nibhāt dharayā ūrdhvam visṛmarayā vigaganam iva khaga giri īśa jagat āsīt

original: mahaḥ utsavaḥ ‘maha uddhava utsavaḥ’ ityamaraḥ | adanto’yam | reṇunibhāt parāgavyājāt | khagagiririti śeṣādrereva nāmāntaram | atra vigaganamiti dravyābhāvotprekṣāyāṃ reṇuvyājenotsṛtvarī bhūmirdravyaṃ nimittamupāttam ||
analyzed: mahaḥ utsavaḥ mahaḥ uddhavaḥ utsavaḥ iti amaraḥ reṇu nibhāt parāga vyājāt khagagiriḥ iti śeṣa adreḥ eva nāma antaram atra vigaganam iti dravya abhāva utprekṣāyām reṇu vyājena utsṛtvarī bhūmiḥ dravyam nimittam upāttam

original: eṣā mālārūpā’pi saṃbhavati, yathā
analyzed: eṣā mālā rūpā api saṃbhavati yathā

original: marakatamaṇiriva vicaran karacaraṇamanoharo’mburāśiriva | sphuradaṅga ivānaṅgo vrajabhuvi vijahāra yadukulakumāraḥ || 429 ||
analyzed: marakata maṇiḥ iva vicaran kara caraṇa manohara umburāśiḥ iva sphurat aṅgaḥ iva anaṅgaḥ vraja bhuvi vijahāra yadu kula kumāraḥ

original: atra bhagavadgatānāṃ saṃcāritvādīnāṃ marakatāditādātmyavirodhināṃ virodhopaśamāya viṣayiṣu marakatādiṣvāropeṇa sādhāraṇīkaraṇam | na cehopamā śakyā nirūpayitum, vicarattvādīnāmukternaiṣphalyāpatteḥ |
analyzed: atra bhagavat gatānām saṃcāri tva ādīnām marakata ādi tādātmya virodhinām virodha upaśamāya viṣayiṣu marakata ādiṣu āropeṇa sādhāraṇīkaraṇam na ca iha upamā śakyā nirūpayitum vicarat tva ādīnām ukteḥ naiṣphalya āpatteḥ

original: na copamāniṣpādakaṃ teṣāṃ sādhāraṇyaṃ tadabhāve’pi nailyādibhirdharmaiḥ pratīyamānaistasyā niṣpatteracārutvādupamāniṣpādakatvena kaveravivakṣitatvācca | na hyatra vicarattvādibhirdharmairmarakatādisādṛśyaṃ bhagavataḥ kavisaṃrambhaviṣayaḥ | evaṃ vicarattvādīnāṃ marakatādiṣvāropo’pi satyāmupamāyāṃ niṣprayojana eva bhavet |
analyzed: na ca upamā niṣpādakam teṣām sādhāraṇyam tad abhāve api nailya ādibhiḥ dharmaiḥ pratīyamānaiḥ tasyāḥ niṣpatteḥ acāru tvāt upamā niṣpādaka tvena kaveḥ avivakṣita tvāt ca na hi atra vicarat tva ādibhiḥ dharmaiḥ marakata ādi sādṛśyam bhagavataḥ kavi saṃrambha viṣayaḥ evam vicarat tva ādīnām marakata ādiṣu āropaḥ api satyām upamāyām niṣprayojanaḥ eva bhavet

original: abhedapratipattau tu avicaratā akaracaraṇenānaṅgena ca tena tena kathamasyābhedassaṃbhavediti pratikūlamatimapanetuṃ viṣayigatānāṃ vicarattvādyāropāṇāmastyevopayogaḥ | atraiva ivaśabdasyābhāve dṛḍhāropaṃ rūpakam | viṣayigataviśeṣaṇānāmabhāve upamā | ivaśabdaviśeṣaṇayorekatarasyāpyabhāve śuddharūpakamiti vivekaḥ ||
analyzed: abheda pratipattau tu a vicaratā a kara caraṇena anaṅgena ca tena tena katham asya abhedaḥ saṃbhavet iti pratikūla matim apanetum viṣayi gatānām vicarat tva ādi āropāṇām asti eva upayogaḥ atra eva iva śabdasya abhāve dṛḍha āropam rūpakam viṣayi gata viśeṣaṇānām abhāve upamā iva śabda viśeṣaṇayoḥ ekatarasya api abhāve śuddha rūpakam iti vivekaḥ

original: evaṃ jātyādibhāvābhāvasvarūpotprekṣāḥ diṅmātreṇodāhṛtāḥ | atha hetūtprekṣā | tatra jātibhāve hetūtprekṣā yathā
analyzed: evam jāti ādi bhāva abhāva svarūpa utprekṣāḥ diś mātreṇa udāhṛtāḥ atha hetu utprekṣā tatra jāti bhāve hetu utprekṣā yathā

original: vṛṣagirineturmaṇimayasaudhenevorasā’bdhirājasutā | vismāritā nivāsaṃ makarandaparāgapaṅkile kamale || 430 ||
analyzed: vṛṣagiri netuḥ maṇi maya saudhena iva urasā abdhirāja sutā vismāritā nivāsam makaranda parāga paṅkile kamale

original: atra saudheneti jātiḥ kamalanivāsavismaraṇaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyate tadevotprekṣyamāṇahetornimittamityupāttaguṇanimittā jātibhāvahetūtprekṣā | hetuphalayorutprekṣāviṣayatve nimittasyopādānameva, na tvanupādānam | tathāhi sādhye anupātte sādhanatvena nirdeśo nānvayaṃ puṣṇāti tathā sādhane anupātte sādhyatvena nirdeśo’pi |
analyzed: atra saudhena iti jātiḥ kamala nivāsa vismaraṇam prati hetu tvena utprekṣyate tat eva utprekṣyamāṇa hetoḥ nimittam iti upātta guṇa nimittā jāti bhāva hetu utprekṣā hetu phalayoḥ utprekṣā viṣaya tve nimittasya upādānam eva na tu anupādānam tathā hi sādhye anupātte sādhana tvena nirdeśaḥ na anvayam puṣṇāti tathā sādhane anupātte sādhya tvena nirdeśaḥ upi

original: tayoritaretarasāpekṣatvāt hetūtprekṣāyāṃ hi nimittaṃ phalam | tasyānupādāne kaṃ prati hetutā saṃgacchatām | phalotprekṣāyāṃ hi sādhanaṃ nimittam, tasminnanupātte kaṃ prati phalatvaṃ saṃghaṭatām | evaṃ ca nimittanaimitikayoranyataropādāne’nvayaparipoṣavirahādubhayopādānaniyame nimittopādānaṃ niyatamevetyavadheyam |
analyzed: tayoḥ itaretara sāpekṣa tvāt hetu utprekṣāyām hi nimittam phalam tasya anupādāne kam prati hetu tā saṃgacchatām phala utprekṣāyām hi sādhanam nimittam tasmin anupātte kam prati phala tvam saṃghaṭatām evam ca nimitta naimitikayoḥ anyatara upādāna anvaya paripoṣa virahāt ubhaya upādāna niyame nimitta upādānam niyatam eva iti avadheyam

original: tathāca udāhṛte’sminpadye utprekṣāyā nimittasya kamalanivāsavismāraṇasyānupādāne saudheneti hetūtprekṣā na śobhate | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaphalotprekṣāyāmapyūhyam | tasmāt svarūpotprekṣāyāmeva nimittasyopādānānupādane | na tu hetuphalotprekṣayoriti draṣṭavyam ||
analyzed: tathā ca udāhṛte smin padye utprekṣāyāḥ nimittasya kamala nivāsa vismāraṇasya anupādāne saudhena iti hetu utprekṣā na śobhate evam vakṣyamāṇa phala utprekṣāyām api ūhyam tasmāt svarūpa utprekṣāyām eva nimittasya upādāna anupādane na tu hetu phala utprekṣayoḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: guṇahetūtprekṣā yathā
analyzed: guṇa hetu utprekṣā yathā

original: acchāccharucirayaṃ mama sacchātra iti pramodato nūnam | svābhimukhe deve’nupraviśati kaustubhamaṇiṃ sahasrāṃśuḥ || 431 ||
analyzed: accha accha ruciḥ ayam mama sat chātraḥ iti pramodataḥ nūnam sva abhimukhe kaustubha maṇim sahasrāṃśuḥ

original: acchāccharuciḥ atisvacchadyutitvāt akuṭilaprītitvāccetyarthaḥ | hetugarbhaviśeṣaṇam | ayaṃ kaustubhamaṇiḥ mama sacchātraḥ iti pramodato nūnaṃ deve śrīnivāse svābhimukhe sati sahasrāṃśuḥ kaustubhamaṇiṃ anupraviśati yogakṣemādau tadaikarasyaṃ bhajatīti bhāvaḥ | tatra pratibimbito bhavatīti vāstavārthaḥ |
analyzed: accha accha ruciḥ ati svaccha dyuti tvāt akuṭila prīti tvāt ca iti arthaḥ hetu garbha viśeṣaṇam ayam kaustubha maṇiḥ mama sat chātraḥ iti pramodataḥ nūnam deve śrīnivāse sva abhimukhe sati sahasrāṃśuḥ kaustubha maṇim anupraviśati yogakṣema ādau tad aikarasyam bhajati iti bhāvaḥ tatra pratibimbitaḥ bhavati iti vāstava arthaḥ

original: bhagavata ābhimukhye satyeva tadvakṣassthite kaustubhe sahasrāṃśupratiphalanasaṃbhavātsvābhimukhe ityuktiḥ | atra sacchātratāhetukapramodo guṇaḥ kaustubhānupraveśaṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyate | sa evānupraveśo nimittamupāttam ||
analyzed: bhagavataḥ ābhimukhye sati eva tad vakṣaḥ sthite kaustubhe sahasrāṃśu pratiphalana saṃbhavāt sva abhimukhe iti uktiḥ atra sat chātra tā hetuka pramodaḥ guṇaḥ kaustubha anupraveśam prati hetu tvena utprekṣyate saḥ eva anupraveśaḥ nimittam upāttam

original: kriyāhetūtprekṣā yathā
analyzed: kriyā hetu utprekṣā yathā

original: harimukharākācandrālokāniśasevanādiva ramāyāḥ | nayanendīvarayugalaṃ nityotphullaṃ nimīlanājñamabhūt || 432 ||
analyzed: hari mukha rākā candra āloka aniśa sevanāt iva ramāyāḥ nayana indīvara yugalam nitya utphullam nimīlana ājñam abhūt

original: atra secanāditi kriyā nityotphullatāṃ prati hetutayotprekṣyate saivotphullatā nimittam || yathāvā
analyzed: atra secanāt iti kriyā nitya utphulla tām prati hetutayā utprekṣyate sā eva utphulla tā nimittam yathāvā

original: svāmiṃstvanmukhahimarucidhāmakṛtātparibhavādiva nitāntam | jīvanabhaṅgavilolā kamalālī vahati kiṃ nu sā’rasatām || 433 ||
analyzed: svāmin tvad mukha hima ruci dhāma kṛtāt paribhavāt iva nitāntam jīvana bhaṅga vilolā kamala ālī vahati kim nu sārasa tām

original: he svāmin ! tvanmukhameva himaruciḥ ātmapratyanīkaścandramāḥ kamalālīdhvaṃsanopakaraṇavattvadyotanāya himaruciśabdaḥ | tasya dhāmnā tejasā prabhāveṇa ca ‘gṛhadehatviṭprabhāvā dhāmāni’ iyamaraḥ | kṛtāt paribhavādiva sā’rasatāmityatra sā arasatāmiti chedaḥ, sā atiramaṇīyatayā prasiddhā kamalālī padmapaṅktiḥ |
analyzed: he svāmin tvad mukham eva himaruciḥ ātma pratyanīkaḥ candramāḥ kamala ālī dhvaṃsana upakaraṇavat tva dyotanāya himaruci śabdaḥ tasya dhāmnā tejasā prabhāveṇa ca gṛha deha tviṣ prabhāvā dhāmāni iyam araḥ kṛtāt paribhavāt iva sārasa tām iti atra sā arasa tām iti chedaḥ sā ati ramaṇīya tayā prasiddhā kamala ālī padma paṅktiḥ

original: jīvanasya jīvitasya bhaṅge vilolā viśeṣeṇa saktā ‘satāṃ mlāne māne’ ityādyuktarītyā jīvitaparityajanakṛtasaṃkalpetyarthaḥ | pakṣe jīvanasya salilasya bhaṅgaistaraṅgaiḥ vilolā cañcalā `lolaścalasatṛṣṇayoḥ’ ityamaraḥ | arasatāṃ sarvaviṣayavairasyaṃ vahati | paraparibhavadūnānāṃ jīvitatyajanadattadṛṣṭīnāṃ sarvatrānāsthaiva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jīvanasya jīvitasya bhaṅge vilolā viśeṣeṇa saktā satām mlāne māne ityādi ukta rītyā jīvita parityajana kṛta saṃkalpā iti arthaḥ pakṣe jīvanasya salilasya bhaṅgaiḥ taraṅgaiḥ vilolā cañcalā lolaḥ cala sa tṛṣṇayoḥ iti amaraḥ arasatām sarva viṣaya vairasyam vahati para paribhava dūnānām jīvita tyajana datta dṛṣṭīnām sarvatra anāsthā eva bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyatra sārasatāmiti samastaṃ padam | sarojatāmiti vāstavārthaḥ | atra paribhavarūpā kriyā arasatāvahanaṃ prati hetutvena saṃbhāvyate | tadeva tatra nimittam | iyaṃ śleṣasaṃkīrṇā ||
analyzed: anyatra sārasa tām iti samastam padam saroja tām iti vāstava arthaḥ atra paribhava rūpā kriyā arasa tā vahanam prati hetu tvena saṃbhāvyate tat eva tatra nimittam iyam śleṣa saṃkīrṇā

original: dravyahetūtprekṣā yathā
analyzed: dravya hetu utprekṣā yathā

original: balavānapi bahupādo’pyalamahibhūbhṛnmahāgatāḍhyopi | neṣṭe padamapi calituṃ svasminviśvaṃbhareṇa kila vasatā || 434 || balavān sāmarthyavānapi | pakṣe sthaulyavānapi ‘sthaulyasāmarthyasainyeṣu balam’ ityamaraḥ | balasattve’pi karaṇavirahe kathaṃ gamanasaṃbhava ityata āha bahviti | bahupādo’pi bahucaraṇopi | pakṣe bahupratyantaparvatopi |
analyzed: balavān api bahu pādaḥ upi alam ahi bhūbhṛt mahā gata āḍhyaḥ api na iṣṭe padam api calitum svasmin viśvaṃbhareṇa kila vasatā balavān sāmarthyavān api pakṣe sthaulyavān api sthaulya sāmarthya sainyeṣu balam iti amaraḥ bala sattve api karaṇa virahe katham gamana saṃbhavaḥ iti atas āha bahu iti bahu pādaḥ upi bahu caraṇaḥ upi pakṣe bahu pratyanta parvataḥ upi

original: ata eva mahat ślāghyaṃ gataṃ gamanaṃ, bhāve ktaḥ | tena āḍhyopi | pakṣe mahāntaḥ agāḥ taravaḥ yasmiṃstathoktaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ mahāgatā tayā āḍhyopi | ahibhūbhṛt śeṣādriḥ śeṣa ityapi gamyate | svasmin vasatā viśvaṃbhareṇeva padamapi calituṃ neṣṭe na śaknoti |
analyzed: atas eva mahat ślāghyam gatam gamanam bhāve ktaḥ tena āḍhyaḥ upi pakṣe mahāntaḥ agāḥ taravaḥ yasmin tathā uktaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ mahāgatā tayā āḍhyaḥ upi ahi bhūbhṛt śeṣa adriḥ śeṣaḥ iti api gamyate svasmin vasatā viśvaṃbhareṇa iva padam api calitum na iṣṭe na śaknoti

original: atra svasminnavasthito viśvaṃbharo dravyaṃ ahibhūbhṛto niścalatāṃ prati hetutvenotprekṣyate | sā niścalataiva nimittamupāttam ||
analyzed: atra svasmin avasthitaḥ viśvaṃbharaḥ dravyam ahi bhūbhṛtaḥ niścala tām prati hetu tvena utprekṣyate sā niścala tā eva nimittam upāttam

original: yathāvā
analyzed: yathā vā

original: nirmaladṛṣṭiprasaraṇanirodhanirmāṇanipuṇanijamahimā | candrādaparasmādiva sāndrā śaurestamastatirgalati || 435 ||

analyzed: he ghana nīla megha śyāmala pakṣe ghanaḥ nīlaḥ nidhi viśeṣaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tasya saṃbuddhiḥ he mukunda mukti dāyin pṛṣodara ādi tvāt sādhuḥ pakṣe he mukunda nidhe tava padam caraṇam santaḥ padma śaṅkha kacchapa makarāḥ yasmin tat padma ādi ākāra rekhā saṃpannam iti arthaḥ pakṣe padma ādi nāma nidhi viśeṣa vat iti arthaḥ

original: iha bhārgavīsamṛddhissarasvatī bhātyupatyakā durgā | acyutadhātrīśayitastrimūrtimaya iva vṛṣādrirayamindhe || 457 ||

original: iha adrau bhārgavī prapātasaṃbandhinī ‘prapātastu taṭo bhṛguḥ’ ityamaraḥ | samṛddhissaṃpat bhāti | pakṣe saṃtatā ṛddhiryasyāssā samṛddhiḥ mahāvibhūtirityarthaḥ | bhārgavī lakṣmīḥ bhāti | upatyakā āsannabhūmiḥ | sarāṃsyasyāṃ santīti sarasvatī | bhūmni matup | ‘tasau matvarthe’ iti bhasaṃjñāvidhānānna padakāryarutvotve | pakṣe bhāratītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: iha adrau bhārgavī prapāta saṃbandhinī prapātaḥ tu taṭaḥ bhṛguḥ iti amaraḥ samṛddhiḥ saṃpad bhāti pakṣe saṃtatā ṛddhiḥ yasyāḥ sā samṛddhiḥ mahā vibhūtiḥ iti arthaḥ bhārgavī lakṣmīḥ bhāti upatyakā āsanna bhūmiḥ sarāṃsi asyām santi iti sarasvatī bhūmni matup tasau iti bha saṃjñā vidhānāt na pada kārya ru tva utve pakṣe bhāratī iti arthaḥ

original: gantumaśakyā durgā ca | pakṣe gaurī ca bhāti | acyutaṃ yathā syāttathā dhātryāṃ bhūmyāṃ śayitaḥ sthita iti yāvat | śīṅaḥ kartari ktaḥ | pakṣe acyuto bhagavān dhātā brahmā īṭ īśānaśca acyutadhātrīśaḥ | idaṃ dvitīyābahuvacanam | itaḥ prāptaḥ | iṇaḥ kartari ktaḥ | yadvā itaḥ asmingirau saptamyāssārvavibhaktikastasiḥ |
analyzed: gantum aśakyā durgā ca pakṣe gaurī ca bhāti acyutam yathā syāt tathā dhātryām bhūmyām śayitaḥ sthitaḥ iti yāvat śīṅaḥ kartari ktaḥ pakṣe acyutaḥ bhagavān dhātā brahmā īṭ īśānaḥ ca acyuta dhātrī īśaḥ idam dvitīyā bahuvacanam itas prāptaḥ kartari ktaḥ yat vā itas asmin girau saptamyāḥ sārvavibhaktikaḥ tasiḥ

original: acyutadhātrīśa iti prathamābahuvacanaṃ arthastūkta eva | bhāntīti vacanavipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | dhātrīśayita ityatra dhātrīśas ita iti sthite rutvayatvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ ‘lopaśśākalyasya’ iti yalopasya vaikalpikatvānneha yakāralopaḥ | ata eva ayaṃ vṛṣādriḥ trimūrtimaya iva hariviriñciharamaya iva indhe dīpyate |
analyzed: acyuta dhātrī īśaḥ iti prathamā bahuvacanam arthaḥ tu uktaḥ eva bhānti iti vacana vipariṇāmena anvayaḥ dhātrī śayitaḥ iti atra dhātrī īśaḥ itas iti sthite ru tu aya tvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ lopaḥ śākalyasya iti ya lopasya vaikalpika tvāt na iha yakāra lopaḥ atas eva ayam vṛṣādriḥ trimūrti mayaḥ iva hari viriñci hara mayaḥ iva indhe dīpyate

original: atra utprekṣyamāṇasya trimūrtimayasya dharmeṣu samṛddhibhārgavyādyadhikaraṇatvādiṣu viśeṣaṇībhūtābhirbhārgavyādibhirviṣayasya vṛṣādrerdharmeṣu bhṛgusaṃbandhisamṛddhimattvādiṣu viśeṣaṇībhūtānāṃ bhṛgusaṃbandhisamṛddhyādīnāṃ śleṣeṇa tādātmyasaṃpādanadvārā tādṛśadharmāṇāṃ sādhāraṇatāsaṃpattiḥ ||
analyzed: atra utprekṣyamāṇasya trimūrti mayasya dharmeṣu samṛddhi bhārgavī ādi adhikaraṇa tva ādiṣu viśeṣaṇībhūtābhiḥ bhārgavī ādibhiḥ viṣayasya vṛṣādreḥ dharmeṣu bhṛgu saṃbandhi samṛddhimat tva ādiṣu viśeṣaṇībhūtānām bhṛgu saṃbandhi samṛddhi ādīnām śleṣeṇa tādātmya saṃpādana dvārā tādṛśa dharmāṇām sādhāraṇa tā saṃpattiḥ

analyzed: śubham puṣṇāti iti śubha puṣ tasmin tathā ukte arāgeṣu virateṣu ruci juṣi prīti bhāji pakṣe śubhāḥ puṣyarāgāḥ ratna viśeṣāḥ taiḥ ruci juṣi parabhāga bhāji iti yāvat su mahā nīle atimātra śyāmale pakṣe maṇi viśeṣe vidūraḥ davīyān bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ yeṣām taiḥ a spṛṣṭa saṃsāra gandhaiḥ nitya mukta ādibhiḥ kalite sevite

original: pakṣe vidūrabhavaiḥ vaidūryaiḥ kalite padmasya rāga iva rāgo yayoste pade caraṇe yasya tasmin | pakṣe padmarāgāṇāṃ maṇīnāṃ pade āśraye ata eva he acyuta ! tvayi uktarūpe tvayi ratnamayatvaṃ avaimi saṃbhāvaye |

original: anukūlaṃ kūle | vibhaktyarthe’vyayībhāvaḥ | ye nagāḥ taravaḥ tān bhindanti unmūlayantīti tathoktāḥ | pade anukūlaḥ nagabhit vajrī yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | kanakādrau śeṣaśaile sumerau ca| sarvataḥ visarpantaḥ pravahantaḥ saṃcarantaśca | tārakāṇyuḍūni jayantīti tathoktāni śarāṇāṃ kāśakusumānāṃ jātāni bṛndāni yeṣu te tathoktāḥ |
analyzed: anukūlam kūle vibhakti arthe vyayībhāvaḥ ye nagāḥ taravaḥ tān bhindanti unmūlayanti iti tathā uktāḥ pade anukūlaḥ naga bhid vajrī yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ kanakādrau śeṣa śaile sumerau ca sarvatas visarpantaḥ pravahantaḥ saṃcarantaḥ ca tārakāṇi uḍūni jayanti iti tathā uktāni śarāṇām kāśa kusumānām jātāni bṛndāni yeṣu te tathā uktāḥ

original: pakṣe tārakamasuraviśeṣaṃ jayatīti tathoktaḥ śarajātaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ amī dṛśyamānāḥ vastuviśeṣāḥ nirjharāḥ vāripravāhāḥ na kiṃtu nirjarā eva nūnam | iyaṃ śleṣasaṃpāditasādhāraṇyā śuddhāpahnutigarbhā jātisvarūpotprekṣā |
analyzed: pakṣe tārakam asura viśeṣam jayati iti tathā uktaḥ śara jātaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ amī dṛśyamānāḥ vastu viśeṣāḥ nirjharāḥ vāri pravāhāḥ na kiṃtu nirjarā eva nūnam iyam śleṣa saṃpādita sādhāraṇyā śuddha apahnuti garbhā jāti svarūpa utprekṣā

original: sthāne’yameva viṣṇurjāne’khilabhuvanavardhanādinduḥ | indostu sphuṭamasmādadharatvaṃ sa hi pade’sya paricarati || 475 ||
analyzed: sthāneyam eva viṣṇuḥ jānekhila bhuvana vardhanāt induḥ indoḥ tu sphuṭam asmāt adhara tvam sa hi paricarati

original: akhilasya bhuvanasya salilasya na tu jaladhisalilamātrasyeti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe jagataḥ vardhanāt utsecanāt samedhanācca ayaṃ viṣṇureva induriti sthāne yuktaṃ jāne indostu asmāt viṣṇoḥ adharatvaṃ nihīnatvaṃ sphuṭam | hi yasmāt saḥ induḥ asya viṣṇoḥ pade caraṇe saptamyekavacanaṃ, tena akāre parataḥ prakṛtibhāvaśaṅkāyā nāvakāśaḥ | paricarati śuśrūṣate |
analyzed: akhilasya bhuvanasya salilasya na tu jaladhi salila mātrasya iti bhāvaḥ pakṣe jagataḥ vardhanāt utsecanāt samedhanāt ca ayam viṣṇuḥ eva induḥ iti sthāne yuktam jāne indoḥ tu asmāt viṣṇoḥ adhara tvam nihīna tvam sphuṭam hi yasmāt saḥ induḥ asya viṣṇoḥ pade caraṇe saptamī ekavacanam tena akāre paratas prakṛti bhāva śaṅkāyāḥ na avakāśaḥ paricarati śuśrūṣate

original: tasmādadharatvaṃ vyaktamityarthaḥ | pakṣe asmāt vakṣyamāṇādetasmāddhetorityarthaḥ| adharatvaṃ dharāsaṃbandhavaidhuryaṃ sphuṭam | kuta ityatrāha sa iti | hi yasmāt saḥ induḥ asya pade viṣṇoḥ pade vyomnītyarthaḥ | paricarati paritassaṃcaratīti |
analyzed: tasmāt adhara tvam vyaktam iti arthaḥ pakṣe asmāt vakṣyamāṇāt etasmāt hetoḥ iti arthaḥ adhara tvam dharā saṃbandha vaidhuryam sphuṭam kutas iti atra āha saḥ iti hi yasmāt saḥ induḥ asya pade viṣṇoḥ pade vyomni iti arthaḥ paricarati paritas saṃcarati iti

analyzed: atra prasiddha indau indu tva apahnavena sakala bhuvana abhivardhanāt nimittāt bhagavati tad saṃbhāvanā iti iyam paryasta apahnuti garbhā

original: vibudhaikādhāraśśrīvṛṣagiriracyuta na meruriti manye | yadi vibudhaikādhāro merussyātsa hi na karburamayassyāt || 476 ||

original: vibudhānāṃ devānāmekeṣāmevādhāraḥ śivabhāgavatavatsamāsaḥ | pakṣe vibudhānāṃ mukhyādhāraḥ | meruḥ vibudhaikādhāro yadi syāt tadā saḥ karburamayaḥ rakṣomayaḥ na syāt suvarṇamaya iti tu vastusthitiḥ | ‘karburaṃ salile hemni karburaḥ pāparakṣasoḥ’ iti medinī |
analyzed: vibudhānām devānām ekeṣām eva ādhāraḥ śiva bhāgavata vat samāsaḥ pakṣe vibudhānām mukhya ādhāraḥ meruḥ vibudha eka ādhāraḥ yadi syāt tadā saḥ karbura mayaḥ rakṣaḥ mayaḥ na syāt suvarṇa mayaḥ iti tu vastu sthitiḥ karburam salile hemni karburaḥ pāpa rakṣasoḥ iti medinī

original: atra merau vibudhaikādhāratvanihnavena śrīvṛṣagirau tadutprekṣā paryastāpahnutigarbhā uttarārdhoktatarkarūpayuktipūrvā |
analyzed: atra merau vibudha eka ādhāra tva nihnavena śrī vṛṣagirau tad utprekṣā paryasta apahnuti garbhā uttara ardha ukta tarka rūpa yukti pūrvā

original: indurna dvijarājo dvijarājo vāha eva tava nūnam | sa hinasti viprayogina eṣa tu kamalākṣa vipramodakaraḥ || 477 ||
analyzed: induḥ na dvijarājaḥ dvijarājaḥ vāhaḥ eva tava nūnam sa hinasti viprayoginaḥ eṣa tu kamala akṣa vipramoda karaḥ

original: he kamalākṣa! induḥ dvijarājaḥ ‘tasmātsomarājāno brāhmaṇāḥ’ iti śrutyuktarītyā brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā na, kiṃtu tava vāha eva garutmāneva dvijarājaḥ ukto’rthaḥ | nūnam | atra hetuḥ sa ityādiḥ | saḥ induḥ viprāśca te yoginaśca tāneva hinasti ataḥ kathaṃ sa dvijarājo bhavediti bhāvaḥ | virahiṇo hinastīti vāstavārthaḥ |
analyzed: he kamalākṣaḥ induḥ dvijarājaḥ tasmāt soma rājānaḥ brāhmaṇāḥ iti śruti ukta rītyā brāhmaṇānām rājā na kiṃtu tava vāhaḥ eva garutmān eva dvijarājaḥ ukta ūrthaḥ nūnam atra hetuḥ saḥ ityādiḥ saḥ induḥ viprāḥ ca te yoginaḥ ca tān eva hinasti atas katham sa dvijarājaḥ bhavet iti bhāvaḥ virahiṇaḥ hinasti iti vāstava arthaḥ

original: eṣaḥ tava vāhastu viprāṇāṃ modakaraḥ, pakṣe vīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pramodakaraḥ tasya tadīśvaratvāt | ato’yameva dvijarāja iti bhāvaḥ | atrendau dvijarājatvāpahnavena garutmati tadutprekṣā sahetukaparyastāpahnutigarbhā ||
analyzed: eṣaḥ tava vāhaḥ tu viprāṇām moda karaḥ pakṣe vīnām pakṣiṇām pramoda karaḥ tasya tad īśvara tvāt atoyam eva dvijarājaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atra indau dvijarāja tva apahnavena garutmati tad utprekṣā sa hetuka paryasta apahnuti garbhā

original: na sahasrāṃśurdyumaṇiḥ kaustubhamaṇimeva tarkaye dyumaṇim | sa pariṣkurute’nantaṃ divaiva naktaṃdivamayaṃ tu || 478||
analyzed: na sahasrāṃśuḥ dyu maṇiḥ kaustubha maṇim eva tarkaye dyu maṇim sa divā eva naktaṃdiva mayam tu

original: saḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ anantaṃ antarikṣaṃ divaiva pariṣkurute | ayaṃ kaustubhamaṇistu anantaṃ antarikṣaṃ bhagavantamiti tu vāstavārthaḥ | naktaṃdivaṃ rātriṃdivaṃ pariṣkuruta iti hetūktiḥ | atra sahasrāṃśau dyumaṇitvāpahnavena kaustubhamaṇau tadutprekṣā pūrvavadeva sahetukaparyastāpahnutigarbhā | sarveṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu śleṣasaṃkīrṇatvam ||
analyzed: saḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ anantam antarikṣam divā eva pariṣkurute ayam kaustubha maṇiḥ tu anantam antarikṣam bhagavantam iti tu vāstava arthaḥ naktaṃdivam rātriṃdivam pariṣkurute iti hetu uktiḥ atra sahasrāṃśau dyumaṇi tva apahnavena kaustubha maṇau tad utprekṣā pūrvavat eva sa hetuka paryasta apahnuti garbhā sarveṣu api udāharaṇeṣu śleṣa saṃkīrṇa tvam

original: hetūtprekṣāyāṃ sāpahnavatvaṃ yathā

original: kamalāstanasuhṛdayamiti nūnaṃ śṛṅgāriśekharo’ higirau | vasati sadā nityayuvā mṛṣaiva jagaduddidhīrṣayeti vacaḥ || 479 ||
analyzed: kamalā stana suhṛdayam iti nūnam śṛṅgāriśekharaḥ hi girau vasati sadā nitya yuvā mṛṣā eva jagat uddidhīrṣayā iti vacaḥ

original: atra bhagavataśśeṣādrinityanivāse jagaduddidhīrṣāyā hetutvamapahṛtya tatra kamalāstanasuhṛttvahetukatāyāssaṃbhāvanātparyastāpahnutigarbhā hetūtprekṣā ||
analyzed: atra bhagavataḥ śeṣa adri nitya nivāse jagat uddidhīrṣāyāḥ hetu tvam apahṛtya tatra kamalā stana suhṛd tva hetuka tāyāḥ saṃbhāvanāt paryasta apahnuti garbhā hetu utprekṣā

original: phalotprekṣāyāṃ sāpahnavatvaṃ yathā
analyzed: phala utprekṣāyām sa apahnava tvam yathā

original: śritakāmadhenutāṃ tvaṃ śrīveṃkaṭanātha sūcayitumeva| adhivatsaṃ śrīvatsaṃ dhatse nūnaṃ na tatpariṣkartum ||
analyzed: śrita kāmadhenu tām tvam śrī veṃkaṭanātha sūcayitum eva adhivatsam śrīvatsam dhatse nūnam na tat pariṣkartum

original: śrīvatsaṃ śrīyuktaṃ tarṇakam | pakṣe tannāma lāñchanam | adhivatsaṃ vakṣasi | ‘uro vatsaṃ ca’ ityamaraḥ | atra śrīvatsadhāraṇaṃ prati phale vakṣaḥpariṣkāre phalatvanihnavapūrvakamāśritakāmadhenutvasūcanarūpaphalotprekṣā paryastāpahnutigarbhetyalaṃ dūradhāvanena ||
analyzed: śrīvatsam śrī yuktam tarṇakam pakṣe tad nāma lāñchanam adhivatsam vakṣasi uraḥ vatsam ca iti amaraḥ atra śrīvatsa dhāraṇam prati phale vakṣaḥ pariṣkāre phala tva nihnava pūrvakam āśrita kāmadhenu tva sūcana rūpa phala utprekṣā paryasta apahnuti garbhā iti alam dūra dhāvanena

original: alaṃkārasarvasvakārādayastu ‘kvacitpadārthānvayavelāyāṃ sādṛśyābhidhānādupakrāntā’pyupamā vākyārthatātparyasāmarthyādutprekṣāyāṃ paryavasyati’ ityāhuḥ | tadanusṛtya prāgullekhālaṃkāraprakaraṇe ‘mṛgamadatilakati’ iti padye upakrāntā’pyupamā aucityādutprekṣāyāṃ paryavasyatītyavocāma || yathāvā
analyzed: alaṃkārasarvasvakāra ādayaḥ tu kvacid padārtha anvaya velāyām sādṛśya abhidhānāt upakrāntā api upamā vākya artha tātparya sāmarthyāt utprekṣāyām paryavasyati iti āhuḥ tat anusṛtya prāk ullekhālaṃkāra prakaraṇe iti padye upakrāntā api upamā aucityāt utprekṣāyām paryavasyati iti avocāma yathāvā

original: jaṅghe tava jalajekṣaṇa jagatīvijigīṣumanasijaniṣaṅgau | vapurupavanaprasāritataruṇimalāvaṇyakarikarāyete || 481 ||
analyzed: jaṅghe tava jalaja īkṣaṇa jagatī vijigīṣu manasija niṣaṅgau vapuḥ upavana prasārita taruṇima lāvaṇya kari karāyete

original: he jalajekṣaṇa ! tava jaṅghe vapureva upavanaṃ tasmin prasāritau taruṇimalāvaṇye eva kariṇau tayoḥ karau tāvivācarata ityarthaḥ | atra karikarāyete ityatra upamānātkartussubantādācāre vihitena kyaṅā āmukhe upamāpratītāvapi vapurupavanetyādiviśeṣaṇanairarthakyādaucityenotprekṣāyāmeva paryavasānam ||
analyzed: he jalaja īkṣaṇa tava jaṅghe vapuḥ eva upavanam tasmin prasāritau taruṇima lāvaṇye eva kariṇau tayoḥ karau tau iva ācarataḥ iti arthaḥ atra karikarāyete iti atra upamānāt kartuḥ sup antāt ācāre vihitena kyaṅā āmukhe upamā pratītau api vapuḥ upavana ityādi viśeṣaṇa nairarthakyāt aucityena utprekṣāyām eva paryavasānam

original: evamupamāvācakānāṃ nibhādiśabdānāṃ kalpabādipratyayānāṃ ca prayoge’pi sāmagryā aucityādutprekṣāyāmeva paryavasānaṃ bodhyam ||
analyzed: evam upamā vācakānām nibha ādi śabdānām kalpapa ādi pratyayānām ca prayoge api sāmagryāḥ aucityāt utprekṣāyām eva paryavasānam bodhyam

analyzed: upagūḍhām hariṇīm śriyam urasā kṛṣṇena vīkṣya vṛṣaśaile abhivīkṣante śaśvat kṛṣṇam nija vallabham vana hariṇyaḥ

original: kṛṣṇena bhagavatā urasā upagūḍhāṃ hariṇī ‘hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm’ iti haritavarṇatayā śrutāṃ haritaśabdāt ‘varṇādanudāttāt’ ityādinā ṅīpsānniyogaśiṣṭastakārasya nakārādeśaḥ, ṇatvaṃ ca ‘hariṇī syānmṛgī hemapratimā haritā ca yā’ ityamaraḥ | śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ vīkṣya vanahariṇyaḥ vipinakuraṅgyaḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇasāramityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kṛṣṇena bhagavatā urasā upagūḍhām hariṇī hiraṇya varṇām hariṇīm iti harita varṇa tayā śrutām harita śabdāt varṇāt anudāttāt iti ādinā ṅīp sānniyoga śiṣṭaḥ takārasya nakāra ādeśaḥ ṇatvam ca hariṇī syāt mṛgī hema pratimā haritā ca yā iti amaraḥ śriyam lakṣmīm vīkṣya vana hariṇyaḥ vipina kuraṅgyaḥ kṛṣṇam kṛṣṇa sāram iti arthaḥ

original: ‘vinā’pi pratyayaṃ pūrvottarapadayorlopaḥ’ iti bhīmasenādiśabdavaduttarapadabhūtasāraśabdasya lopaḥ| ata eva ‘kṛṣṇājinena saṃvṛṇvan’ ityādayaḥ prayogā nirvicikitsāḥ | nijavallabhaṃ īkṣante | śrīriva vayamapi hariṇīśabdavācyāḥ bhagavānivāsmadvallabhopi kṛṣṇaśabdābhilapanīya iti paśyantīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vinā api pratyayam pūrva uttara padayoḥ lopaḥ iti bhīmasena ādi śabda vat uttara pada bhūta sāra śabdasya lopaḥ atas eva kṛṣṇājinena saṃvṛṇvan ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ nirvicikitsāḥ nija vallabham īkṣante śrīḥ iva vayam api hariṇī śabda vācyāḥ bhagavān iva asmad vallabhaḥ api kṛṣṇa śabda abhilapanīyaḥ iti paśyanti iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra hariṇīkartukakṛṣṇasārakarmakavīkṣaṇena vastunā śrīkṛṣṇavakṣassamāliṅgitā hariṇīśabdābhilāpyā śrīriva svayamapi tathā bubhūṣava ivetyutprekṣā dhvanyate ||
analyzed: atra hariṇī kartuka kṛṣṇasāra karmaka vīkṣaṇena vastunā śrī kṛṣṇa vakṣaḥ samāliṅgitā hariṇī śabda abhilāpyā śrīḥ iva svayam api tathā bubhūṣavaḥ iva iti utprekṣā dhvanyate

analyzed: yathā vā

original: praṇinaṃsayā sumanasā mauliṣu namiteṣu sumanasastatsthāḥ | pura eva tatopyapatannuragadharādharaśiromaṇeścaraṇe || 486 ||
analyzed: praṇinaṃsayā sumanasā mauliṣu namiteṣu sumanasaḥ tad sthāḥ puras eva tatas api apatan uraga dharādhara śiromaṇeḥ caraṇe

original: sumanasāṃ devānām | tatsthāḥ maulisthāḥ sumanasaḥ kusumāni | atra sumanaḥpatanena vastunā nāmasāmyaprayuktaspardhayā tridaśamaulibhyopyagre svayameva praṇinaṃsava ivetyutprekṣā dhvanyate|
analyzed: sumanasām devānām tad sthāḥ mauli sthāḥ sumanasaḥ kusumāni atra sumanaḥpatanena vastunā nāma sāmya prayukta spardhayā tridaśa maulibhyaḥ api agre svayam eva praṇinaṃsavaḥ iva iti utprekṣā dhvanyate

analyzed: nirvela bhava davānala kharva itara tāpa vilulitāḥ manujāḥ tvad vadana sudhā jalanidhim udvīkṣante muhur murārāte

analyzed: atra rūpakeṇa nimaṅktum iva iti utprekṣā dhvanyate yathā vā

original: ativele bhavajaladhāvarivijayāyāvitīryamāṇapathe | raghukulavīra taṭasthaṃ vīkṣante vānarā iva narāstvām || 488 ||
analyzed: ativele bhava jaladhau ari vijayāyau vitīryamāṇa pathe raghu kula vīra taṭa stham vīkṣante vānarāḥ iva narāḥ tvām

original: ativele bhavajaladhau pūrvaṃ jaladhāviveti bhāvaḥ | arīṇāṃ kāmādīnāṃ dviṣāṃ daśānanādīnāmiveti bhāvaḥ | vijayāya avitīryamāṇaḥ adīyamānaḥ panthāḥ mārgaḥ upāyaśca yena tathokte sati, taṭasthaṃ tīrasthaṃ udāsīnaṃ ca tvāṃ vānarā iva narāḥ paśyanti kuto’yamamuṃ bhavajaladhimapi śaraiśśoṣayituṃ setunā banddhuṃ vā nodyuṅkta iti vīkṣanta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ativele bhava jaladhau pūrvam jaladhau iva iti bhāvaḥ arīṇām kāma ādīnām dviṣām daśānana ādīnām iva iti bhāvaḥ vijayāya a vitīryamāṇaḥ a dīyamānaḥ panthāḥ mārgaḥ upāyaḥ ca yena tathā ukte sati taṭa stham tīra stham udāsīnam ca tvām vānarāḥ iva narāḥ paśyanti kutas yam amum bhava jaladhim api śaraiḥ śoṣayitum setunā banddhum vā na udyuṅkte iti vīkṣantaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

analyzed: udvelataram sutarām utsikte tava yaśaḥ payaḥ rāśau uraga dharādhara bhāsvan uḍupam kṣaṇam api na muñcati jyotsnā

original: jyotsnā kaumudī uḍupaṃ indumeva plavaṃ na muñcati striyo hi nitarāṃ bhīrava iti bhāvaḥ | atrāpi rūpakeṇa nimajjanabhayenevetyutprekṣāyā dhvaniḥ ||
analyzed: jyotsnā kaumudī uḍupam indum eva plavam na muñcati striyaḥ hi nitarām bhīravaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atra api rūpakeṇa nimajjana bhayena iva iti utprekṣāyāḥ dhvaniḥ

original: nanu adhyavasāyamūlatāyā atiśayoktyutprekṣayostulyatvātkathamanayorbheda iti cet śṛṇv adhyavasāyo nāmābhinnatvena pratibhāsanam | sa ca dvividhaḥ siddhassādhyaśceti | yatra lakṣyamāṇaguṇasaṃbandhādviṣayiṇo viṣayagatatvenāropyamāṇatayā bhinnasyāpi viṣayiṇo viṣayakroḍīkāreṇa pravṛttatvādabhinnatayā pratītiḥ tatrādhyavasāyassiddhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu adhyavasāya mūla tāyāḥ atiśayokti utprekṣayoḥ tulya tvāt katham anayoḥ bhedaḥ iti ced śṛṇu adhyavasāyaḥ nāma abhinna tvena pratibhāsanam sa ca dvividhaḥ siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ ca iti yatra lakṣyamāṇa guṇa saṃbandhāt viṣayiṇaḥ viṣaya gata tvena āropyamāṇa tayā bhinnasya api viṣayiṇaḥ viṣaya kroḍīkāreṇa pravṛtta tvāt abhinna tayā pratītiḥ tatra adhyavasāyaḥ siddhaḥ

original: etadāśrayeṇātiśayokteḥ prathamaḥ prakāro’nupadameva pradarśayiṣyate | yatra punarupāttaviṣayatvādviṣayiṇo bhinnatvena pratibhānaṃ tatra vyañjanavyāpāreṇābhinnatvapratītessādhyamānatvātsādhyaḥ | etadavalambanena pravṛttissaṃbhāvanamūho vitarka ityādyaparaparyāyāyā utprekṣāyā ityanayorbhada iti ||
analyzed: etad āśrayeṇa atiśayokteḥ prathamaḥ prakāraḥ nupadam eva pradarśayiṣyate yatra punar upātta viṣaya tvāt viṣayiṇaḥ bhinna tvena pratibhānam tatra vyañjana vyāpāreṇa abhinna tva pratīteḥ sādhyamāna tvāt sādhyaḥ etad avalambanena pravṛttiḥ saṃbhāvanam ūhaḥ vitarkaḥ ityādi apara paryāyāyāḥ utprekṣāyāḥ iti anayoḥ bhadaḥ iti

original: ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre utprekṣāsaraścaturdaśaḥ
analyzed: iti alaṃkāramaṇihāre utprekṣāsaraḥ caturdaśaḥ

original: athātiśayoktisaraḥ
analyzed: atha atiśayokti saraḥ

original: nigīrya viṣayaṃ yatra viṣayyevādhyavasyate |
analyzed: nigīrya viṣayam yatra viṣayī eva adhyavasyate

original: rūpakātiśayoktiṃ tāmalaṃkāravido viduḥ ||
analyzed: rūpaka atiśayoktim tām alaṃkāra vidaḥ viduḥ

original: āropaviṣayasya mukhāderviśiṣya tadvācakapadopādānena vinā’pi viṣayivācakaiścandrādipadaireva grahaṇaṃ viṣayanigaraṇam | tatpūrvakaṃ viṣayasya viṣayirūpatayā’dhyavasānaṃ yatra tatra rūpakātiśayoktiḥ | viṣayirūpatayetyatra rūpaṃ ca abhedatādrūpyānyatarat |
analyzed: āropa viṣayasya mukha ādeḥ viśiṣya tad vācaka pada upādānena vinā api viṣayi vācakaiḥ candra ādi padaiḥ eva grahaṇam viṣaya nigaraṇam tad pūrvakam viṣayasya viṣayi rūpatayā adhyavasānam yatra tatra rūpaka atiśayoktiḥ viṣayi rūpatayā iti atra rūpam ca abheda tādrūpya anyatarat

original: evaṃ ca anupāttaviṣayadharmikāhāryaniścayaviṣayībhūtaṃ viṣayyabhedatādrūpyānyataradrūpakātiśayoktiriti lakṣaṇaṃ bodhyam | rūpakavāraṇāyānupātteti| tatra hi viṣayo mukhādirupāttaḥ | ayameva hi rūpakādasyāṃ viśeṣo’tiśaya ucyate | bhrāntimadvāraṇāyāhāryeti | utprekṣāvāraṇāya niścayeti |
analyzed: evam ca anupātta viṣaya dharmika āhārya niścaya viṣayībhūtam viṣayya bheda tādrūpya anyatarat rūpaka atiśayoktiḥ iti lakṣaṇam bodhyam rūpaka vāraṇāya anupātta iti tatra hi viṣayaḥ mukha ādiḥ upāttaḥ ayam eva hi rūpakāt asyām viśeṣa utiśayaḥ ucyate bhrāntimat vāraṇāya āhārya iti utprekṣā vāraṇāya niścaya iti

original: atra ca viṣayaviṣayiṇorekapadopāttatvānnoddeśyavidheyabhāvassaṃbhavati | vibhinnapadopāttayoreva tadavatārāt || yathā
analyzed: atra ca viṣaya viṣayiṇoḥ eka pada upātta tvāt na uddeśya vidheya bhāvaḥ saṃbhavati vibhinna pada upāttayoḥ eva tad avatārāt yathā

original: timiranirāsapaṭīyānkamalānāmāvahanmahāmodam | kardamamardayatitamāṃ durdamamambhojabāndhavo dyutimān || 489 ||
analyzed: timira nirāsa paṭīyān kamalānām āvahat mahā āmodam kardamam ardayatitamām durdamam ambhoja bāndhavaḥ dyutimān

original: atra hi ambhojabāndhavatvena kaustubhasya nigaraṇe timiranirāsetyādipādadvayagate dve viśeṣaṇe tadanugrahārthaṃ viṣayaviṣayiṇossādhāraṇadharmatayā sākṣādupātte | tṛtīyamapi tṛtīyacaraṇagatamaśābdikānāṃ naye |
analyzed: atra hi ambhoja bāndhava tvena kaustubhasya nigaraṇe timira nirāsa ityādi pāda dvaya gate dve viśeṣaṇe tad anugraha artham viṣaya viṣayiṇoḥ sādhāraṇa dharma tayā sākṣāt upātte tṛtīyam api tṛtīya caraṇa gatam a śābdikānām naye

original: śābdikānāṃ tūpāttayā ambhojabāndhavābhinnakartṛkayā kardamamardanakriyayonnītaṃ tādṛśakartṛtvaṃ sādhāraṇadharmatvena tayorviṣayaviṣayiṇossthitam | prathame caraṇe ajñānasya timiratvena, dvitīye jananayanānāṃ kamalatayā, tṛtīye duritasya kardamatvena ca nigaraṇaṃ tasminnevānugrāhakatayā | evaṃca sāvayaveyamatiśayoktiḥ ||
analyzed: śābdikānām tu upāttayā ambhoja bāndhava abhinna kartṛkayā kardama mardana kriyayā unnītam tādṛśa kartṛ tvam sādhāraṇa dharma tvena tayoḥ viṣaya viṣayiṇoḥ sthitam prathame caraṇe ajñānasya timira tvena dvitīye jana nayanānām kamala tayā tṛtīye duritasya kardama tvena ca nigaraṇam tasmin eva anugrāhaka tayā evam ca sāvayavā iyam atiśayoktiḥ

original: yathā vā
analyzed: yathā vā

original: timirādhaḥkṛtaminduṃ kamalayugaṃ tatra satatasaṃphullam | kalayantī bhāti ghane māyā devasya kā’pyavijñeyā || 490 ||

original: atra timirendukamalaghanamāyārūpairviṣayibhiścikuravadananayanabhagavacchriyo viṣayā nigīrṇāḥ | atra ‘janakasya kule jātā devamāyeva nirmitā’ ityetadanusandheyam | māyā nāma vicitrakāryakarī śaktiḥ |
analyzed: atra timira indu kamala ghana māyā rūpaiḥ viṣayibhiḥ cikura vadana nayana bhagavat śriyaḥ viṣayāḥ nigīrṇāḥ atra janakasya kule jātā deva māyā iva nirmitā iti etat anusandheyam māyā nāma vicitra kārya karī śaktiḥ

original: yatra hyanugrāhakaṃ na nigaraṇāntaraṃ kiṃtu śuddhaṃ sādhāraṇadharmādi sā niravayavā || yathā
analyzed: yatra hi anugrāhakam na nigaraṇa antaram kiṃtu śuddham sādhāraṇa dharma ādi sā niravayavā yathā

original: madhurān sudhāpravāhānvidhuśiśirānabudhajanaduravagāhān | pramuṣitatāpavyūhan pravigāhya jahāmi sakalasaṃmohān || 491 ||
analyzed: madhurān sudhā pravāhān vidhu śiśirān abudha jana duravagāhān pramuṣita tāpa vyūhan pravigāhya jahāmi sakala saṃmohān

original: abudhajanaiḥ ajñajanaiḥ devetaraiśva duravagāhān, atra śrīnivāsadayāvibhavā nigīrṇāḥ | prathamodāharaṇe ambhojabāndhavapadena sādhyavasānalakṣaṇayā śakyalakṣyobhayānugatatimiranirāsapaṭīyastvādyupāttadharmapuraskāreṇopasthite kaustubhe śaktyupasthitasyāmbhojabāndhavatvaviśiṣṭasyābhedasaṃsargeṇānvayaḥ |
analyzed: abudha janaiḥ ajña janaiḥ deva itaraiḥ ca duravagāhān atra śrīnivāsa dayā vibhavāḥ nigīrṇāḥ prathama udāharaṇe ambhoja bāndhava padena sādhyavasāna lakṣaṇayā śakya lakṣya ubhaya anugata timira nirāsa paṭīyas tva ādi upātta dharma puraskāreṇa upasthite kaustubhe śakti upasthitasya ambhoja bāndhava tva viśiṣṭasya abheda saṃsargeṇa anvayaḥ

original: śaktyupasthitayoḥ kṛtīṣṭasādhanatayoriva śaktilakṣaṇābhyāmupasthitayorapyekapadārthayostātparyavaśādanvayābhyupagame bādhakavirahāt | evaṃ ca ambhojabāndhavābhinnaḥ timiranirāsapaṭīyastvādimāniti bodhādiyamabhedātiśayoktirityucyate | evamanantarodāharaṇayorapi | nanvevaṃ sati kimasya rūpakādvailakṣaṇyamiti cenmaivam |
analyzed: śakti upasthitayoḥ kṛti iṣṭa sādhanatayoḥ iva śakti lakṣaṇābhyām upasthitayoḥ api eka padārthayoḥ tātparya vaśāt anvaya abhyupagame bādhaka virahāt evam ca ambhoja bāndhava abhinnaḥ timira nirāsa paṭīyaḥ tva ādimān iti bodhāt iyam abheda atiśayoktiḥ iti ucyate evam anantara udāharaṇayoḥ api nanu evam sati kim asya rūpakāt vailakṣaṇyam iti ced mā evam

original: rūpake viṣayibhedavyāpyasya viṣayatāvacchedakasya bhānena vailakṣaṇyasya spaṣṭatvāt | yadā tu nābhedabhāne tātparye kiṃtu bhedabhāne tadā tādrūpyasyaiva bodhāttādrūpyātiśayoktirvakṣyate | atra lakṣaṇe viṣayaṃ nigīrya viṣayyevādhyavasyata iti sāmānyata evokteśśuddhasādhyavasānalakṣaṇayā abhedopacāre’pyatiśayoktireva ||
analyzed: rūpake viṣayi bheda vyāpyasya viṣayatā avacchedakasya bhānena vailakṣaṇyasya spaṣṭa tvāt yadā tu na abheda bhāne tātparye kiṃtu bheda bhāne tadā tādrūpyasya eva bodhāt tādrūpya atiśayoktiḥ vakṣyate atra lakṣaṇe viṣayam nigīrya viṣayī eva adhyavasyate iti sāmānyatas eva ukteḥ śuddha sādhyavasāna lakṣaṇayā abheda upacāre api atiśayoktiḥ eva

original: tatra dharme dharmyabhedādhyavasāyo yathā
analyzed: tatra dharme dharmya bheda adhyavasāyaḥ yathā

original: sakalajagadagragaṇyaṃ sarasijanayanasya pariṇataṃ puṇyam | asmādṛśāṃ śaraṇyaṃ vismayanīyaṃ vibhātu lāvaṇyam || 492 || atra lāvaṇyāśraye bhagavatyāṃ lakṣmyāṃ lāvaṇyāropaḥ | candro’yamityādau sādṛśyasyādhyavasānanimittatvādgauṇatvam | āśrayatvādisaṃbandhasya nimittatve tu śuddhatvamiti vivekaḥ | ‘bhedāvimau ca sādṛśyātsaṃbandhāntaratastathā |
analyzed: sakala jagat agragaṇyam sarasija nayanasya pariṇatam puṇyam asmādṛśām śaraṇyam vismayanīyam vibhātu lāvaṇyam atra lāvaṇya āśraye bhagavatyām lakṣmyām lāvaṇya āropaḥ candraḥ yam ityādau sādṛśyasya adhyavasāna nimitta tvāt gauṇa tvam āśraya tva ādi saṃbandhasya nimitta tve tu śuddha tvam iti vivekaḥ bhedau imau ca sādṛśyāt saṃbandha antarataḥ tathā

original: gauṇau śuddhau ca vijñeyau’ iti kāvyaprakāśokteḥ | imau bhedau sāropasādhyavasānarūpabhedāvityarthaḥ | tasmātsādṛśyātiriktasaṃbandhena yatrānyasminnanyatādātmyāropaḥ sā śuddhasādhyavasāneti dhyeyam ||
analyzed: gauṇau śuddhau ca vijñeyau iti kāvyaprakāśa ukteḥ imau bhedau sa āropa sa adhyavasāna rūpa bhedau iti arthaḥ tasmāt sādṛśya atirikta saṃbandhena yatra anyasmin anya tādātmya āropaḥ sā śuddha sādhyavasānā iti dhyeyam

original: kārye kāraṇābhedādhyavasānaṃ yathā
analyzed: kārye kāraṇa abheda adhyavasānam yathā
