original: sa hi ‘prastutānāmaprastutanāṃ vā guṇakriyārūpaikadharmānvayastulyayogitā’ iti sarvasva kuvalayānandoktiṃ dūṣayan ‘guṇakriyārūpetyuktirāpātataḥ
analyzed: sa hi vā guṇa kriyā rūpa eka dharma anvayaḥ tulya yogitā iti kuvalayānanda uktim dūṣayan guṇa kriyā rūpa iti uktiḥ āpātataḥ

original: śāsati tvayi he rājannakhaṇḍāvanimaṇḍalam |
analyzed: śāsati tvayi he rājan akhaṇḍa avani maṇḍalam

original: na manāgapi niścinte maṇḍale śatrumitrayoḥ ||
analyzed: na manāk api niścinte maṇḍale śatru mitrayoḥ

original: ityatrābhāvarūpasyaiva dharmasyānvayāt ityabhāṇīt | anye tu ‘śāsati’ iti padye niścinte neti niścintabhedaśśatrumitramaṇḍaladharmatayopātto guṇasvarūpa eva, cintābhāvavadbhedasya cintānatiriktatvāt | anyathā cintābhāvābhāvasyāpyatiriktatvāpatteḥ |
analyzed: iti atra abhāva rūpasya eva dharmasya anvayāt iti abhāṇīt anye tu śāsati iti padye niścinte na iti niścinta bhedaḥ śatru mitra maṇḍala dharmatayā upāttaḥ guṇa svarūpaḥ eva cintā bhāvavat bhedasya cintā anatirikta tvāt anyathā cintā bhāva abhāvasya api atirikta tva āpatteḥ

original: atha tatrāpīṣṭāpattāvapi abhāvasya kathaṃguṇabahirbhāvaḥ jātikriyādravyātiriktasyaiva ‘catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttiḥ’ iti vadadbhiśśābdikaistadanuyāyibhirālaṃkārikaiśca guṇatvābhyupagamādityāhuḥ | ata eva jātiguṇayorvirodhe prakāśakṛtā ‘girayopyanunnatiyujaḥ’ iti, vidyānāthenāpi ‘amadassārvabhaumopi’ iti codāhṛtaṃ saṃgacchate |
analyzed: atha tatra api iṣṭa āpattau api abhāvasya kathaṃguṇa bahirbhāvaḥ jāti kriyā dravya atiriktasya eva catuṣṭayī śabdānām pravṛttiḥ iti vadadbhiḥ śābdikaiḥ tad anuyāyibhiḥ ālaṃkārikaiḥ ca guṇa tva abhyupagamāt iti āhuḥ atas eva jāti guṇayoḥ virodhe prakāśakṛtā iti vidyānāthena api amadaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ api iti ca udāhṛtam saṃgacchate

original: anunnatīyāderabhāvasyāguṇatve tadudāharaṇāsaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭaiva | tasmādabhāvasyāpi guṇatvāddharmasya guṇakriyārūpatoktāvapyadoṣa eva | evaṃcāsminnudāharaṇe’pi nāprasannamityādau guṇarūpa eva dharma iti dhyeyam | vastutastu lakṣaṇe tena rūpeṇa dharmo niveśito’smābhiriti na kopi doṣaḥ ||
analyzed: anunnati iyādeḥ abhāvasya aguṇa tve tad udāharaṇa asaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭā eva tasmāt abhāvasya api guṇa tvāt dharmasya guṇa kriyā rūpatā uktau api adoṣaḥ eva evam ca asmin udāharaṇe api na aprasannam ityādau guṇa rūpaḥ eva dharmaḥ iti dhyeyam vastutas tu lakṣaṇe tena rūpeṇa dharmaḥ niveśitaḥ smābhiḥ iti na kaḥ api doṣaḥ

original: adhiphaṇigirimaṇinīradamacañcalāsīdramā ca vibhutā ca| kṣamayāvipulāsīttanmānasavṛttiśca tasya karuṇā ca || 526 ||
analyzed: adhi phaṇi giri maṇi nīradam acañcalā āsīt ramā ca vibhu tā ca kṣamayā avipulā āsīt tad mānasa vṛttiḥ ca tasya karuṇā ca

original: phaṇigirimaṇirbhagavān nīrada iva tasmin adhiphaṇigirimaṇinīradaṃ, vibhaktyarthe’vyayībhāvaḥ | ramā acañcalāsīt cañcalevācārīt, vidyudivābhādityarthaḥ | cañcalāśabdādācārakvipi liṅ , aḍāgamaḥ | vibhutā aiśvaryaṃ ca acañcalā niścalā āsīt abhavat |’asa bhuvi’ ityasmāllaṅ | ‘ ‘astisico’pṛkte ‘ itīṭ, ‘śnasoḥ’ ityallopasyābhīyatvenāsiddhatvādāṭ |
analyzed: phaṇi giri maṇiḥ bhagavān nīradaḥ iva tasmin adhi phaṇi giri maṇi nīradam vibhakti artha avyayībhāvaḥ ramā acañcalā āsīt cañcalā iva acārīt vidyut iva ābhāt iti arthaḥ cañcalā śabdāt ācāra kvipi liṅ aṭ āgamaḥ vibhu tā aiśvaryam ca acañcalā niścalā āsīt abhavat bhuvi iti asmāt laṅ asti sicā upṛkte iti iṭ ś nasoḥ iti al lopasya abhīya tvena asiddha tvāt āṭ

original: tasya bhagavato mānasavṛttiḥ kṣamayā kṣāntyā avipulāsīt vipulevācārīt bhūtulyā’’sīdityarthaḥ | vipulāśabdādācārakvipi luṅ pūrvavat | pakṣe vipuleti chedaḥ | tasya karuṇā ca vipulā mahatī āsīt | śrīśrīnivāsasyaiśvaryakṣamākṛpāḥ śrīlakṣmīnivāsanibandhanā iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasya bhagavataḥ mānasa vṛttiḥ kṣamayā kṣāntyā avipulā āsīt vipulā iva acārīt bhū tulyā āsīt iti arthaḥ vipulā śabdāt ācāra kvipi luṅ pūrvavat pakṣe vipulā iti chedaḥ tasya karuṇā ca vipulā mahatī āsīt śrī śrīnivāsasya aiśvarya kṣamā kṛpāḥ śrī lakṣmī nivāsa nibandhanā iti bhāvaḥ

original: atrobhayasādhāraṇayorguṇākriyayorabhāvācchabdamātraṃ śleṣamūlenābhedādhyavasānena sapiṇḍito’rtho vā dharmaḥ || yathā vā
analyzed: atra ubhaya sādhāraṇayoḥ guṇa akriyayoḥ abhāvāt śabda mātram śleṣa mūlena abheda adhyavasānena sapiṇḍita ūrthaḥ vā dharmaḥ yathā vā

original: dantālī grīvā’pi ca muktālyā nāsitā tava murāre | nāpramadaṃ jātucidapi vakṣaścetaśca vārijākṣa tava || 527 ||
analyzed: danta ālī grīvā api ca muktā ālyā nā asitā tava murāre nā apramadam jātucit api vakṣaḥ cetaḥ ca vārija akṣa tava

original: he murāre ! tava dantālī muktālyā iti chedaḥ , muktāhārāpekṣayā nāsitā naśabdena samāsaḥ asitā na bhavati kiṃtu sitā dhavalaivetyarthaḥ | grīvā’pi ca muktālyeti tṛtīyaikavacanaṃ, muktāhāreṇa asitā asaṃdānitā na bhavati kiṃtu saṃdānitaiva ‘baddhe saṃdānitaṃ mūtaṃ mudditaṃ saṃditaṃ sitam’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: he murāre tava danta ālī muktā ālyāḥ iti chedaḥ muktā hāra apekṣayā na asitā na śabdena samāsaḥ asitā na bhavati kiṃtu sitā dhavalā eva iti arthaḥ grīvā api ca muktā ālyā iti tṛtīya ekavacanam muktā hāreṇa asitā asaṃdānitā na bhavati kiṃtu saṃdānitā eva baddhe saṃdānitam mūtam mudditam saṃditam sitam iti amaraḥ

original: he vārijākṣa ! tava vakṣaḥ cetaśca apramadaṃ avidyamānamāninīkaṃ avidyamānalakṣmīkamityarthaḥ, avidyamānapraharṣaṃ ca na, kiṃtu salakṣmīkameva saharṣameveti bhāvaḥ | atra sitatvasapramadatvaniṣedhasaṃbhāvanā’pi nañdvayena vyudasyate | yathoktaṃ vāmanena ‘saṃbhāvyaniṣedhānevartane dvau pratiṣedhau’ iti |
analyzed: he vārija akṣa tava vakṣaḥ cetaḥ ca apramadam a vidyamāna māninīkam a vidyamāna lakṣmīkam iti arthaḥ avidyamāna praharṣam ca na kiṃtu salakṣmīkam eva sa harṣam eva iti bhāvaḥ atra sita tva sapramada tva niṣedha saṃbhāvanā api nañ dvayena vyudasyate yathā uktam vāmanena dvau pratiṣedhau iti

original: atrāpi pūrvodāharaṇavadeva dharmaḥ, tasyābhāvarūpatvaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ ||
analyzed: atra api pūrva udāharaṇa vat eva dharmaḥ tasya abhāva rūpa tvam tu viśeṣaḥ

original: kvacidadhyāhṛtopi dharmavācakaśśabdastulyayogitāṃ prayojayati | yathā
analyzed: kvacid adhyāhṛtaḥ api dharma vācakaḥ śabdaḥ tulyayogitām prayojayati yathā

original: divyatamaṃ rūpaṃ tava bhavyatamā śrīriyaṃ ca vanamālā | stavyatamo maṇiracyuta bhāvyaṃ viśayena kiṃ tava paratve || 528 ||
analyzed: divyatamam rūpam tava bhavyatamā śrīḥ iyam ca vanamālā stavyatamaḥ maṇiḥ acyuta bhāvyam viśayena kim tava paratve

original: tava paratve viśayena saṃśayena bhāvyaṃ kiṃ saṃdeho na bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | atra paratvasaṃśayakṣepakaraṇatayā prastutānāṃ divyarūpādīnāmastīti kriyāyāmanvayaḥ | ‘astirbhavantiparoprayujyamānopyasti’ ityanuśāsanāt | bhavantiriti laṭassaṃjñā | ‘bhuvo jhic’ ityauṇādiko bhavaterjhicpratyayaḥ | ‘jho’ntaḥ ‘ iti jhasyāntādeśaḥ |
analyzed: tava paratve viśayena saṃśayena bhāvyam kim saṃdehaḥ na bhavati eva iti arthaḥ atra paratva saṃśaya kṣepa karaṇatayā prastutānām divya rūpa ādīnām asti iti kriyāyām anvayaḥ astiḥ bhavanti paraḥ prayujyamānā api asti iti anuśāsanāt bhavantiḥ iti laṭaḥ saṃjñā bhuvaḥ iti auṇādikaḥ bhavateḥ jhic pratyayaḥ iti jhasya anta ādeśaḥ

original: āstekriyāyā’ aprayoge’pi tadākṣepaśśīghropasthitikatvāt | tarhi prativākyamapi kutonādhyāhriyatāmiti cenna | lāghavādekatrādhyāhṛtasyaivānyatrānuṣañjanīyatāyā nyāyyatvāt | viśveśvarīyālaṃkārakaustubhe īdṛśamudāharaṇaṃ pradarśitam ||
analyzed: aprayoge api tad ākṣepaḥ śīghra upasthitika tvāt tarhi prativākyam api kutas nā adhyāhriyatām iti ced na lāghavāt ekatra adhyāhṛtasya eva anyatra anuṣañjanīya tāyāḥ nyāyya tvāt viśveśvarīyālaṃkārakaustubhe īdṛśam udāharaṇam pradarśitam

original: aprakṛtānāmeva yathā
analyzed: aprakṛtānām eva yathā

original: mānavavargo nikhilo dānavavargaśca namati nantavyam | ahirājagirikhiśāmaṇimatra kathaṃ namadabhedavārtā syāt || 529 ||
analyzed: mānava vargaḥ nikhilaḥ dānava vargaḥ ca namati nantavyam ahi rāja giri khiśāmaṇim atra katham namat abheda vārtā syāt

original: nantavyaṃ ‘nantavyaḥ paramaśśeṣī’ ityuktarītyā sarvaśeṣitayā namikarmīkaraṇārhaṃ ahirājagiriśikhāmaṇiṃ nikhilo mānavavargo dānavavargaśca namati | atra namatāṃ mānavānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca varge abhedavārtā kathaṃ syāt, namane availakṣaṇye’pi mānavānāṃ dāna vānāṃ ca parasparaṃ vailakṣaṇyāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nantavyam nantavyaḥ paramaḥ śeṣī iti ukta rītyā sarva śeṣitayā nami karmīkaraṇa arham ahirāja giri śikhāmaṇim nikhilaḥ mānava vargaḥ dānava vargaḥ ca namati atra namatām mānavānām dānavānām ca varge abheda vārtā katham syāt namane a vailakṣaṇye api mānavānām dāna vānām ca parasparam vailakṣaṇyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadvā atra nantavye bhagavati abhedavārtā namadbhissahābhedakathā kathaṃ syāt | nantṛnantavyayo śeṣaśeṣiṇorabhedāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | athavā atra namatormānavadānavavargayoḥ madabhedavārtā mado nāma kulaśīlādyabhimānenānyāvadhīraṇahetuścittavikāraviśeṣaḥ yo hyariṣaḍvarge gaṇitaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā atra nantavye bhagavati abheda vārtā namadbhiḥ saha abheda kathā katham syāt nantṛ nantavyayoḥ śeṣa śeṣiṇoḥ abheda ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ athavā atra namatoḥ mānava dānava vargayoḥ mada bheda vārtā madaḥ nāma kula śīla ādi abhimānena anya avadhīraṇa hetuḥ citta vikāra viśeṣaḥ yaḥ hi ari ṣaḍvarge gaṇitaḥ

original: tasya bhedavārtā vidāraṇavṛttāntaḥ kathaṃ na syāt bhagavatpraṇantṝṇāṃ kāmādinikhiladoṣadūrībhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | pakṣe atra mā navadānavavargaśabdayoḥ madabhedavārtā makāradakārayorvailakṣaṇyakathā kathaṃ na syāt | tāvanmātrabhedasya dṛśyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atrāprakṛtayormānavadānavavargayornamanakriyārūpadharmaikyam || yathā vā
analyzed: tasya bheda vārtā vidāraṇa vṛttāntaḥ katham na syāt bhagavat praṇantṝṇām kāma ādi nikhila doṣa dūrībhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ pakṣe atra mā nava dānava varga śabdayoḥ mad abheda vārtā makāra dakārayoḥ vailakṣaṇya kathā katham na syāt tāvat mātra bhedasya dṛśyamāna tvāt iti bhāvaḥ atra aprakṛtayoḥ mānava dānava vargayoḥ namana kriyā rūpa dharma aikyam yathā vā

original: yatsādhumanīṣāyāṃ pararūpaṃ sphurati taddhi mārtaṇḍe’pi | āha sadākṛtigaṇyaṃ paramekaṃ śrutiravaimi śābdoktiśca || 530 ||
analyzed: yat sādhu manīṣāyām para rūpam sphurati tat hi mārtaṇḍe pi āha sat ākṛti gaṇyam param ekam śrutiḥ avaimi śābda uktiḥ ca

original: yat parasya brahmaṇo rūpaṃ sādhūnāṃ yogināṃ manīṣāyāṃ buddhau skurati,
analyzed: yat parasya brahmaṇaḥ rūpam sādhūnām yoginām manīṣāyām buddhau skurati

original: eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhotmā na prakāśate |
analyzed: eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍha utmā na prakāśate

original: dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ ||
analyzed: dṛśyate tu agryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣma darśibhiḥ

original: iti śrutyuktarītyā antaryāmivigrahāvaśiṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhissūkṣmayā buddhyā aikāgryasaṃpannayā dṛśyata ityabhiprāyaḥ | taddhi tadeva ‘hi hetāvavadhāraṇe’ ityamaraḥ | pararūpaṃ parasya brahmaṇo rūpaṃ ‘ya eṣo’ntarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate ‘ ityādi śrutaṃ divyamaṅgalavigrahaviśiṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ mārtaṇḍe āditye’pi sphurati dīpyate |
analyzed: iti śruti ukta rītyā antaryāmi vigraha avaśiṣṭam sva rūpam sūkṣma darśibhiḥ sūkṣmayā buddhyā aikāgrya saṃpannayā dṛśyate iti abhiprāyaḥ tat hi tat eva hi hetau avadhāraṇe iti amaraḥ para rūpam parasya brahmaṇaḥ rūpam yaḥ eṣaḥ antarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ dṛśyate ityādi śrutam divya maṅgala vigraha viśiṣṭam sva rūpam mārtaṇḍe āditye api sphurati dīpyate

original: kathamanayoraikyaṃ tvayā viditamityatrāha āheti | śrutiḥ ‘sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe | yaścāsāvāditye | sa ekaḥ ‘ iti śrutiḥ sadākṛtigaṇyaṃ satyā ākṛtyā vigraheṇa gaṇyaṃ praśasyamiti yāvat | divyamaṅgalavigrahaviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ | paraṃ paramātmasvarūpaṃ ubhayatra vidyamānamiti bhāvaḥ | ekaṃ abhinnaṃ āha avaimi tasmājjāne, vākyārthaḥ karma |
analyzed: katham anayoḥ aikyam tvayā viditam iti atra āha āha iti śrutiḥ sa yaḥ ca ayam puruṣe yaḥ ca asau āditye saḥ ekaḥ iti śrutiḥ sat ākṛti gaṇyam satyā ākṛtyā vigraheṇa gaṇyam praśasyam iti yāvat divya maṅgala vigraha viśiṣṭam iti arthaḥ param paramātma svarūpam ubhayatra vidyamānam iti bhāvaḥ ekam abhinnam āha avaimi tasmāt jāne vākya arthaḥ karma

original: śabdoktiścemamevārthamāha tathāhi, pakṣe yat sādhu samyaganuśiṣṭaṃ pararūpaṃ pūrvavarṇasya paravarṇatāpattirūpa ekādeśa ityarthaḥ | manīṣāyāṃ manīṣāśabde sphurati prakāśate | tatra manasa īṣeti vigrahe nakārānantarabhāvinaḥ as ityasya īkārarūpaparavarṇarūpasaṃpatteḥ sphuṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: śabda uktiḥ ca imam eva artham āha tathā hi pakṣe yat sādhu samyak anuśiṣṭam para rūpam pūrva varṇasya para varṇa tā āpatti rūpaḥ ekādeśaḥ iti arthaḥ manīṣāyām manīṣā śabde sphurati prakāśate tatra manasaḥ īṣā iti vigrahe nakāra anantara bhāvinaḥ iti asya īkāra rūpa para varṇa rūpa saṃpatteḥ sphuṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: taddhi tadeva pararūpaṃ mārtaṇḍe mārtaṇḍaśabde’pi sphurati | mṛte aṇḍe jāto mārtaṇḍa ityatra taddhitaprakṛtibhūtamṛtaṇḍaśabde takārottaravartyakārasya tatparabhūtākārarūpaikādeśadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | paraṃ anayośśabdayormadhye paratra paṭhitaṃ mārtaṇḍaśabdaṃ ekaṃ ekameva | na tu manīṣāśabdamapi, tasya vakṣyamāṇagaṇe pāṭhadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tat hi tat eva para rūpam mārtaṇḍe mārtaṇḍa śabde api sphurati mṛte aṇḍe jātaḥ mārtaṇḍaḥ iti atra taddhita prakṛti bhūta mṛtaṇḍa śabde takāra uttara varti akārasya tatpara bhūta ākāra rūpa eka ādeśa darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ param anayoḥ śabdayoḥ madhye paratra paṭhitam mārtaṇḍa śabdam ekam ekam eva na tu manīṣā śabdam api tasya vakṣyamāṇa gaṇe pāṭha darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: sarvadā ākṛtigaṇyaṃ ākṛtyā pararūpavattvākāreṇa gaṇyaṃ śakandhvādigaṇaṃ labdhāraṃ ‘dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā’ iti yat | labdheti tṛnnantena lābhatācchīlyaṃ dyotitam | uktagaṇe paṭhitumarhamiti yāvat | śābdoktiḥ śabdaśāstrīyaṃ ‘śakandhvādiṣu pararūpaṃ vācyam’ iti vārtikamityarthaḥ | āha vadatīti avaimi saṃbhāvaye |
analyzed: sarvadā ākṛti gaṇyam ākṛtyā para rūpavat tva ākāreṇa gaṇyam śakandhu ādi gaṇam labdhāram dhana gaṇam labdhā iti yat labdhā iti lābha tācchīlyam dyotitam ukta gaṇe paṭhitum arham iti yāvat śābda uktiḥ śabda śāstrīyam śakandhu ādiṣu para rūpam vācyam iti vārtikam iti arthaḥ āha vadati iti avaimi saṃbhāvaye

original: manīṣāśabdavanmārtaṇḍaśabdasya gaṇe pāṭhābhāvāduktapararūpavattvākāreṇāyaṃ śakandhvādigaṇe paṭhanīya iti sabhāvaye | anyadhā pararūpavidhāyakaśāstrāntarādarśanādayamasādhutāmaśnuvīteti bhāvaḥ | ata eva śakandhvādigaṇapāṭhānte ‘ākṛtigaṇo’yaṃ mārtaṇḍaḥ’ ityuktiśca saṃgacchate |
analyzed: manīṣā śabda vat mārtaṇḍa śabdasya gaṇe pāṭha abhāvāt ukta para rūpavat tva ākāreṇa ayam śakandhu ādi gaṇe paṭhanīyaḥ iti sabhāvaye anyadhā para rūpa vidhāyaka śāstra antara adarśanāt ayam asādhu tām aśnuvīta iti bhāvaḥ atas eva śakandhu ādi gaṇa pāṭha ante ākṛti gaṇaḥ yam mārtaṇḍaḥ iti uktiḥ ca saṃgacchate

original: śakandhvādiśabdarūpaniṣpattyanuguṇaṃ teṣu śabdeṣu ṭeḥ pararūpaṃ vācyamiti vārtikārthaḥ | atrāprakṛtayoḥ śrutiśābdoktyorāheti kriyāyāmanvayaḥ| śleṣopaskṛteyam ||
analyzed: śakandhu ādi śabda rūpa niṣpatti anuguṇam teṣu śabdeṣu ṭeḥ para rūpam vācyam iti vārtika arthaḥ atra aprakṛtayoḥ śruti śābda uktyoḥ āha iti kriyāyām anvayaḥ śleṣa upaskṛtā iyam

analyzed: suravara māṇikyam nanu suravara gāṇikyam api vṛṣādri maṇe sevāte tava lakṣmīm māga abhinne ime khalu samāne

original: “ tavaivocitayā tava śriyā’ ityetadatrānusaṃhitam | sevāte bhajete | indranīlaprabhāyā api tava divyavigrahaśobhā sutarāmatiśete iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe rambhādyapsaronivahaḥ kiṃkarībhūya tava divyamahiṣīṃ varivasyatīti bhāvaḥ| ime suravaramāṇikyasuravaragāṇikye bhinne parasparavilakṣaṇe mā gāḥ mā jñāsīḥ ‘ye gatyarthāste jñānārthakāḥ ‘|
analyzed: tava eva ucitayā tava śriyā iti etat atra anusaṃhitam sevāte bhajete indranīla prabhāyāḥ api tava divya vigraha śobhā sutarām atiśete iti bhāvaḥ pakṣe rambhā ādi apsaraḥ nivahaḥ kiṃkarībhūya tava divya mahiṣīm varivasyati iti bhāvaḥ ime suravara māṇikya suravara gāṇikye bhinne paraspara vilakṣaṇe mā gāḥ mā jñāsīḥ ye gati arthāḥ te jñāna arthakāḥ

original: kutaḥ? ime samāne tāvakalakṣmīsevanarūpadharmavattayā anyonyaṃ tulye khalu | pakṣe ime suravaramāṇikyasuravaragāṇikyarūpe pade māgābhinne iti samastaṃ padaṃ, māgāvarṇābhyāmeva bhedavatī parasparavilakṣaṇe ityarthaḥ | samāne anyavarṇānupūrvyā tulye khalu |
analyzed: kutas ime samāne tāvaka lakṣmī sevana rūpa dharmavat tayā anyonyam tulye khalu pakṣe ime suravara māṇikya suravara gāṇikya rūpe pade māgā bhinne iti samastam padam māgā varṇābhyām eva bhedavatī paraspara vilakṣaṇe iti arthaḥ samāne anya varṇa ānupūrvyā tulye khalu

original: atrāpyaprakṛtayossu ravaramāṇikyasuravaragāṇikyayorbhagavallakṣmīkarmakasevanakriyāyāma nvayaḥ pūrvavat |

original: atra guṇaḥ, āvirbhāvakriyāyāssākṣāddharmibhirananvayāt| ‘cintādanturanijāntaraṅgāṇi | sutarāṃ paryamlāsiṣuḥ’ iti dvitīyatṛtīyapādayoḥ ‘indīvajaladharendranīlāni’ iti turyapādasya ca kalpane kriyā | ‘dadhate niścetanatām’ iti tṛtīyapāde kṛte guṇaviśiṣṭā kriyā | evamuttaratra yathāsaṃbhavamūhyam ||
analyzed: atra guṇaḥ āvirbhāva kriyāyāḥ sākṣāt dharmibhiḥ ananvayāt cintā dantura nija antaraṅgāṇi sutarām paryamlāsiṣuḥ iti dvitīya tṛtīya pādayoḥ indīva jaladhara indranīlāni iti turya pādasya ca kalpane kriyā dadhate niścetana tām iti tṛtīya pāde kṛte guṇa viśiṣṭā kriyā evam uttaratra yathāsaṃbhavam ūhyam

original: mahasā tavāsurāṇāṃ malīmase mānase ca vadane ca | yaduvīra nirmalāni tridaśamṛgadṛśāṃ diśāṃ ca vadanani || 533 ||

original: te tava īkṣaṇena kaṭākṣavīkṣaṇena savarṇe samāno varṇo yayoste tathokte bhavataḥ tulyavarṇe saṃpadyete |kaṭākṣasya kālimnā dhavalimnā vā asitavarṇe sitavarṇe vā bhavata iti bhāvaḥ | ‘kaṭākṣāḥ kālindīkuvalayakacagrāhirucayaḥ, vadhukiraṇadhārāsahacaro kaṭākṣāṇāṃ rekhā’ ityādau kaṭākṣāṇāṃ dvaivarṇyasya kavisamayasiddhatvāt | prāya iti saṃbhāvanāyām |
analyzed: te tava īkṣaṇena kaṭākṣa vīkṣaṇena savarṇe samānaḥ varṇaḥ yayoḥ te tathā ukte bhavataḥ tulya varṇe saṃpadyete kaṭākṣasya kālimnā dhavalimnā vā asita varṇe sita varṇe vā bhavataḥ iti bhāvaḥ kaṭākṣāḥ kālindī kuvalaya kaca grāhi rucayaḥ kaṭākṣāṇām rekhā ityādau kaṭākṣāṇām dvaivarṇyasya kavi samaya siddha tvāt prāyas iti saṃbhāvanāyām

analyzed: padārtha nidarśanāyām tu upamāna bhūta ruci ādeḥ anyatarasya eva upātta tva na dvayoḥ iti ced ruci śabdena ruci tvena dvayoḥ api upātta tvāt na hi upamāna upameya tā avacchedaka rūpeṇa upātta tvam vivakṣitam yena avyāptiḥ syāt yat vā prāgukta lakṣaṇam vākya artha nidarśanāyāḥ eva na padārtha nidarśanāyāḥ asyāḥ tu evam astu lakṣaṇam

original: harerbhagavataḥ hetīśaḥ cakrarājaḥ raviriva kiraṇaiḥ sphuṭāni vikacāni aravindāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ | anyatra kiraṇaiḥ sphuṭāḥ pravyaktāḥ ye arāḥ parito nābhyarpitaśalākāḥ ‘araṃ śīghre ca cakrāṅke’ iti medinī | tānvindatīti tathoktaḥ | karmaṇyaṇ | prabhāvitāne tejomaṇḍale |
analyzed: hareḥ bhagavataḥ heti īśaḥ cakrarājaḥ raviḥ iva kiraṇaiḥ sphuṭāni vikacāni aravindāni yasya sa tathā uktaḥ anyatra kiraṇaiḥ sphuṭāḥ pravyaktāḥ ye arāḥ paritas na abhyarpita śalākāḥ aram śīghre ca cakra aṅke iti medinī tān vindati iti tathā uktaḥ prabhā vitāne tejaḥ maṇḍale

original: yadvā prakṛṣṭā bhāḥ yeṣāṃ te prabhāsaḥ agnyādayastejasvinaḥ teṣāṃ vitāne samudaye amitaṃ aparicchinnaṃ yathāyathā sphurantī mūrtiryasya sa tathoktaḥ | anyatra prabhāyāḥ avitā rakṣakaḥ prāptā vā| avateḥ rakṣaṇārthakādavāptyarthakādvā tācchīlye tṛn |
analyzed: yat vā prakṛṣṭā bhāḥ yeṣām te prabhāsaḥ agni ādayaḥ tejasvinaḥ teṣām vitāne samudaye amitam aparicchinnam yathā yathā sphurantī mūrtiḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ anyatra prabhāyāḥ avitā rakṣakaḥ prāptā vā avateḥ rakṣaṇa arthakāt avāpti arthakāt vā tācchīlye tṛn

original: nemitaḥ nemyā paritasthitena valayena sphuranmūrtiḥ ‘cakraṃṃ rathāṅgaṃ tasyānte nemisstrī’ ityamaraḥ | saḥ raviḥ durdarśaḥ ayaṃ hetīśaḥ sudarśanaḥ śobhanaṃ darśanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sudarśanaśabdaḥ puṃstve’pyanuśiṣṭaḥ | tathāca medinī ‘sudarśano hareścakre merujambūdrume pumān’ iti ‘sudarśanostriyāṃ cakre’ iti nāmanidhānaṃ ca |
analyzed: nemitaḥ nemyā paritasthitena valayena sphurat mūrtiḥ cakram rathāṅgam tasya ante nemiḥ strī iti amaraḥ saḥ raviḥ durdarśaḥ ayam heti īśaḥ sudarśanaḥ śobhanam darśanam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ sudarśana śabdaḥ puṃstve api anuśiṣṭaḥ tathā ca medinī sudarśanaḥ hareḥ cakre meru jambu drume pumān iti sudarśanoḥ striyām cakre iti nāma nidhānam ca

original: niśvasanavicaladalakaṃ lasadalikaṃ nalinamiva bhavadvadanam | janani paraṃ tvatrāntyaṃ kanati tarāmabjakaraśubhālokaiḥ || 634 ||
analyzed: niśvasana vicalat alakam lasat alikam nalinam iva bhavat vadanam janani param tu atra antyam kanati tarām abja kara śubha ālokaiḥ

original: niśvasanena vicalantaḥ alakāḥ cūrṇakuntalāḥ yasya tattathoktam | pakṣe nitarāṃ śvasanena marutā vicalantīti vicalāni, pacādyac | dalāni patrāṇi yasya tattathoktaṃ ‘śeṣādvibhāṣā’ iti kap | lasat alikaṃ lalāṭaṃ yasya tathoktaṃ ‘lalāṭamalikaṃ’ ityamaraḥ | pakṣe lasantaḥ alayo bhramarāḥ yasmiṃstattathoktaṃ, pūrvavatkap |
analyzed: niśvasanena vicalantaḥ alakāḥ cūrṇa kuntalāḥ yasya tat tathā uktam pakṣe nitarām śvasanena marutā vicalanti iti vicalāni dalāni patrāṇi yasya tat tathā uktam śeṣāt vibhāṣā iti kap lasat alikam lalāṭam yasya tathā uktam lalāṭam alikam iti amaraḥ pakṣe lasantaḥ alayaḥ bhramarāḥ yasmin tat tathā uktam pūrvavat kap

original: paraṃtu antyaṃ bhavadvadanaṃ abjasya candramasaḥ karāṇāṃ kiraṇānāṃ śubhaiḥ ālokaiḥ prakāśaiḥ, pakṣe abjaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kare yasya sa tathoktaḥ bhagavānityarthaḥ | tasya śubhaiḥ kalyāṇaiḥ ālokaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ kanatitarām || yathāvā
analyzed: paraṃtu antyam bhavat vadanam abjasya candramasaḥ karāṇām kiraṇānām śubhaiḥ ālokaiḥ prakāśaiḥ pakṣe abjaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kare yasya sa tathā uktaḥ bhagavān iti arthaḥ tasya śubhaiḥ kalyāṇaiḥ ālokaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ kanatitarām yathāvā

original: parakīyaḥ pakkaṇarāṭṇṭṭaṇarāṅbhavati tāvakīnastu hare | sidhyati nṝṇāmanayorutkaṭasaṃyogamātrato rūpabhidā || 635 ||
analyzed: parakīyaḥ tāvakīnaḥ tu hare sidhyati nṝṇām anayoḥ utkaṭa saṃyoga mātrataḥ rūpa bhidā

original: he hare parakīyaḥ tvaditaropāsakaḥ pakkaṇarāṭ śabaranivāsabhūtakugrāmamātraprakāśavān bhavati | pakkaṇe rājata iti vigrahe kvip ‘pakkaṇaśśābarālayaḥ’ ityamaraḥ | tāvakīnaḥ tvāmupāsīnastu paṭṭaṇarāṭ rājadhānyāḥ rājā bhavati ‘rājñi rāṭ’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: he hare parakīyaḥ tvad itara upāsakaḥ pakkaṇa rāj śabara nivāsa bhūta ku grāma mātra prakāśavān bhavati pakkaṇe rājate iti vigrahe kvip pakkaṇaḥ śābara ālayaḥ iti amaraḥ tāvakīnaḥ tvām upāsīnaḥ tu paṭṭaṇa rāj rājadhānyāḥ rājā bhavati rājñi rāj iti amaraḥ

original: ‘paṭṭaṇaṃ puṭabhedanam’ iti paṭhanto vācaspatiprabhṛtayaḥ tavargyamadhyāntyapattanaśabdavaṭṭavargyamadhyāntyapaṭṭaṇaśabdopyastīti manyante | ata eva ‘aṭṭaśūlāḥ katipaye paṭṭaṇe’sminpratiṣṭhitāḥ ‘ iti prayogaśca prāsabaddhassaṃgacchate |
analyzed: paṭṭaṇam puṭa bhedanam iti paṭhantaḥ vācaspati prabhṛtayaḥ ta vargya madhya antya pattana śabda vaṭṭa vargya madhya antya paṭṭaṇa śabdaḥ upi asti iti manyante atas eva aṭṭa śūlāḥ katipaye paṭṭaṇe asmin pratiṣṭhitāḥ iti prayogaḥ ca prāsa baddhaḥ saṃgacchate

original: rūḍhaścāyaṃ śabdo nātra vipratipattavyam |anayoḥ pakkaṇapaṭṭaṇarājoḥ utkaṭo’timātraḥ yassaṃyogassaṃsargaḥ tanmātreṇa tāvataiva nṝṇāṃ saṃsargiṇāṃ narāṇāṃ rūpābhidā sidhyati ‘saṃsargajā doṣaguṇā bhavanti’ iti nyāyātpakkaṇasaṃsargeṇa mahatāmapi nihīnatvaṃ paṭṭaṇarāṭsaṃsargeṇa nihīnānāmapi mahattvaṃ cetyevaṃrūpabhedassidhyatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: rūḍhaḥ ca ayam śabdaḥ na atra vipratipattavyam anayoḥ pakkaṇa paṭṭaṇa rājoḥ utkaṭa uti mātraḥ yaḥ saṃyogaḥ saṃsargaḥ tad mātreṇa tāvatā eva nṝṇām saṃsargiṇām narāṇām rūpa abhidā sidhyati saṃsarga jāḥ doṣa guṇāḥ bhavanti iti nyāyāt pakkaṇa saṃsargeṇa mahatām api nihīna tvam paṭṭaṇa rāj saṃsargeṇa nihīnānām api mahā tvam ca iti evaṃrūpa bhedaḥ sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ

original: utkṛṣṭaḥ kaṭayorvarṇayoḥ yassaṃyogaḥ ‘halo’nantarāssaṃyogaḥ, ityuktalakṣaṇaḥ aucityāt kakārasya kakāreṇa ṭakārasya ṭakāreṇaiva saṃyogo’tra vivakṣitaḥ | utkaṭasaṃyoga eva utkaṭasaṃyogamātraṃ tasmāt tataḥ rūpabhidā sidhyati | saṃyuktakakāraṭakārābhyāmeva pakkaṇarāṭpaṭṭaṇarāṭchabdayorvailakṣaṇyaṃ nānyavarṇeṣviti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: utkṛṣṭaḥ kaṭayoḥ varṇayoḥ yaḥ saṃyogaḥ ha laḥ ūnantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ iti ukta lakṣaṇaḥ aucityāt kakārasya kakāreṇa ṭakārasya ṭakāreṇa eva saṃyogaḥ utra vivakṣitaḥ utkaṭa saṃyogaḥ eva utkaṭa saṃyoga mātram tasmāt tatas rūpa bhidā sidhyati saṃyukta kakāra ṭakārābhyām eva pakkaṇa rāj paṭṭaṇarāj śabdayoḥ vailakṣaṇyam na anya varṇeṣu iti bhāvaḥ

original: atrādye udāharaṇacatuṣṭaye vyatirekamūlabhūtā upamā śābdī | atra tu upāsanādiprayuktā gamyeti bhidā || yathāvā
analyzed: atra ādye udāharaṇa catuṣṭaye vyatireka mūla bhūtā upamā śābdī atra tu upāsana ādi prayuktā gamyā iti bhidā yathāvā

original: karibhayakārī giriśaḥ karibhayavārī phaṇādharagirīśaḥ | varṇe dhavalāsitayoranayoḥ kāvā bhidā’sti haraharyoḥ || 636 ||
analyzed: kari bhaya kārī giriśaḥ kari bhaya vārī phaṇādhara girīśaḥ varṇe dhavala asitayoḥ anayoḥ bhidā asti hara haryoḥ

original: giriśaḥ dhūrjaṭiḥ kariṇaḥ gajāsurasya bhayakārī, phaṇādharāgirīśastu karibhayavārī gajendrabhayanivārayitā | varṇe varṇaviṣaye dhavalāsitayoḥ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ sitanīlayoḥ anayoḥ haraharyoḥ kā vā abhidā asti na kā’pyabhidā, kiṃtu bheda eva spaṣṭa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: giriśaḥ dhūrjaṭiḥ kariṇaḥ gaja asurasya bhaya kārī phaṇādharā girīśaḥ tu kari bhaya vārī gaja indra bhaya nivārayitā varṇe varṇa viṣaye dhavala asitayoḥ yathāsaṃkhyam sita nīlayoḥ anayoḥ hara haryoḥ kā vā abhidā asti na kā api abhidā kiṃtu bhedaḥ eva spaṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: pakṣe varṇe akṣare viṣaye kāvābhidā kāvābhayamevabhedaḥ karibhayakārikaribhayavāriśabdayoḥ kāvāvarṇābhyāmeva bhedo na varṇāntareṣvityarthaḥ | kiṃca haraharyoḥ kāvā kā’pi abhidā akāreṇaiva bhidā haraśabde dvāvakārau hariśabdetveka eva sa iti bheda ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pakṣe varṇe akṣare viṣaye kāvā bhidā kāvā abhaya meva bhedaḥ kari bhaya kāri kari bhaya vāri śabdayoḥ kāvā varṇābhyām eva bhedaḥ na varṇa antareṣu iti arthaḥ kiṃca hara haryoḥ kāvā kā api abhidā akāreṇa eva bhidā hara śabde dvau akārau hari śabde tu ekaḥ eva saḥ iti bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: atra bhayakāryapekṣayā bhayavāriṇa utkarṣassarvalokasākṣikaḥ, bhayābhayapradayorabhayapradasyaiva śreyastvāt | atra hariśabdasya ‘dvaṃdve ghi, abhyarhitaṃ pūrvam’ iti pūrvaprayogāvaśyaṃbhāve’pi ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ’ iti sūtranirdeśāttasya prakaraṇasyānityatvamanusṛtaṃ vivakṣitacamatkārānurodhāditi dhyeyam |
analyzed: atra bhaya kāri apekṣayā bhaya vāriṇaḥ utkarṣaḥ sarva loka sākṣikaḥ bhaya abhaya pradayoḥ abhaya pradasya eva śreyastvāt atra hari śabdasya dvaṃdve ghi abhyarhitam pūrvam iti pūrva prayoga avaśyaṃbhāve api lakṣaṇa hetvoḥ iti sūtra nirdeśāt tasya prakaraṇasya anitya tvam anusṛtam vivakṣita camatkāra anurodhāt iti dhyeyam

original: ihāpi pūrvodāharaṇavadīśvaraśabdavācyatvādiprayuktamaupamyaṃ gamyam ||
analyzed: iha api pūrva udāharaṇa vat īśvara śabda vācya tva ādi prayuktam aupamyam gamyam

original: sārasanābhikhyāḍhyā daśanālistava madamba raśa nāliśva | mukhyā’’dyā madhyasthā parā’nayorbhavati devi daramātrabhidā || 637 || he devi madamba sā prasiddhā tava daśanāliḥ rasanāyāḥ rasajñāyāḥ abhikhyayā śobhayā āḍhyā paripakvadāḍimabījarājivatpāṭalavarṇatayā bhāsamānetyarthaḥ | raśanāliḥ mekhalāpaṅktiśca |
analyzed: sārasana abhikhyā āḍhyā daśa nāliḥ tava madamba mukhyā ādyā madhya sthā parā anayoḥ bhavati devi dara mātra bhidā he devi madamba sā prasiddhā tava daśa nāliḥ rasanāyāḥ rasajñāyāḥ abhikhyayā śobhayā āḍhyā paripakva dāḍima bīja rāji vat pāṭala varṇa tayā bhāsamānā iti arthaḥ raśanā āliḥ mekhalā paṅktiḥ ca

original: yadvā raśanā ālisseturiva raśanāliḥ ‘seturālau striyāṃ pumān’ ityamaraḥ | striyāṃ vidyamānāyāmālau setuḥ pumāniti kośārthaḥ| sārasanamityabhikhyayā nāmnā āḍhyā ‘saptakī raśanā tathā | klībe sārasanaṃ ca, abhikhyānāmaśobhayoḥ’ iti cāmaraḥ |
analyzed: yat vā raśanā āliḥ setuḥ iva raśanā āliḥ setuḥ ālau striyām pumān iti amaraḥ striyām vidyamānāyām ālau setuḥ pumān iti kośa arthaḥ sārasanam iti abhikhyayā nāmnā āḍhyā saptakī raśanā tathā klībe sārasanam ca abhikhyā nāma śobhayoḥ iti ca amaraḥ

analyzed: anayoḥ madhye ādyā daśanāliḥ mukhyā śreṣṭhā mukhe bhavā ca aparā raśanāliḥ madhya sthā madhyamā avalagna sthā ca anayoḥ dara mātrī alpa parimāṇā bhidā bhedaḥ dara mātrī ca sā bhidā ca iti vigrahaḥ mukhya tva madhya stha tve eva bhedaḥ na anyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: pakṣe darābhyāṃ dakārarephābhyāmeva bhedaḥ daśanāliraśanāliśabdayostāvataiva bhedaḥ tulyatvādanyavarṇānupūrvyā iti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: pakṣe darābhyām dakāra rephābhyām eva bhedaḥ daśanāli raśanāli śabdayoḥ tāvatā eva bhedaḥ tulya tvāt anya varṇa ānupūrvyā iti bhāvaḥ

analyzed: yathā vā

original: tava kṛpayā muktendrāvāvirbhūtasvarūpasaṃpannau | ekassvarāṭparastu svārāḍāsphūrtimāṃstayorbhedaḥ ||
analyzed: tava kṛpayā mukta indrau āvirbhūta sva rūpa saṃpannau ekaḥ svarāj paraḥ tu svārāj āsphūrtimān tayoḥ bhedaḥ

original: he bhagavanniti prakaraṇāllabhyate | tava kṛpayā muktaḥ prakṛtibandhavinirmuktaḥ pumān indraśśakraśca muktendrau āvirbhūtasvarūpasaṃpannau |
analyzed: he bhagavan iti prakaraṇāt labhyate tava kṛpayā muktaḥ prakṛti bandha vinirmuktaḥ pumān indraḥ śakraḥ ca mukta indrau āvirbhūta sva rūpa saṃpannau

original: muktapakṣe āvirbhūtaṃ yatsvarūpaṃ apahatapāpmatvādibrāhmaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ svarūpaṃ tena saṃpannaḥ, pūrvaṃ karmārabdhaśarīrasaṃbandhavattayā tirohitāpahatapāpmatvādiḥ paścāt ‘paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate’ ityuktarītyā’’virbhūtasvasvarūpa ityarthaḥ | atra saṃpadyāvirbhāvādhikaraṇārtho’nusaṃdheyaḥ |
analyzed: mukta pakṣe āvirbhūtam yat sva rūpam apahatapāpmatva ādi brāhma guṇa viśiṣṭam sva rūpam tena saṃpannaḥ pūrvam karma ārabdha śarīra saṃbandhavattayā tirohita apahata pāpmatva ādiḥ paścāt param jyotiḥ upasaṃpadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate iti ukta rīti āvirbhūta sva svarūpaḥ iti arthaḥ atra saṃpadi āvirbhāva adhikaraṇa arthaḥ anusaṃdheyaḥ

original: indrapakṣe āvirbhūtaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ prakāśamāna’ iti yāvat | yaḥ svaruḥ śatakoṭiḥ ‘śatakoṭissvaruśśambaḥ’ ityamaraḥ | tena upasaṃpannaḥ indrasya vajrāyudhalābho’pi bhagavatkṛpāyatta eveti bhāvaḥ | ekaḥ anayormadhye prathamanirdiṣṭo muktaḥ svarāṭ svena rājata iti svarāṭ akarmavaśya ityarthaḥ | ‘sa svarāṭ bhavati’ iti śruteḥ |
analyzed: indra pakṣe āvirbhūtaḥ prādurbhūtaḥ prakāśamānaḥ iti yāvat yaḥ svaruḥ śatakoṭiḥ śatakoṭiḥ svaruḥ śambaḥ iti amaraḥ tena upasaṃpannaḥ indrasya vajrāyudha lābhaḥ api bhagavat kṛpā āyattaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ ekaḥ anayoḥ madhye prathama nirdiṣṭaḥ muktaḥ svarāj svena rājate iti svarāj akarma vaśyaḥ iti arthaḥ sa svarāj bhavati iti śruteḥ

original: sūtritaṃ ca ‘ata eva cānanyādhipatiḥ’ iti | ‘apahatapāpmā satyasaṅkalpaḥ’ iti śravaṇādevākarmavaśya iti sūtrārthaḥ | paraḥ anantaranirdiṣṭa indrastu svārāṭ svena na rājata iti svārāṭ karmaparatantra ityarthaḥ | pakṣe svaḥ svargasya rāṭ rājā | svariti rephāntamavyayam |
analyzed: sūtritam ca atas eva ca an anya adhipatiḥ iti apahata pāpmā satya saṅkalpaḥ iti śravaṇāt eva a karma vaśyaḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ paraḥ anantara nirdiṣṭaḥ indraḥ tu svārāj svena na rājate iti svārāj karma paratantraḥ iti arthaḥ pakṣe svaḥ svargasya rāj rājā svar iti repha antam avyayam

original: ‘rori’ iti rephalope ‘ḍhralope pūrvasya’ iti dīrghaḥ ‘svārāṇṇamucisūdanaḥ’ ityamaraḥ | tayoḥ muktamahendrayoḥ bhedaḥ āsphūrtimān īṣatsphuraṇavān | āṅīṣadarthe | atyalpa eva bheda ityarthaḥ | yadvā ā samantāt, āṅbhividhau | sphūrtimān akarmavaśyakarmaparatantrayormahān bheda iti bhāvaḥ | āṅīṣadarthe’bhivyāptau’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: iti repha lope ḍh ra lope pūrvasya iti dīrghaḥ iti amaraḥ tayoḥ mukta mahendrayoḥ bhedaḥ āsphūrtimān īṣat sphuraṇavān āṅīṣad arthe ati alpaḥ eva bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ yat vā ā samantāt sphūrtimān akarma vaśya karma paratantrayoḥ mahān bhedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ āṅīṣad artha abhivyāptau iti amaraḥ

original: yadvā uktarītyā anayostaulye’pi bhedopi kaścitsaṃbhavedvā na veti mīmāṃsamānassmarannāha āḥ sphūrtimāniti | tayoḥ muktamahendrayoḥ bhedaḥ ekassvarāṭ anyassvārāḍiti vailakṣaṇyaṃ sphūrtimān idānīṃ smṛta ityarthaḥ | ā iti smaraṇārthakaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñakamavyayam | ‘ā pragṛhyassmṛtau’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: yat vā ukta rītyā anayoḥ taulye api bhedaḥ api kaścid saṃbhavet vā na vā iti mīmāṃsamānaḥ smaran āha āḥ sphūrtimān iti tayoḥ mukta mahendrayoḥ bhedaḥ ekaḥ svarāj anyaḥ svārāj iti vailakṣaṇyam sphūrtimān idānīm smṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ ā iti smaraṇa arthakam pragṛhya saṃjñakam avyayam ā pragṛhyaḥ smṛtau iti amaraḥ

original: pakṣe āsphūrtimān hrasvākāradīrghākārābhyāṃ sphuraṇavān | svarāṭsvārāṭchabdayostāvataiva bhedadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: pakṣe āsphūrtimān hrasva ākāra dīrgha ākārābhyām sphuraṇavān svarāj svārāj śabdayoḥ tāvatā eva bheda darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: kamalānano hare tvaṃ kamalāsana eva tava suto jajñe | nasabhedo gaṇanīyo lokeśāviti yuvāṃ yato viditau || 639 || he hare ! tvaṃ kamalānanaḥ kamalāyāḥ śriyaḥ ananaḥ prāṇayitā | anyate anenetyananaḥ, kamalavadanaśca | tava sutaḥ brahmā kamalāsanaḥ śrīnirāsakaḥ asyate anenetyasanaḥ, kamalāyāḥ asana iti vigrahaḥ | padmopaviṣṭa iti ca |
analyzed: kamala ānanaḥ hare tvam kamalāsanaḥ eva tava sutaḥ jajñe nasa bhedaḥ gaṇanīyaḥ loka īśau iti yuvām yatas viditau he hare tvam kamala ānanaḥ kamalāyāḥ śriyaḥ ananaḥ prāṇayitā anyate anena iti ananaḥ kamala vadanaḥ ca tava sutaḥ brahmā kamalāsanaḥ śrī nirāsakaḥ asyate anena iti asanaḥ kamalāyāḥ asanaḥ iti vigrahaḥ padma upaviṣṭaḥ iti ca

original: saḥ uktaprakāraḥ bhedaḥ vailakṣaṇyaṃ na gaṇanīyaḥ upekṣaṇīyaḥ atyalpabhedasyākiṃcitkaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | yato hetoḥ yuvāṃ sa ca tvaṃ ca yuvāṃ ‘tyadādīnāṃ mithassahoktau yatparaṃ tacchiṣyate’ ityanuśāsanātparabhūtayuṣmacchabdaikaśeṣaḥ | lokeśāviti viditau | lokeśatvena viditayoryuvayoḥ kiyānayaṃ bheda iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ ukta prakāraḥ bhedaḥ vailakṣaṇyam na gaṇanīyaḥ upekṣaṇīyaḥ ati alpa bhedasya akiṃcitkara tvāt iti bhāvaḥ yatas hetoḥ yuvām sa ca tvam ca yuvām tyad ādīnām mithas saha uktau yat param tat śiṣyate iti anuśāsanāt para bhūta yuṣmad śabda ekaśeṣaḥ lokeśau iti viditau lokeśa tvena viditayoḥ yuvayoḥ kiyān ayam bhedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: prasiddhyati hi caturānanasyāpi lokeśatvaṃ ‘hiraṇyagarbho lokaśaḥ ityukteḥ | pakṣe nasābhyāṃ nasavarṇābhyāṃ bhedaḥ gaṇanīyaḥ | kamalānanakamalāsanayostāvataiva bhedadarśanāditi bhāva | atra ‘sārasanābhikhyāḍhyā’ ityādyudāharaṇatraye sārasanetyādiśleṣapratibhonmīlitatulyayogatānuprāṇito vyatireka iti viśeṣaḥ ||
analyzed: prasiddhi ati hi caturānanasya api loka īśa tvam hiraṇyagarbhaḥ lokaśas iti ukteḥ pakṣe nasābhyām nasa varṇābhyām bhedaḥ gaṇanīyaḥ kamala ānana kamala āsanayoḥ tāvatā eva bheda darśanāt iti bhāva atra sārasana abhikhyā āḍhyāḥ ityādi udāharaṇa traye sārasana ityādi śleṣa pratibhā unmīlita tulya yogatā anuprāṇitaḥ vyatirekaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

original: patriṇyāsīcchyenī phaṇigirinātha tvadīyakīrtiśca | prathamā śaśādanīti prathitā’ntyā’’tmaujasā śaśinamatti || 640 ||
analyzed: patriṇī āsīt śyenī phaṇigiri nātha tvadīya kīrtiḥ ca prathamā śaśādanī iti prathitā antya ātma ojasā śaśinam atti

original: he phaṇigirinātha ! patriṇī tadākhyā kācidvihagī śyenī śyenākhyā āsīt ‘atha śaśādanaḥ | patrī śyenaḥ’ ityamaraḥ| ‘śyene patriśaśādanau’ ityamaramālā | “ śyenākhyo vihagaḥ patrī patriṇau śarapakṣiṇau’ iti śāśvataśca | patriśabdāt nāntalakṣaṇo ṅīp | jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ vā | tvadīyakīrtiśca śyenī āsīt ukto’rthaḥ |
analyzed: he phaṇigiri nātha patriṇī tad ākhyā kācid vihagī śyenī śyena ākhyā āsīt atha śaśādanaḥ patrī śyenaḥ iti amaraḥ śyene patri śaśādanau iti amara mālā śyena ākhyaḥ vihagaḥ patrī patriṇau śara pakṣiṇau iti śāśvataḥ ca patri śabdāt na anta lakṣaṇaḥ ṅīp jāti lakṣaṇaḥ ṅīṣ vā tvadīya kīrtiḥ ca śyenī āsīt uktā arthaḥ

original: pakṣe śvetavarṇā abhūt ‘viśadaśyetapāṇḍurāḥ’ ityamaraḥ | śyetaśabdāt strītvavivakṣāyāṃ ‘varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ’ iti ṅīpsaṃniyogaśiṣṭastakārasya nakāraḥ | śyenaḥ pakṣiṇi pāṇḍure’ iti medinīkośāttu puṃsyapi nopadhaśśyenaśabdostīti jñāyate |
analyzed: pakṣe śveta varṇā abhūt viśada śyeta pāṇḍurāḥ iti amaraḥ śyeta śabdāt strītva vivakṣāyām varṇāt anudātta āt ta upadhāt taḥ naḥ iti ṅīp saṃniyoga śiṣṭaḥ takārasya nakāraḥ śyenaḥ pakṣiṇi pāṇḍure iti medinīkośāt tu puṃsi api na upadhaḥ śyena śabdaḥ asti iti jñāyate

original: tasmāt pippalyāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ṅīṣ bodhyaḥ prathamā tayorādyā patriṇī śaśamattīti śaśādanī prathitā tannāmnā prasiddhā | antyā tvadīyakīrtistu ātmaujasā nijatejasā śaśinaṃ śaśavantaṃ, indumiti vāstavārthaḥ | atti kabalayati ācchādayatīti yāvat ||
analyzed: tasmāt pippalyādeḥ ākṛtigaṇa tvāt ṅīṣ bodhyaḥ prathamā tayoḥ ādyā patriṇī śaśamattī iti śaśādanī prathitā tad nāmnā prasiddhā antyā tvadīya kīrtiḥ tu ātma ojasā nija tejasā śaśinam śaśavantam indum iti vāstava arthaḥ atti kabalayati ācchādayati iti yāvat

original: kāko rarāda hṛdayaṃ pikastu tava vacanadāsyato hṛdyaḥ| dvijayorapi janani tayoḥ kā’pi bhidā vyañjane svare’pyasti || 641 ||
analyzed: kākaḥ rarāda hṛdayam pikaḥ tu tava vacana dāsyataḥ hṛdyaḥ dvijayoḥ api janani tayoḥ kā api bhidā vyañjane svare pi asti

original: he janani ! kākaḥ vāyasaḥ aindririti bhāvaḥ | tava hṛdayaṃ vakṣaḥ rarāda vilalekha ‘rada vilekhane ‘ liṭ | yadvā kākaḥ sādhāraṇo vāyasaḥ hṛdayaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cittaṃ rarāda svarakārkaśyena udvejayāmāseti yāvat | pikaḥ kokilastu tava vacane dāsyataḥ dāsabhāvāt ‘tvadāsyadāsye’pi gato’dhikāritāṃ na śāradaḥ’ ityādāvivāsya āpamye paryavasānam |
analyzed: he janani kākaḥ vāyasaḥ aindriḥ iti bhāvaḥ tava hṛdayam vakṣaḥ rarāda vilalekha radaḥ vilekhane liṭ yat vā kākaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ vāyasaḥ hṛdayam śṛṇvatām cittam rarāda svara kārkaśyena udvejayāmāsa iti yāvat pikaḥ kokilaḥ tu tava vacane dāsyataḥ dāsa bhāvāt tvad dāsya dāsye pi gata udhikāri tām na śāradaḥ ityādau iva āsyaḥ āpamye paryavasānam

original: hṛdyaḥ tava hṛdayapriyo’bhūt | pakṣe śṛṇvatāṃ svaramādhuryeṇa manoharo’bhūdityarthaḥ | tayoḥ kākāpikayoḥ dvijayoḥ viprayossatorapi pakṣiṇossato’rapīti vastusthitiḥ | kā’pi anirvacanīyā bhidā bhedaḥ vyañjane cañcupakṣādicihne svare dhvanau ca asti ‘vyañjanaṃ lāñchanaśmaśruniṣṭhānāvayaveṣvapi’ ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: hṛdyaḥ tava hṛdaya priyaḥ bhūt pakṣe śṛṇvatām svara mādhuryeṇa manoharaḥ bhūt iti arthaḥ tayoḥ kāka āpikayoḥ dvijayoḥ viprayoḥ satoḥ api pakṣiṇoḥ satoḥ api iti vastu sthitiḥ kā api anirvacanīyā bhidā bhedaḥ vyañjane cañcu pakṣa ādi cihne svare dhvanau ca asti vyañjanam lāñchana śmaśru niṣṭhāna avayaveṣu api iti amaraḥ

original: pakṣe kākapikaśabdayoḥ kā pi iti varṇayorvidyamānā bhidā vyañjane kakārapakārarūpe halavarṇe svare ākārekārarūpe avarge’pi asti halajvarṇayorubhayorapyasti na tvantimakakārayoḥ, tatrobhayorapyaikarūpyadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ | udāharaṇadvaye’smin śleṣapratibhottambhitadīpakānuprāṇito vyatireka iti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: pakṣe kākapika śabdayoḥ kā iti varṇayoḥ vidyamānā bhidā vyañjane kakāra pakāra rūpe hala varṇe svare ākāra ikāra rūpe avarge pi asti hala jvarṇayoḥ ubhayoḥ api asti na tu antima kakārayoḥ tatra ubhayoḥ api aikarūpya darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ udāharaṇa dvaye smin śleṣa pratibhā uttambhita dīpaka anuprāṇitaḥ vyatirekaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

original: pakṣe antaḥ svavācakaśabdamadhye suvarṇaṃ su ityākārakamakṣaraṃ vahadapi dadhānamapi mukhe vakre ādau ca kuvarṇaṃ kutsitavarṇaṃ ku ityākārakamakṣaraṃ ca, sadā dadhat kusumaṃ prasūnaṃ kusumapadaṃ ca | hariṇyāḥ suvarṇapratimāyāḥ, anenāsyāḥ apracchannasarvāṅgasuvarṇatvaṃ darśitam | haritavarṇāyāśca ‘hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīm’ iti śruteḥ|

original: ‘hariṇī syānmṛgī hemapratimā haritā ca yā’ ityamaraḥ | tava vapuṣaḥ paścāt parokṣamiti yāvat | samaṃ samaṃmanyamiti yāvat astu | puraḥ samakṣaṃ tu na, nasamaṃ syādityarthaḥ | parokṣaṃ samamiti vikatthatāṃ nāma pratyakṣaṃ tu kathaṃ samamiti brūyāditi bhāvaḥ | yadvā vapuṣaḥ paścāt caramāṅge samamastu puraḥ agrabhāge tu na samamevetyarthaḥ |

analyzed: śuddha śleṣa bhittikā abheda adhyavasāya mūlā yathā

original: niravadhikaruṇānidhinā bhavatā bhavatāpato natānavatā | iṣṭena sahāniṣṭaṃ nirastamāraci samastamapi bhagavan || 701 ||
analyzed: niravadhi karuṇā nidhinā bhavatā bhava tāpataḥ nata anavatā iṣṭena saha aniṣṭam nirastam āraci samastam api bhagavan

original: iṣṭena abhīpsitārthena saha aniṣṭamaśubhaṃ nirastamāraci | iṣṭapakṣe nirgataṃ astaṃ adarśanaṃ yasya tat nirastam | astamiti māntamavyayaṃ, tena saha bahuvrīhiḥ| ‘astamadarśane’ itya vyayeṣvamara | anastaṃgataṃ prakāśamānamevākārītyarthaḥ | aniṣṭapakṣe nirastaṃ prakṣiptaṃ nāśitamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: iṣṭena abhīpsita arthena saha aniṣṭam aśubham nirastam āraci iṣṭa pakṣe nirgatam astam adarśanam yasya tat nirastam astam iti māntam avyayam tena saha bahuvrīhiḥ astam adarśane vyayeṣu amara an astaṃgatam prakāśamānam eva akāri iti arthaḥ aniṣṭa pakṣe nirastam prakṣiptam nāśitam iti arthaḥ

original: atra nirastamiti śleṣeṇaiva bhedādhyavasāyaḥ, na tvanyaprakāreṇa | atrāpi karmasāhityameva ||
analyzed: atra nirastam iti śleṣeṇa eva bheda adhyavasāyaḥ na tu anya prakāreṇa atra api karma sāhityam eva

original: nyapatan śirāṃsyarīṇāṃ murāribāṇaissahārinārīṇām | aśrujharaissātaṅkaistāṭaṅkaissurasumaiśca vijayāṅkaiḥ || 702 ||
analyzed: nyapatan śirāṃsi arīṇām murāri bāṇaiḥ saha ari nārīṇām aśru jharaiḥ sa ātaṅkaiḥ tāṭaṅkaiḥ surasumaiḥ ca vijaya aṅkaiḥ

original: vijayāṅkaiḥ vijayacihnabhūtairityarthaḥ | atra nipatanasya bāṇādyāśrayabhedena bhidurasyāpi cyutatvarūpaikopādhyavacchinnatayā abhidurīkṛtasyopādānamityasyaikakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ | ata eva na śleṣaḥ tasya pratipādyatāvacchedakabheda evābhyupagamāt | eṣūdāharaṇeṣu sahayogatṛtīyāprayukto guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vijaya aṅkaiḥ vijaya cihna bhūtaiḥ iti arthaḥ atra nipatanasya bāṇa ādi āśraya bhedena bhidurasya api cyuta tva rūpa eka upādhi avacchinna tayā abhidurīkṛtasya upādānam iti asya eka kriyā saṃbandhaḥ atas eva na śleṣaḥ tasya pratipādya tā avacchedaka bhedaḥ eva abhyupagamāt eṣu udāharaṇeṣu saha yoga tṛtīyā prayuktaḥ guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ

original: prādhānyena kriyānvaye tu yathāyathaṃ tulyayogitā dīpakaṃ vā bhavati | sahādiśabdaprayogeṇa vinā’pīyaṃ saṃbhavati ‘vṛddho yūnā’ iti nirdeśena tṛtīyāyā niṣpratyūhaprasaratvāt | paraṃtvivādiśabdaprayogavidhurotprekṣāvadgamyā | apradhānabhāvastu śābda eva | yadyapi prakṛtatvāprakṛtatve prāyeṇopameyopamānatayornirṇāyake |
analyzed: prādhānyena kriyā anvaye tu yathāyatham tulyayogitā dīpakam vā bhavati saha ādi śabda prayogeṇa vinā api iyam saṃbhavati vṛddhaḥ yūnā iti nirdeśena tṛtīyāyāḥ niṣpratyūha prasara tvāt paraṃtu iva ādi śabda prayoga vidhura utprekṣā vat gamyā apradhāna bhāvaḥ tu śābdaḥ eva yadi api prakṛta tva aprakṛta tve prāyeṇa upameya upamāna tayoḥ nirṇāyake

original: tathā’pīha na tābhyāṃ tayornirṇayaḥ, prakṛtayorapi sāhityasaṃbhavāt | kiṃtu prādhānyāprādhānyābhyāmeva | hṛdyatvaṃ cāsyā atiśayoktikṛtamityavocāma | yatra tu sā nāsti tatra ‘putreṇa sahāgataḥ pitā’
analyzed: tathā api iha na tābhyām tayoḥ nirṇayaḥ prakṛtayoḥ api sāhitya saṃbhavāt kiṃtu prādhānya aprādhānyābhyām eva hṛdya tvam ca asyāḥ atiśayokti kṛtam iti avocāma yatra tu sā nā asti tatra putreṇa saha āgataḥ pitā

original: nākaṃ pareṇa bhāntaṃ lokaṃ paramaṃ vihāya divyaṃ tam | lokaṃpṛṇassa bhagavān sākaṃ lakṣmyaiva viharati vṛṣādrau || 703 || ityādau na sahoktiralaṃkāraḥ | lokaṃ pṛṇati prīṇayatīti lokaṃpṛṇaḥ | pṛṇatiḥ prīṇanārthakaḥ | asmānmūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ | ‘lokasya pṛṇe’ iti mumāgamaḥ ||
analyzed: nākam pareṇa bhāntam lokam paramam vihāya divyam tam lokaṃpṛṇaḥ sa bhagavān sākam lakṣmyā eva viharati vṛṣādrau ityādau na sahoktiḥ alaṃkāraḥ lokam pṛṇati prīṇayati iti lokaṃpṛṇaḥ pṛṇatiḥ prīṇana arthakaḥ asmāt mūla vibhuja ādi tvāt kaḥ lokasya pṛṇe iti mum āgamaḥ

original: atra vicāryate ‘daśavadanādimakadanaiḥ’ ityādau paurvāparyaviparyayānuprāṇitā sahoktiralaṃkāra iti na yuktam | atiśayokterevātra camatkārāvahatvena sahoktessaṃjñāmātratvāt |
analyzed: atra vicāryate daśa vadana ādima kadanaiḥ ityādau paurvāparya viparyaya anuprāṇitā sahoktiḥ alaṃkāraḥ iti na yuktam atiśayokteḥ eva atra camatkāra āvaha tvena sahokteḥ saṃjñā mātra tvāt

original: ‘tava kopo’rināśaśca jāyate yugapannṛpa’ ityasmādatiśayoktyalaṃkārāt ‘tava kopo’rināśena sahaiva nṛpa jayate’ ityatra guṇabhāvamātraprayukte satyapi vaijātye vicchittiviśeṣasyādarśanāttasyaiva cālaṃkāravibhājakatvāt |
analyzed: tava kopori nāśaḥ ca jāyate yugapad nṛpaḥ iti asmāt atiśayokti alaṃkārāt tava kopori nāśena saha eva nṛpa jayate iti atra guṇa bhāva mātra prayukte sati api vaijātye vicchitti viśeṣasya adarśanāt tasya eva ca alaṃkāra vibhājaka tvāt

original: na ca sādṛśyānuprāṇitasya rūpakāderapyapārthakyāpattiḥ, ‘navanīradasadṛśo’sau, eṣa navīnāmbudassākṣāt’ ityādau vicchittivailakṣaṇyasya jāgarūkatvāt | anyathā sādṛśyaprayuktasya vyatirekasyānutthānāpatteḥ |
analyzed: na ca sādṛśya anuprāṇitasya rūpaka ādeḥ api apārthakya āpattiḥ nava nīrada sadṛśaḥ asau eṣa navīna ambudaḥ sākṣāt ityādau vicchitti vailakṣaṇyasya jāgarūka tvāt anyathā sādṛśya prayuktasya vyatirekasya anutthāna āpatteḥ

original: apica sādṛśyaprayuktarūpakādiṣu sādṛśyasya guṇabhāvāccamatkāraviśrāntibhūmibhyo rūpakādibhyo yathā na pṛthagvyapadeśyatvaṃ tathā sahabhāvoktyunmīlitāyāḥ kāryakāraṇapaurvāparyaviparyayātmikāyā atiśayoktessakāśādasyāssahokterapārthakyamevocitam |
analyzed: api ca sādṛśya prayukta rūpaka ādiṣu sādṛśyasya guṇa bhāvāt camatkāra viśrānti bhūmibhyaḥ rūpaka ādibhyaḥ yathā na pṛthak vyapadeśya tvam tathā sahabhāva ukti unmīlitāyāḥ kārya kāraṇa paurvāparya viparyaya ātmikāyāḥ atiśayokteḥ sakāśāt asyāḥ sahokteḥ apārthakyam eva ucitam

original: nanvevaṃ sati nirviṣayataiva syātsahokteḥ, sahoktyantarasyāpyabhedādhyavasānarūpātiśayena kabalīkārāditi cennābhedādhyavasānamūlāyāṃ hi sahoktau abhedādhyavasānenopaskriyate sahoktiriti ‘na guṇena tiraskāraḥ pradhānasya apitu pradhānena guṇasya’ ityuktadiśā labdhāvakāśaiva sahoktiḥ | guṇapradhānabhāvaścānāgrahaissūkṣmayā dṛśā’vadhātavyaḥ |
analyzed: nanu evam sati nirviṣaya tā eva syāt sahokteḥ sahokti antarasya api abheda adhyavasāna rūpa atiśayena kabalīkārāt iti ced na abheda adhyavasāna mūlāyām hi sahoktau abheda adhyavasānena upaskriyate sahoktiḥ iti na guṇena tiraskāraḥ pradhānasya apitu pradhānena guṇasya iti ukta diśā labdha avakāśā eva sahoktiḥ guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ ca anāgrahaiḥ sūkṣmayā dṛśā avadhātavyaḥ

original: kiṃca parasparābhedādhyavasānamātramatiśaya eva | nātiśayoktiḥ, tasya śleṣādāvapi sattvāt | sā tūpamānena viṣayasya nigaraṇam | evaṃca ‘vidalanti, nyapatan’ ityādavekenāparasya nigaraṇābhāvānnātiśayoktigandho’pi| atiśayamātraṃ tu prāyeṇa sādhāraṇadharmāṃśe bhūyasāmupaskarotyalaṃkārāṇām |
analyzed: kiṃca paraspara abheda adhyavasāna mātram atiśayaḥ eva na atiśayoktiḥ tasya śleṣa ādau api sattvāt sā tu upamānena viṣayasya nigaraṇam evam ca vidalanti nyapatan ityādau ekena aparasya nigaraṇa abhāvāt na atiśayokti gandhaḥ api atiśaya mātram tu prāyeṇa sādhāraṇa dharma aṃśe bhūyasām upaskaroti alaṃkārāṇām

original: na hi ‘śobhate padmavanmukham’ ityādau padmamukhaśobhayorvastuto bhinnayorabhedādhyavasānamantareṇopamā prakāśate | tasmātkāryakāraṇapaurvāparyaviparyayamūlassahokterekaḥ prakāra iti sarvasvakārādīnāmuktirāgrahamūlaiva | abhedādhyavasānamūlastu prakāro bhavatu nāma sahokterviṣayaḥ |
analyzed: na hi śobhate padma vat mukham ityādau padma mukha śobhayoḥ vastutas bhinnayoḥ abheda adhyavasānam antareṇa upamā prakāśate tasmāt kārya kāraṇa paurvāparya viparyaya mūlaḥ sahokteḥ ekaḥ prakāraḥ iti sarvasva kāra ādīnām uktiḥ āgraha mūlā eva abheda adhyavasāna mūlaḥ tu prakāraḥ bhavatu nāma sahokteḥ viṣayaḥ

original: yadi tu dīpake tulyayogitāyāṃ copamānopameyayoḥ prādhānyena kriyādirūpadharmānvayaḥ, iha tu guṇapradhānabhāvenaiveti viśeṣassannapi vicchittiviśeṣānādhāyakatayā nālaṃkārāntaratvaprayojakaḥ apitu tadavāntarabhedatāyā iti vibhāvyate, apāsyate ca jaradālaṃkārikavadanāvalokanadākṣiṇyaṃ, tadā niviśatāmiyamapi klṛptālaṃkāreṣveva |
analyzed: yadi tu dīpake tulya yogitāyām ca upamāna upameyayoḥ prādhānyena kriyā ādi rūpa dharma anvayaḥ iha tu guṇa pradhāna bhāvena eva iti viśeṣaḥ san api vicchitti viśeṣān ādhāyaka tayā na alaṃkāra antara tva prayojakaḥ apitu tad avāntarabheda tāyāḥ iti vibhāvyate apāsyate ca jarat ālaṃkārika vadana avalokana dākṣiṇyam tadā niviśatām iyam api klṛpta alaṃkāreṣu eva

original: kiṃcidvailakṣaṇyamātreṇaivālaṃkārabhede vacanabhaṅgīnāmānantyādalaṃkārānantyaprasaṅgāditi | satyaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvāliṅgitasya sahabhāvasyālaṃkārāntarādvicchittiviśeṣamanubhavantaḥ prācīnā eva sahokteḥ pṛthagalaṃkāratāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ, anyathā evaṃjātīyopaplavena bhūyasī syādvaiyākulī |
analyzed: kiṃcid vailakṣaṇya mātreṇa eva alaṃkāra bhede vacanabhaṅgīnām ānantyāt alaṃkāra ānantya prasaṅgāt iti satyam guṇa pradhāna bhāva āliṅgitasya sahabhāvasya alaṃkāra antarāt vicchitti viśeṣam anubhavantaḥ prācīnāḥ eva sahokteḥ pṛthak alaṃkāra tāyām pramāṇam anyathā evaṃjātīya upaplavena bhūyasī syāt vaiyākulī

original: naiva pramāṇīkurmahe vayaṃ mṛṣānimīlitalocanānprācīnān, niveśyatāṃ ceyamalaṃkārāntarāntaḥpurakārāgṛhaṃ varākīti tu prabhutaiva, na tu sahṛdayatetyalaṃ dūradhāvanena ||
analyzed: nā eva pramāṇīkurmahe vayam mṛṣā nimīlita locanān prācīnān niveśyatām ca iyam alaṃkāra antarā antaḥpura kārā gṛham varākī iti tu prabhu tā eva na tu sahṛdaya tā iti alam dūra dhāvanena

original: evaṃ kriyāyāssādhāraṇadharmatāyāmudāharaṇāni darśitāni | guṇasya tathātve yathā
analyzed: evam kriyāyāḥ sādhāraṇa dharma tāyām udāharaṇāni darśitāni guṇasya tathātve yathā

original: bhuvanādhipa tava nābhyā saha mānasamapyupaiti gāmbhīryam | aṃsaissaha mahimā’pi ca kaṃsaripo māṃsalairmahaunnatyam || 704 || atra yadyapi kriyā’pi guṇena saha samānadharmatāmaśnute | tathā’pi tasyāḥ nāntarīyakatvenāsundaratvātparyavasāne guṇasyaiva samagrabhārasahiṣṇutvam |
analyzed: bhuvana adhipa tava nābhyā saha mānasam api upaiti gāmbhīryam aṃsaiḥ saha mahimā api ca kaṃsa ripoḥ māṃsalaiḥ mahā aunnatyam atra yadi api kriyā api guṇena saha samāna dharmatām aśnute tathā api tasyāḥ nāntarīyaka tvena asundara tvāt paryavasāne guṇasya eva samagra bhāra sahiṣṇu tvam

original: atra gāmbhīryaunnatyayorāśrayabhedabhinnayorabhedādhyatrasānena sahabhāvaḥ | evaṃ śleṣe’pi bodhyam | yatra caikamevopameyaṃ parasparavilakṣaṇasahoktyālambanaṃ sā mālātulyatayā mālāsahoktiḥ ‘nyapatan śirāṃsyarīṇām’ ityatra murāribāṇaissaha arinārīṇāmaśrujharaissaha tāṭaṅkaissaha surasumaissahetyupamānabhedena sāhityasyānekatve’pi
analyzed: atra gāmbhīrya aunnatyayoḥ āśraya bheda bhinnayoḥ sahabhāvaḥ evam śleṣe api bodhyam yatra ca ekam eva upameyam paraspara vilakṣaṇa sahokti ālambanam sā mālā tulya tayā mālā sahoktiḥ nyapatan śirāṃsi arīṇām iti atra murāri bāṇaiḥ saha ari nārīṇām aśru jharaiḥ saha tāṭaṅkaiḥ saha surasumaiḥ saha iti upamāna bhedena sāhityasya anekatve pi

original: nipatanaikyātsahokterabhedaḥ | sati vā yathākathaṃcidbhede nāsti vailakṣaṇyam, dharmaikyāt | dharmopamānobhayakṛtavailakṣaṇyasya cātra vivakṣitatvāt |
analyzed: nipatana aikyāt sahokteḥ abhedaḥ sati vā yathā kathaṃcid bhede nā asti vailakṣaṇyam dharma aikyāt dharma upamāna ubhaya kṛta vailakṣaṇyasya ca atra vivakṣita tvāt

original: mathanoccalakalaśāmbudhikaṇaissahāmarasumaiśca visarantaḥ | padmākṣe nipatantaḥ pāntu kaṭākṣāḥ payodhikanyāyāḥ || 705 ||
analyzed: mathana uccala kalaśa ambudhi kaṇaiḥ saha amara sumaiḥ ca visarantaḥ padmākṣe nipatantaḥ pāntu kaṭākṣāḥ payodhi kanyāyāḥ

original: ityatra dharmavailakṣaṇyasadbhāve’pi visaraṇadharmonmīlitasahoktighaṭakopamānabhūtānāṃ kalaśāmbudhikaṇāmarasumānāmeva nipatanadharmottambhitāyāmapi sahoktau ghaṭakatvānna mālārūpatā | atra payodhikanyāyā iti viśeṣyaṃ kaṭākṣāṇāṃ kṣīrodanvadavatārakālikatvaṃ dhvanayitum ||
analyzed: iti atra dharma vailakṣaṇya sadbhāve api visaraṇa dharma unmīlita sahokti ghaṭaka upamāna bhūtānām kalaśa ambudhi kaṇā amara sumānām eva nipatana dharma uttambhitāyām api sahoktau ghaṭaka tvāt na mālā rūpa tā atra payodhi kanyāyāḥ iti viśeṣyam kaṭākṣāṇām kṣīrodanvat avatāra kālika tvam dhvanayitum

original: idaṃ tūdāharaṇam
analyzed: idam tu udāharaṇam

original: bhāgyaissamamunmiṣitaṃ jagatāṃ sārdhaṃ vijṛmbhitaṃ vibhavaiḥ | saha vismayairamāntaṃ dhanyāḥ phaṇigiripatermahaṃ yānti || 706 ||
analyzed: bhāgyaiḥ samam unmiṣitam jagatām sārdham vijṛmbhitam vibhavaiḥ saha vismayaiḥ amāntam dhanyāḥ phaṇigiri pateḥ maham yānti

original: atronmiṣitatvādidharmāṇāṃ bhāgyādyupamānānāṃ ca vailakṣaṇyāḍhu pameyasya śrīnivāsotsavasyaikatvācca sahoktermālārūpateti dhyeyam|| śoṇoruṣā vyaraci dṛkkoṇena samaṃ daśāsyakāyaśca | bāṇena sahāmuṣya prāṇo’pyudadhāri raghupate bhavatā || 707 ||
analyzed: atra unmiṣita tva ādi dharmāṇām bhāgya ādi upamānānām ca vailakṣaṇyāt ḍhu pameyasya śrīnivāsa utsavasya ekatvāt ca sahokteḥ mālā rūpa tā iti dhyeyam śoṇa uruṣā vyaraci dṛś koṇena samam daśa āsya kāyaḥ ca bāṇena saha amuṣya prāṇaḥ upi udadhāri raghupate bhavatā

original: he raghupate ! bhavatā dṛkkoṇena samaṃ daśāsyakāyaśca ruṣā śoṇo vyaraci | pakṣe aruṣeti chedaḥ | dṛkkoṇaḥ ruṣā śoṇaḥ daśasyakāyaḥ aruṣā vraṇena śoṇaḥ lohitaḥ vyaracītyarthaḥ | ‘vraṇo’striyāmīrmamaruḥ’ ityamaraḥ | bāṇena saha amuṣya daśasyasya prāṇaḥ pañcavṛttirmukhyaprāṇopi udadhāri bāṇa utkṣiptaḥ prāṇa unmūlita ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: he raghupate bhavatā dṛś koṇena samam daśa āsya kāyaḥ ca ruṣā śoṇaḥ vyaraci pakṣe aruṣā iti chedaḥ dṛś koṇaḥ ruṣā śoṇaḥ daśasya kāyaḥ aruṣā vraṇena śoṇaḥ lohitaḥ vyaraci iti arthaḥ vraṇaḥ ustriyām īrma maruḥ iti amaraḥ bāṇena saha amuṣya daśasyasya prāṇaḥ pañcavṛttiḥ mukhya prāṇaḥ api udadhāri bāṇaḥ utkṣiptaḥ prāṇaḥ unmūlitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: utpūrvakasya dharaterupapāditobhayārthaśaktatvāt | ‘syāduddharaṇamunnaye | bhuktojjhitonmūlanayoḥ’ iti hemacandraḥ | atra dvayoreva parasparavilakṣaṇasahoktyossadbhāve’pi mālātvamastyeva | evamapi rasagaṅgādharādau mālāsahokterudāharaṇāt |

analyzed: yadi ca aparaḥ arthaḥ prakṛta kartari āropyate tadā kamalinī vikāsa kartā nāyikā anunaya kartā ca sūryaḥ iti ekatra dvayam iti viṣaya tā śālī bodhaḥ syāt na tu pūrva ukta anupapatti parihāraḥ yadi ca śleṣa mūla abheda adhyavasānena kamalinī ādīnām nāyikā tva ādi pratyayaḥ upapādyate tadā api aśliṣṭa pada upasthitaḥ bhagavān nāyaka tva anāghrātaḥ eva

original: padminīśabdasthāne nalinīśabdopādāne sāSpi nāyikātvena kathaṃ nāma pratītiviṣayatvamiyāt | tasmādviśeṣaṇasāmyamahimnā pratīti’prakṛtavākyārthassvānuguṇaṃ nāyikādimarthamākṣipya tena paripūrṇaviśiṣṭaśarīraḥ prakṛtavākyārthe svāvayavatādātmyāpannatadavayavo’bhedenāvatiṣṭhate | sa ca pariṇāma iva prakṛtātmanaiva kāryopayogī |
analyzed: padminī śabda sthāne nalinī śabda upādāne sā api nāyikā tvena katham nāma pratīti viṣayatvam iyāt tasmāt viśeṣaṇa sāmya mahimnā pratīti prakṛta vākyārthaḥ sva anuguṇam nāyikā ādim artham ākṣipya tena paripūrṇa viśiṣṭa śarīraḥ prakṛta vākyārthe sva avayava tādātmya āpanna tad avayavaḥ bhedena avatiṣṭhate sa ca pariṇāmaḥ iva prakṛta ātmanā eva kārya upayogī

original: svātmanā ca rasādyupayogī | atra cāprakṛtārthasya pṛthakchabdānupādānādrūpakādvākyārthasaṃbandhino vailakṣaṇyam | padārtharūpakāttu sphuṭameva | ākṣiptārthaghaṭitatvācca vākyārthaśleṣāt | evaṃ cātra śaktyākṣepābhyāṃ sarvārthanirvāha iti bhāmahodbhaṭaprabhṛtīnāṃ cirantanānāmāśayaḥ |

original: ‘niśāmukhaṃ cumbati candra eṣaḥ’ ityādau niśācandraśabdayoraśliṣṭatvānmukhacumbanamātrasya ca putrādisādhāraṇyena kathaṃ tāvanniyatanāyakākṣepakatvam, kathaṃ vā ākṣiptasyāpi nāyakāderniśācandrayorevābhedenānvayaḥ, na bhedena cumbanādau | tathātveca tayornāyakatātāṭasthye rasānudbodhāpatteḥ |
analyzed: niśā mukham cumbati candraḥ eṣaḥ ityādau niśā candra śabdayoḥ aśliṣṭa tvāt mukha cumbana mātrasya ca putra ādi sādhāraṇyena katham tāvat niyata nāyaka ākṣepaka tvam katham vā ākṣiptasya api nāyaka ādeḥ niśā candrayoḥ eva abhedena anvayaḥ na bhedena cumbana ādau tathātve ca tayoḥ nāyaka tā tāṭasthye rasa anudbodha āpatteḥ

original: tasmāt ‘niśāmukhaṃ cumbati candrikaiṣā, aharmukhaṃ cumbati caṇḍabhānuḥ’ ityādāvapratīyamānaṃ nāyakatvaṃ prakṛte ṭāpprathamābhyāṃ pratipāditena prakṛtyarthagatena strītvena puṃstvena ca svādhikaraṇa evābhivyajyate | evaṃ ca niśāśaśinornāyakatvasiddhiśśliṣṭaviśeṣaṇaiḥ | vyañjanavyāpāreṇaivāprakṛtārthabodhanam, śakteḥ prakaraṇādinā niyantraṇāt |
analyzed: tasmāt niśā mukham cumbati candrikā eṣā ahar mukham cumbati caṇḍabhānuḥ ityādau apratīyamānam nāyaka tvam prakṛte ṭāp prathamābhyām pratipāditena prakṛti artha gatena strī tvena puṃs tvena ca sva adhikaraṇe eva abhivyajyate evam ca niśā śaśinoḥ nāyaka tva siddhiḥ śliṣṭa viśeṣaṇaiḥ vyañjana vyāpāreṇa eva aprakṛta artha bodhanam śakteḥ prakaraṇa ādinā niyantraṇāt

original: taditthaṃ vyañjanamāhātmyādevāprakṛtavākyārthatādātmyena prakṛtavākyārtho’vatiṣṭhate | guṇībhūtavyaṅgyabhedaścāyamiti tu ramaṇīyaḥ panthāḥ” iti | anyatsarvaṃ tatraiva draṣṭavyaṃ vistarābhilāṣibhiri tyalamatibhūmisvairavisarpaṇena ||
analyzed: tat ittham vyañjana māhātmyāt eva aprakṛta vākyārtha tādātmyena prakṛta vākyārthaḥ avatiṣṭhate guṇībhūta vyaṅgya bhedaḥ ca ayam iti tu ramaṇīyaḥ panthāḥ iti anyat sarvam tatra eva draṣṭavyam vistara abhilāṣibhiḥ i ti alam ati bhūmi svaira visarpaṇena

original: athāsyāḥ kevalabhedāḥ pratipādyante | viśeṣaṇasāmyaṃ śleṣeṇa bhavati śuddhasādhāraṇyena vā | tadapi dharmāntarapuraskāreṇa kāryapuraskāreṇa veti pratyekaṃ dvividham | tatra śliṣṭadharmāntarapuraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇasāmyaṃ yathā
analyzed: atha asyāḥ kevala bhedāḥ pratipādyante viśeṣaṇa sāmyam śleṣeṇa bhavati śuddha sādhāraṇyena vā tat api dharma antara puraskāreṇa kārya puraskāreṇa vā iti pratyekam dvividham tatra śliṣṭa dharma antara puraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇa sāmyam yathā

original: vilikhitavicitrapatrā succhāyā bhāsvadatanutāpaharā | uragagiritaṭavanī paricaraṇācchrīvallabhasya sollāsā || 737 ||
analyzed: vilikhita vicitra patrā su chāyā bhāsvada tanu tāpa harā uraga giri taṭa vanī paricaraṇāt śrī vallabhasya sa ullāsā 737

original: vilikhitāni viśeṣeṇa racitāni, vibhiḥ pakṣibhiḥ likhitāni cañcupuṭairdalitāni ca | citrāṇi makarikādyākāravattathā nānārūpāṇi patrāṇi patrākārarekhānyasanāni | pakṣe nānāvarṇāni palāśāni yasyāssā tathoktā | succhāyā śobhanānātapāmanoharakāntiśca | bhāsvataḥ bhānoḥ atanuḥ akṛśaḥ yastāpaḥ tasya harā |
analyzed: vilikhitāni viśeṣeṇa racitāni vibhiḥ pakṣibhiḥ likhitāni cañcu puṭaiḥ dalitāni ca citrāṇi makarikā ādi ākāra vat tathā nānā rūpāṇi patrāṇi patra ākāra rekhāni asanāni pakṣe nānā varṇāni palāśāni yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā su chāyā śobha nānā ātapa amanohara kāntiḥ ca bhāsvataḥ bhānoḥ atanuḥ akṛśaḥ yaḥ tāpaḥ tasya harā

original: anyatra bhāsvān udīrṇaḥ atanormadanasya tāpassaṃjvaraḥ tasya harā | śrīvallabhasya paricaraṇāt paritassaṃcārāt śuśrūṣaṇācca sollāsā saprakāśā saharṣā ca | atra dakṣiṇanāyakalabdhopacārottamamahilāvṛttāntābhedena sthitaḥ prakṛtavṛttāntaḥ succhāyatvasollāsatvādidharmapuraskāreṇa śleṣeṇa viśeṣaṇasāmyam|
analyzed: anyatra bhāsvān udīrṇaḥ atanoḥ madanasya tāpaḥ saṃjvaraḥ tasya harā śrī vallabhasya paricaraṇāt paritas saṃcārāt śuśrūṣaṇāt ca sa ullāsā sa prakāśā sa harṣā ca atra dakṣiṇa nāyaka labdha upacāra uttama mahilā vṛttānta abhedena sthitaḥ prakṛta vṛttāntaḥ succhāya tva sa ullāsa tva ādi dharma puraskāreṇa śleṣeṇa viśeṣaṇa sāmyam

original: evaṃ ‘sphuṭakucamukha’ iti prāgudāhṛte padye’pi draṣṭavyam ||
analyzed: evam sphuṭa kuca mukhaḥ iti prāk udāhṛte padye api draṣṭavyam

original: śliṣṭakāryapuraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇasāmyaṃ yathā

original: pūrvaṃ nipātya vigrahakāle śaure samānamadhyamavīrān| paścādanipātyaikaṃ padamapi loke suśabdatāṃ prakaṭayase || 738 || he śaure ! vigrahakāle āyodhanasamaye ekaṃ padamapi paścādanipātya ekacaraṇāpasarpaṇamapyakṛtvetyarthaḥ | samānāḥ tulyāḥ uttamā iti yāvat | madhyamāḥ svāpekṣayā’pakṛṣṭāḥ ye vīrāśśūrāḥ tān | yadvā asamāniti chedaḥ |
analyzed: pūrvam nipātya vigraha kāle śaure samāna madhyama vīrān paścāt a nipātya ekam padam api loke suśabdatām prakaṭayase he śaure vigraha kāle āyodhana samaye ekam padam api paścāt a nipātya eka caraṇa apasarpaṇam api a kṛtvā iti arthaḥ samānāḥ tulyāḥ uttamāḥ iti yāvat madhyamāḥ sva apekṣayā apakṛṣṭāḥ ye vīrāḥ śūrāḥ tān yat vā asamān iti chedaḥ

original: asamān śauryavīryādibhirasadṛśān | ata eva amadhyamān utkṛṣṭān vīrān pūrvaṃ ādāveva na tu vilambena nipātya pātayitvā nihatyetyarthaḥ | anenāsya paranirāsa īṣatkara iti dyotitam | śobhanaḥ śabdaḥ yaśaḥ yasya tasya bhāvaṃ suśabdatāṃ yaśasvitāmityarthaḥ | prakaṭayase | ‘śabdo’kṣarayaśogītavyomavākyadhvaniṣvapi’ iti ratnamālā |
analyzed: asamān śaurya vīrya ādibhiḥ asadṛśān atas eva amadhyamān utkṛṣṭān vīrān pūrvam ādau eva na tu vilambena nipātya pātayitvā nihatya iti arthaḥ anena asya para nirāsaḥ īṣatkaraḥ iti dyotitam śobhanaḥ śabdaḥ yaśaḥ yasya tasya bhāvam suśabdatām yaśasvi tām iti arthaḥ prakaṭayase śabda ukṣara yaśaḥ gīta vyoma vākya dhvaniṣu api iti ratnamālā

original: pakṣe vigrahakāle samāsārthaṃ vigrahapradarśanāvasare samānamadhyamavīrān uktavidhān śabdān pūrvaṃ nipātya teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ ‘pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca’ iti sūtreṇa pūrvanipātasya niyamitatvāt pūrvameva prayujyetyarthaḥ | ekaṃ padamapi ekamityākārakaṃ śabdamapi | paścādanipātya pūrvameva prayujyetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pakṣe vigraha kāle samāsa artham vigraha pradarśana avasare samāna madhyama vīrān uktavidhān śabdān pūrvam nipātya teṣām śabdānām pūrva apara prathama carama jaghanya samāna madhya madhyama vīrāḥ ca iti sūtreṇa pūrva nipātasya niyamita tvāt pūrvam eva prayujya iti arthaḥ ekam padam api ekam iti ākārakam śabdam api paścāt a nipātya pūrvam eva prayujya iti arthaḥ

original: tasya ‘pūrvakālaika’ iti sūtreṇa pūrvanipātaniyamāt | suśabdatāṃ śabdaśāstraprāvīṇyaṃ prakaṭayase prathayase ityarthaḥ | atra vaiyākaraṇavṛttāntābhedena sthitaḥ prastutavṛttāntaḥ| nipātyetyādiśliṣṭakāryapuraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇasāmyam ||
analyzed: tasya pūrva kāla ekaḥ iti sūtreṇa pūrva nipāta niyamāt su śabda tām śabda śāstra prāvīṇyam prakaṭayase prathayase iti arthaḥ atra vaiyākaraṇa vṛttānta abhedena sthitaḥ prastuta vṛttāntaḥ nipātya ityādi śliṣṭa kārya puraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇa sāmyam

original: evaṃ kāryātiriktadharmapratipādakaśliṣṭaviśeṣaṇasāmyena kāryarūpadharmapratipādakatatsāmyena ca samāsoktidvaidhī darśitā ||
analyzed: evam kārya atirikta dharma pratipādaka śliṣṭa viśeṣaṇa sāmyena kārya rūpa dharma pratipādaka tad sāmyena ca samāsokti dvaidhī darśitā

original: śuddhasādhāraṇyena dharmāntarapuraskāreṇa yathā
analyzed: śuddha sādhāraṇyena dharma antara puraskāreṇa yathā

original: skhalitamimaṃ saṃsāre lalitatamā dṛktavātra kaṃsāre | niravadhivātsalyā māṃ sarabhasamuddhartumutsukā’’patati || 739 || utsukā āpatatīti chedaḥ | āpatati āyātītyarthaḥ | atra bālakajananīvṛttāntābhedena sthitaḥ prakṛtavṛttāntaḥ | niravadhivātsalyetyādiśuddhasādhāraṇyena dharmāntarapuraskāraḥ ||
analyzed: skhalitam imam saṃsāre lalitatamā dṛś tava atra kaṃsāre niravadhi vātsalyā mām sarabhasam uddhartum utsukā patati utsukā āpatati iti chedaḥ āpatati āyāti iti arthaḥ atra bālaka jananī vṛttānta abhedena sthitaḥ prakṛta vṛttāntaḥ niravadhi vātsalyā ityādi śuddha sādhāraṇyena dharma antara puraskāraḥ

original: śuddhasādhāraṇyena kāryapuraskāreṇa yathā
analyzed: śuddha sādhāraṇyena kārya puraskāreṇa yathā

original: stotuṃ trapāmahe tvāṃ yasya tavocchṛṅkhalo vṛṣādrimaṇe | viṣphāro nanu samitāvambaramādhūya daśa diśo bhuṅkte || 740 ||
analyzed: stotum trapāmahe tvām yasya tava ucchṛṅkhalaḥ vṛṣā adrimaṇe viṣphāraḥ nanu samitau ambaram ādhūya daśa diśaḥ bhuṅkte

original: samitau sabhāyām | ambaraṃ vasanam | tvadviṣphārasya nirllajatayā sabhāyāmevāmbaravyādhūnanapūrvakaṃ daśadigupabhogakāritvāttvāṃ stotuṃ vayameva lajjāmaha iti bhāvaḥ | vastusthitistu yudhi tāvakadhanurviṣphārassakalagaganadaśadigvyāpī īdṛśaṃ mahāvikrāntacūḍāmaṇiṃ tvāṃ stotuṃ mitaṃpacavacaso vayaṃ lajjāmaha iti |
analyzed: samitau sabhāyām ambaram vasanam tvad viṣphārasya nirllaja tayā sabhāyām eva ambara vyādhūnana pūrvakam daśa diś upabhoga kāri tvāt tvām stotum vayam eva lajjāmahe iti bhāvaḥ vastu sthitiḥ tu yudhi tāvaka dhanuḥ viṣphāraḥ sakala gagana daśa diś vyāpī īdṛśam mahā vikrānta cūḍāmaṇim tvām stotum mitaṃpaca vacasaḥ vayam lajjāmahe iti

original: atra prastutabhagavaddhanurjyānirghoṣavṛttānto’prastutanirlajjakāmukavṛttāntābhedenāvatiṣṭhate | bhuṅkte iti kāryapuraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇasāmyam | bhogaśca prakṛte aupacārikaḥ | evaṃ prāgudāhṛte ‘sāmodabāṣpagadgada’ iti padye’pi draṣṭavyam ||
analyzed: atra prastuta bhagavat dhanuḥ jyā nirghoṣa vṛttānta uprastuta nirlajja kāmuka vṛttānta abhedena avatiṣṭhate bhuṅkte iti kārya puraskāreṇa viśeṣaṇa sāmyam bhogaḥ ca prakṛte aupacārikaḥ evam prāk udāhṛte sa āmoda bāṣpa gadgadaḥ iti padye api draṣṭavyam

original: kāryadharmāntarayossaṃkareṇa sādhāraṇyaṃ yathā
analyzed: kārya dharma antarayoḥ saṃkareṇa sādhāraṇyam yathā

original: śubhavibhavasaṃprasāraṇamākalayanpūrvarūpamapi bhagavan| racayasi maghoni guṇamapi subhe’tra dṛḍhapāṇinihitaśāstrastvam || 741 ||
analyzed: śubha vibhava saṃprasāraṇam ākalayan pūrvarūpam api bhagavan racayasi maghoni guṇam api su bhetra dṛḍha pāṇi nihita śāstraḥ tvam

original: he bhagavan ! dṛḍhaṃ pāṇau nihitaṃ śāstraṃ sudarśanādiśastrasamudayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ | āśritāniṣṭanivāraṇeṣṭaprāpaṇārthamāttapañcāyudha iti bhāvaḥ | tvaṃ maghoni indre śubhavibhavasaṃpra sāraṇaṃ śubhasya maṅgalakarasya vibhavasya trailokyasāmrājyasya saṃprasāraṇaṃ saṃpradānamiti yāvat |
analyzed: he bhagavan dṛḍham pāṇau nihitam śāstram sudarśana ādi śastra samudayaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ āśrita aniṣṭa nivāraṇa iṣṭa prāpaṇa artham ātta pañcāyudhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tvam maghoni indre śubha vibhava saṃpra sāraṇam śubhasya maṅgala karasya vibhavasya trailokya sāmrājyasya saṃprasāraṇam saṃpradānam iti yāvat

original: ākalayan san ata eva pūrvarūpaṃ durvāsaśśāpātpūrvamavasthitamūrjitatvādirūpaṃ ca | ākalayanniti saṃbadhyate | pravartayannityarthaḥ | ata eva subhe śobhanā bhā dīptiryasya tasmiṃstathokte ujjvalatejasītyarthaḥ | atra asminnindre guṇamapi nayavinayasamṛddhyādisuguṇamapi racayasi |
analyzed: ākalayan san atas eva pūrvarūpam durvāsas śāpāt pūrvam avasthitam ūrjita tva ādi rūpam ca ākalayan iti saṃbadhyate pravartayan iti arthaḥ atas eva subhe śobhanā bhā dīptiḥ yasya tasmin tathā ukte ujjvala tejasi iti arthaḥ atra asmin indre guṇam api naya vinaya samṛddhi ādi suguṇam api racayasi

original: paripūrṇajñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejasastavānugrahādevendrasyedṛśasamṛddhyādilābha iti bhāvaḥ | anenaivābhiprāyeṇa bhagavanniti saṃbodhanam | pakṣe dṛḍhaṃ svabhyastaṃ pāṇinaye hitaṃ yacchāstraṃ vyākaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktastvam | asmin pakṣe śubhavibhavasaṃprasāraṇamityatra śubhavibheticchedaḥ | śubhā vibhā prabhā yasya tathoktaḥ |

original: pakṣe ghanāgamasya prāvṛṭsamayasya ante avasāne ityarthaḥ | prathate | atrāpi śāstrīye vyavahāre laukikaśaratsamayavyavahārāropaḥ ||
analyzed: pakṣe ghanāgamasya prāvṛṣ samayasya ante avasāne iti arthaḥ prathate atra api śāstrīye vyavahāre laukika śarad samaya vyavahāra āropaḥ

original: saṃkhyāvadbhissarvavidbhiścamatkāraikajīvitaiḥ |
analyzed: saṃkhyāvadbhiḥ sarva vidbhiḥ camatkāra eka jīvitaiḥ

original: udāharaṇabhūyastvaṃ soḍhavyaṃ cāpalātkṛtam ||
analyzed: udāharaṇa bhūyastvam soḍhavyam cāpalāt kṛtam

original: iyaṃ cālaṃkārāntareṣu bhūyassvānuguṇyena vartate | yathā
analyzed: iyam ca alaṃkāra antareṣu bhūyas sva ānuguṇyena vartate yathā

original: kaṭakaścaraṇe vyalasacchiro hareradhiruroha maṇimakuṭī | datte’ntare vadhūṭī svalpe’pi viśṛṅkhalapravṛttissyāt || 800 ||
analyzed: kaṭakaḥ caraṇe vyalasat śiraḥ hareḥ adhiruroha maṇi makuṭī dattā intare vadhūṭī su alpe api viśṛṅkhala pravṛttiḥ syāt

original: atra sāmarthyatvena vartamānā samāsoktirarthāntaranyāsānuguṇyamādhatte || yathāvā
analyzed: atra sāmarthya tvena vartamānā samāsoktiḥ arthāntaranyāsa ānuguṇyam ādhatte yathā vā

original: gṛhṇāti ko nu hṛdayānyabalānāṃ bhuvi nisargacapalānām | daramanabhimukhe bhagavati ciraparicitamapi naraṃ tyajati saṃpat || 801 ||
analyzed: gṛhṇāti kaḥ nu hṛdayāni abalānām bhuvi nisarga capalānām daram anabhimukhe bhagavati cira paricitam api naram tyajati saṃpad

original: atra samarthakatvena vartate ||
analyzed: atra samarthaka tvena vartate

original: prasṛmaraghṛṇayo maṇayo hāragatāśśaurihṛtpadagatāya | prābhṛtamarpayituṃ maṇivarāya manye prasārayanti karān || 802 ||
analyzed: prasṛmara ghṛṇayaḥ maṇayaḥ hāra gatāḥ śauri hṛd pada gatāya prābhṛtam arpayitum maṇi varāya manye prasārayanti karān

original: atra sāmrājyasiṃhāsanādhirūḍhasārvabhaumopahārārpaṇaparaparicchinnajanapadādhipanarapatisamudayavyavahāramūlā karaprasāraṇotprekṣā | anenaiva pathā acetanavyavahāre prastute cetanavyavahārasaṃbandhisvarūpahetuphalotprekṣāyāṃ, cetanavyavahāre prastute cācetanavyavahārasaṃbandhisvarūpahetuphalotprekṣāyāṃ ca samāsoktireva mūlam |
analyzed: atra sāmrājya siṃhāsana adhirūḍha sārvabhauma upahāra arpaṇa para paricchinna janapada adhipa narapati samudaya vyavahāra mūlā kara prasāraṇa utprekṣā anena eva pathā acetana vyavahāre prastute cetana vyavahāra saṃbandhi svarūpa hetu phala utprekṣāyām cetana vyavahāre prastute ca acetana vyavahāra saṃbandhi svarūpa hetu phala utprekṣāyām ca samāsoktiḥ eva mūlam

original: sārūpyādapīyaṃ samāsoktirbhavatīti dīkṣitairabhyadhāyi| na kṣamate tāṃ samāsoktijīvātorviśeṣaṇasāmyasya ‘purā yatra srotaḥ’ ityatrābhāvena samāsoktitāyā evānupapatteriti vadanrasagaṅgādharakṛt | tanmate ‘purā yatra strotaḥ ityādāvaprastutapraśaṃsaiva, tathaiva tenavyavasthāpanāt |
analyzed: sārūpyāt api iyam samāsoktiḥ bhavati iti dīkṣitaiḥ abhyadhāyi na kṣamate tām samāsokti jīvātoḥ viśeṣaṇa sāmyasya purā yatra srotaḥ iti atra abhāvena samāsokti tāyāḥ eva anupapatteḥ iti vadan rasagaṅgādhara kṛt tad mate purā yatra strotaḥ ityādau aprastuta praśaṃsā eva tathā eva tena vyavasthāpanāt

original: tatsarvamapyupariṣṭādaprastutapraśaṃsālaṃkāranirūpaṇāvasare darśayiṣyāmaḥ ||
analyzed: tat sarvam api upariṣṭāt aprastuta praśaṃsā alaṃkāra nirūpaṇa avasare darśayiṣyāmaḥ

original: ityalaṃkāramaṇihāre samāsoktisaraḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ
analyzed: iti alaṃkāramaṇihāre samāsoktisaraḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ

original: pūrvabhāgassamāptaḥ
analyzed: pūrva bhāgaḥ samāptaḥ
